items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习（ResNet）
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出残差学习框架来缓解训练远超以往深度的网络的困难：将网络层显式表述为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而不是学习无参照的函数。大量实证表明，残差网络更易优化，并能随深度显著增加而提升精度。在 ImageNet 上，我们评估了深达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 深 8 倍但复杂度更低；其集成在测试集上错误率 3.57%，获 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层网络。表征深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要：仅凭极深表征，我们在 COCO 目标检测上取得 28% 的相对提升。该网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 的基础，并在 ImageNet 检测、ImageNet 定位、COCO 检测与 COCO 分割任务上均获第一。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让 152 层网络更易训练并夺冠
items.digest_zh: 1) 研究的问题：神经网络越堆越深，理论表达力更强，但实践中层数一多就难以训练，训练误差反而上升——这不是过拟合，而是优化本身变难。2) 方法：作者提出“残差学习”，让若干层不再直接学目标映射，而是学输入与输出之间的差值（残差），并把输入原样加到输出上，形成 shortcut 连接。这样极深的网络只需学“还需要改动多少”，优化起来容易得多。3) 结果：在 ImageNet 上训练 18 到 152 层的 ResNet，深度增加时精度持续提升，152 层模型比 VGG 深 8 倍却计算量更低；多模型集成在测试集上错误率 3.57%，夺得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军；在 CIFAR-10 上甚至验证了 1000 层网络仍可训练。直接用学到的深层特征做检测，COCO 上相对提升 28%。4) 为何重要：残差连接此后成为几乎所有深层网络（包括后来的视觉与语言模型）的默认组件，回答了“深度是否还有用”的疑问，并证明只要结构设计得当，深度本身就能带来收益。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上理解其功能。经大量实验努力，约 10 万个独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只是已知数十亿条蛋白质序列中的一小部分；测定单个结构往往需数月到数年，成为结构覆盖的瓶颈。仅依据氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将采用的三维结构——即“蛋白质折叠问题”中的结构预测部分——是 50 多年来重要的开放问题。尽管近来取得进展，现有方法仍远未达到原子级精度，在无同源结构时尤其如此。本文给出首个能在没有相似结构的情况下仍经常以原子精度预测蛋白质结构的计算方法。我们在极具挑战的第 14 届 CASP14 中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法。其核心是一种新的机器学习方法，将关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（利用多序列比对）融入到深度学习算法的设计中。
items.highlight_zh: 无同源结构也能达到原子级精度
items.digest_zh: 1) 问题：蛋白质的三维结构决定其功能，但用实验方法（如 X 射线晶体学、冷冻电镜）测定一个结构往往要数月到数年；已知序列有数十亿条，而已解结构仅约十万个，缺口巨大。仅凭氨基酸序列算出结构的“蛋白质折叠问题”悬而未决五十多年，尤其在没有同源模板时，已有方法远达不到原子级精度。2) 方法：AlphaFold 用深度神经网络直接从序列预测原子的三维坐标，关键是把多序列比对（同源序列中共同变化的模式）作为输入，并把关于蛋白质几何与化学的物理、生物学约束嵌入网络结构与损失设计中，相当于让模型同时“看数据”和“守规则”。3) 结果：在盲测的 CASP14 评测中，AlphaFold 在大多数目标上达到与实验结构相当的精度，大幅领先其他参赛方法，被视为向解决这一几十年难题迈出的一大步。4) 意义：它把结构生物学从“一个一个测”推向“大规模算”，可加速药物设计、酶工程与基础生物学研究，后续工作还扩展到蛋白质复合物等更大范围。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 基于衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光学衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：一组被动衍射层经深度学习设计后可协同工作，学会实现多种功能。我们通过 3D 打印的 D2NN 在太赫兹波段实验演示了该框架的成功，其学会了手写数字分类以及成像透镜的功能。借助现有丰富的 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光学深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将应用于全光学图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，还可催生能用 D2NN 学习执行独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 3D 打印衍射层以光速完成全光学分类
items.digest_zh: 1) 问题：常规神经网络依靠电子芯片做矩阵运算，速度和能耗受硬件限制；能否让光本身在传播过程中就完成神经网络的“计算”？2) 方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN），把若干层被动衍射元件叠成“光学网络”。光穿过每一层时发生衍射与相位调制，相当于一层线性变换加非线性激活；层上的相位分布由计算机用深度学习（反向传播）离线训练得到，实际器件则用 3D 打印制作，工作在太赫兹波段，无需电源或非线性电子元件。3) 结果：实验制作的 D2NN 成功完成手写数字分类，并能充当成像透镜；由于光波前在层间自然传播，整个推理过程基本以光速、几乎无源完成。4) 意义：这是“全光学计算”的可行路线演示，除分类与成像外，还可能用于全光图像分析、特征检测，乃至设计出能自行“学习”完成特殊任务的新型相机与光学元件。当前局限是器件打印完成后功能即固定，精度受制造工艺与波段限制。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种高效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得最优结果。我们提出针对稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图；更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，以构建可扩展的树提升系统。结合这些设计，XGBoost 以远少于现有系统的资源扩展到数十亿级样本。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与加权分位数草图让树提升可扩展
items.digest_zh: 1) 问题：梯度提升树在表格类任务上效果极好，但当数据规模达到上亿样本、特征稀疏时，已有实现的内存占用与训练速度都成为瓶颈。2) 方法：XGBoost 从算法与系统两侧改造。算法上，提出稀疏感知的分裂查找，自动为缺失值学习默认分支方向，稀疏数据无需填补；提出加权分位数草图，用近似分位点确定候选切分，使分布式与流式环境也能高效建树；目标函数加入树复杂度正则，抑制过拟合。系统上，采用按特征预排序的块结构、缓存感知的访问模式、数据压缩与分片，让并行与核外计算高效运转。3) 结果：在单机与分布式设置下，XGBoost 用远少于同类系统的资源即可扩展到数十亿级样本，并在大量机器学习竞赛中取得最优成绩。4) 意义：它把“好用但难扩展”的树提升变成实用的工业级工具，成为数据科学竞赛与工业建模的常用基线，也影响了 LightGBM 等后续 GBDT 系统的设计思路。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，它代表来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与最近的语言表示模型不同，BERT 被设计为通过在所有层中联合以左右上下文为条件，从无标签文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练的 BERT 模型仅需一个额外的输出层进行微调，即可为广泛的任务（例如问答和语言推断）创建最先进的模型，而无需大量任务特定的架构修改。BERT 在概念上简单，在经验上强大。它在 11 项自然语言处理任务上获得了新的最先进结果，包括将 GLUE 分数推至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点）、将 MultiNLI 准确率推至 86.7%（4.6% 的绝对提升）、将 SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 推至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5 分）以及将 SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 推至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1 分）。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：一个用于视觉、视觉惯性和多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能够使用针孔和鱼眼镜头模型、以单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机执行视觉、视觉惯性和多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个主要创新是一个基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM 系统，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计。其结果是一个能够在小型和大型、室内和室外环境中实时稳健运行的系统，并且比先前方法精确 2 到 5 倍。第二个主要创新是一个多地图系统，它依赖于一种具有改进召回率的新地点识别方法。得益于它，ORB-SLAM3 能够在长时间视觉信息较差的情况下继续运行：当它丢失时，会启动一个新地图，当重访已建图区域时，该地图将与先前地图无缝合并。与仅使用过去几秒信息的视觉里程计系统相比，ORB-SLAM3 是首个能够在所有算法阶段重用所有先前信息的系统。这使得能够将共视关键帧纳入捆绑调整，这些关键帧提供高视差观测从而提升精度，即使它们在时间上相隔很远或来自先前的建图会话。我们的实验表明，在所有传感器配置下，ORB-SLAM3 与文献中可用的最佳系统一样稳健，并且显著更精确。值得注意的是，我们的双目惯性 SLAM 在 EuRoC 无人机上达到 3.6 cm 的平均精度，在 TUM-VI 数据集的房间内快速手持运动下达到 9 mm，该设置代表 AR/VR 场景。为造福社区，我们公开源代码。

items.title_en: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.title_zh: 面向智能体机器人操作的世界上下文学习
items.abstract_en: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript
items.abstract_zh: 经训练的动作策略将操作技能写入网络权重，从而把所学内容与其学习所处的分布绑定。上下文学习（ICL）避免了这种耦合，但尚未达到经训练策略的水平，因为在另一场景中记录的演示不携带机器人当前所面对世界的反馈。我们观察到，智能体在上下文中学习到的内容是语义性的，记录的是任务步骤和对象角色而非视觉外观，因此在一个世界中收集的经验可以迁移到另一个世界。基于这一洞见，我们提出世界上下文学习（WICL），一种范式：冻结模型从演示出发，在诸如模拟器的世界中排练任务，并将反馈写入其上下文而非权重。我们构建了 RoboScript，一个模块化基础设施，为智能体操作实现 WICL。从单次演示出发，RoboScript 通过模拟中的排练学习每个任务，将学到的知识冻结为任务记忆（Task Memory），并将冻结的记忆部署到新场景，且采用数据隔离以确保每个部署输入在真实机器人上可用。在 RoboTwin 2.0 的全部 50 个任务上，RoboScript 在干净和随机化设置下以每个任务一次演示且无梯度更新达到 83.4% 的平均成功率，超过最强的经训练动作策略 20 个百分点以上。该方法可跨视觉分布泛化，通过反思得到改进，随基础模型扩展，并通过跨具身记忆适配迁移到物理双臂机器人。在闭环中引入世界后，机器人可以在其上下文中学习操作任务，效果与在权重中学习相当。所有代码见 https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

items.title_en: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
items.title_zh: ProTEUS：面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型
items.abstract_en: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed than AlphaFold3 with guaranteed physical validity. Lastly, ProTEUS refines its prediction and understanding of protein activity through closed loop experimental feedback to guide evolution toward a desired phenotype. ProTEUS surpasses established models in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning mutation prediction tasks. We experimentally demonstrate its utility in two closed-loop multi-objective engineering campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase, yielding variants with >10 fold higher activity than wild type. ProTEUS provides a world-model framework that connects virtual evaluation of mutational outcomes with experimental learning for efficient protein evolution.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度景观中导航，其中微小的序列变化可产生大的功能差异，但实验筛选只能采样序列空间的一小部分。因此，一个核心挑战是在计算机中高效遍历巨大的突变组合空间。我们提出 ProTEUS，一个面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型。ProTEUS 在深度突变扫描实验数据上预训练，使用 MutationFormer（一种突变偏置注意力架构）学习序列、进化和结构信息的联合表示。变体被表示为该联合潜在空间中的状态，突变定义动作，并预测其功能后果。为支持对许多突变体的探索，我们开发了一种快速、物理约束的全原子预测器，利用显式几何约束强制执行，在保证物理有效性的情况下实现比 AlphaFold3 超过 10 倍的速度提升。最后，ProTEUS 通过闭环实验反馈来改进其对蛋白质活性的预测和理解，以引导进化朝向期望表型。在零样本和监督微调突变预测任务中，ProTEUS 均优于已有模型。我们在醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶（levansucrase）上的两个闭环多目标工程活动中实验证明了其效用，产生的变体活性比野生型高 10 倍以上。ProTEUS 提供了一个世界模型框架，将突变结果的虚拟评估与实验学习连接起来，以实现高效的蛋白质进化。

items.title_en: Machine-learning decoders for fusion-based quantum computing in real time
items.title_zh: 面向聚变式量子计算的实时机器学习解码器
items.abstract_en: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires decoders that combine accuracy, throughput, low latency, and scalability to large numbers of physical qubits. In photonic fusion-based architectures, erasures from photon loss and probabilistic fusion measurements are a dominant error mechanism, motivating decoders that remain accurate at high erasure rates. We introduce PRISM, a transformer-based machine-learning decoder designed to exploit the known locations of erasures in protocols subject to both Pauli and erasure errors. We benchmark PRISM across a wide range of fault-tolerant protocols based on surface codes, color codes, and quantum low-density parity-check codes, with distances up to 24. Across these benchmarks, PRISM matches the logical error rates of integer-programming-based decoders while being significantly faster, including at error rates up to 50% of threshold. We further optimize the decoder and its real-time hardware implementation to reduce latency while maintaining accuracy. Our optimized implementation on an AMD VP1902 FPGA can decode logical blocks of distance 8 in both space and time, demonstrating a latency of 6.59 microseconds and an amortized decoding time of 1.56 microseconds per logical block is possible. These results show that machine-learning decoding can provide accurate, low-latency inference for erasure-dominated fault-tolerant quantum architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算要求解码器兼具准确性、吞吐量、低延迟以及可扩展到大量物理比特的能力。在光子聚变架构中，光子丢失与概率性聚变测量带来的擦除是主导性错误机制，这要求解码器在高擦除率下仍保持准确。我们提出 PRISM——一种基于 Transformer 的机器学习解码器，专为同时存在 Pauli 错误与擦除错误的协议设计，可利用擦除位置的已知信息。我们在基于 surface code、color code 与量子低密度奇偶校验码的多类容错协议上评测 PRISM，码距最大为 24。结果显示，PRISM 的逻辑错误率与基于整数规划的解码器相当，但速度显著更快，即便错误率高达阈值的 50% 时亦然。我们进一步优化解码器及其实时硬件实现以降低延迟并保持精度：在 AMD VP1902 FPGA 上，空间与时间码距均为 8 的逻辑块可实现 6.59 微秒延迟，每逻辑块均摊解码时间 1.56 微秒。
items.highlight_zh: 机器学习解码器精度媲美整数规划，FPGA 延迟仅 6.59 微秒
items.digest_zh:
① 研究的核心问题：容错量子计算机需要实时把物理量子比特的错误记录“翻译”成纠错动作，这个翻译器就是解码器，必须同时做到准确、快、延迟低、可扩展到海量比特。在光子“聚变式”架构里，主导错误是光子丢失和概率性测量造成的“擦除”，而擦除发生在哪里往往可以预先知道，但传统解码器未必用得上这一信息。
② 采用的方法：作者提出 PRISM，一种 Transformer 结构的机器学习解码器，专门利用“擦除位置已知”这一点，同时处理普通 Pauli 错误与擦除错误。
③ 得到的结果：他们在 surface code、color code 和量子 LDPC 码等多类容错方案上做基准测试，码距最大到 24。PRISM 的纠错准确度与计算量大得多的整数规划解码器持平，但速度快得多，即便错误率高达阈值的 50% 仍然成立。团队还优化了硬件实现：在 AMD VP1902 FPGA 上，空间与时间码距均为 8 的逻辑块解码延迟为 6.59 微秒，均摊每块 1.56 微秒。
④ 为什么重要：量子纠错必须“跑得比错误积累快”，微秒级延迟是硬指标。该工作说明机器学习解码不仅精度可媲美传统最优方法，还能达到实时硬件所需的延迟，为以擦除为主导错误机制的光子量子计算路线提供了可行方案。

items.title_en: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
items.title_zh: Tree-Ising：用比特级 Ising 编辑修复语言模型
items.abstract_en: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop direction, strengthens a concluding direction, and preserves the layer's output on productive tokens. Within a state-tree representation, where lossless BF16 storage acts as a special case, the admissible edits are sign flips and exponent shifts that preserve all shared group exponents and mantissas. We decompose this objective exactly into independent QUBO (Ising) problems, one per output row, which we solve on a GPU using simulated annealing or quantum-inspired simulated bifurcation. On the agent's two layers, Tree-Ising achieves 54.6% on MATH-500, outperforming the agent's edit (51.7%) under the same evaluation protocol, while the base model scores 7.9% as reported. The simulated bifurcation solver yields a statistically indistinguishable repair at 55.1%. Both solvers outperform the agent edit across all five math benchmarks, with statistically significant improvements on MATH-500 and GSM8K after correcting for multiple comparisons. Our approach modifies 13% to 17% fewer weights and reduces BF16 bit flips by a factor of 2.2 to 2.3. It requires only four forward-pass requests and zero LLM tokens, with the annealing recipe costing about $0.90 in GPU time. On Qwen3.5-2B, with layers and dose selected using only the base model, the same recipe increases greedy GSM8K accuracy from 21.6% to 69.4%. As a proof of concept, we execute an eight-variable repair subproblem using QAOA on an IBM Heron processor.
items.abstract_zh: MIT 的 Take 等人提出的权重空间编程使 LLM 智能体能够读取网络权重并写出修复：其 GPT-6 Astra 在无梯度条件下纠正了 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的推理循环，但耗费 158 个智能体回合、8970 万 token 与 50 次前向请求。我们提出 Tree-Ising，把修复转化为模型自身 BF16 权重上的稀疏离散优化：以前向统计构造目标，削弱循环方向、强化收束方向，并保持该层在有效 token 上的输出；允许的编辑限于保值（共享组指数与尾数）的符号翻转与指数位移，目标可精确分解为逐输出行的独立 QUBO（Ising）问题，在 GPU 上用模拟退火或量子启发式模拟分岔求解。在 MATH-500 上达 54.6%，优于智能体编辑的 51.7%（基座为 7.9%）；模拟分岔给出统计无差的 55.1%。方法少修改 13%–17% 的权重，BF16 位翻转减少 2.2–2.3 倍，仅需 4 次前向请求、零 LLM token。（原文摘要末尾在此截断）
items.highlight_zh: 把权重修复化为一组 Ising 问题，更准且成本低数百倍
items.digest_zh:
① 研究的问题：大模型有时会陷进“推理循环”绕圈子，常规修法要重训或微调，代价高。MIT 的 Take 等人提出“权重空间编程”：让一个 LLM 智能体直接读目标模型的权重并写出修补方案。效果不错但代价惊人——158 个交互回合、近 9000 万 token、50 次前向请求。本文要让这件事更便宜也更准。
② 方法：Tree-Ising 把“修权重”改写成模型自身 BF16 权重上的稀疏离散优化。先用前向统计量定义目标：削弱导致绕圈的方向、强化能收束到答案的方向，同时尽量不改变模型在正常 token 上的输出。允许的编辑只有两类——符号翻转和指数位移，且必须保持同组共享的指数与尾数不变（无损 BF16 存储只是其中一个特例）。该目标可被精确拆成“每个输出行一个独立 QUBO（Ising）问题”，再在 GPU 上用模拟退火或量子启发的模拟分岔求解。
③ 结果：在智能体挑出的两层上，MATH-500 准确率 54.6%，高于智能体编辑的 51.7%，而基座模型仅 7.9%；模拟分岔求解器给出 55.1%，与退火统计上无差别。两种求解器在全部五个数学基准上都胜过智能体编辑，其中 MATH-500 与 GSM8K 的改进经多重比较校正后仍显著。代价上：改动权重少 13%–17%，BF16 位翻转少 2.2–2.3 倍，只需 4 次前向请求、不消耗任何 LLM token，退火方案 GPU 时间约 0.9 美元。在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，仅用基座模型选层与剂量，同一配方把 GSM8K 贪心准确率从 21.6% 继续往上推（原文摘要在此截断）。
④ 重要性：它把“靠智能体反复试探改权重”换成可精确分解、可高效求解的组合优化，既更准又便宜几个数量级，为大模型行为修复提供了工程上现实的路径。

items.title_en: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 大语言模型作为开放世界自动机器学习的通用搜索器
items.abstract_en: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 构建有效机器学习模型需要复杂的人工调参，而现有 AutoML 框架仍局限于特定领域，并把模型架构、训练超参数与数据配比优化割裂开来。为此，我们提出一个通用、基于大语言模型（LLM）的 AutoML 框架，首次在无需任务特定微调的情况下联合优化上述配置。我们提出 NCode——一种统一数值编码方案，将多样的 AutoML 设计选择转换为通用离散序列，并把优化过程重塑为统一的排序任务。该 LLM 搜索器仅在有限单领域视觉任务的优化轨迹上训练，却在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证与文生图基准上展现出跨任务、跨模态与联合搜索空间优化的泛化能力，取得 SOTA 表现。尤为关键的是，它在十亿参数 Diffusion Transformer 的大规模训练与联合优化中表现优异：耗时 896 GPU 天，取得 GenEval 0.91 的 SOTA 分数。借助强化学习注入思维链推理，我们提供了系统解读搜索器内部决策机制的方法，揭示其优化策略从早期多样性驱动的探索转向后期的锚点利用。该框架为通用、开放世界的机器学习优化提供了可扩展、可泛化、可解释的路径。
items.highlight_zh: 统一 NCode 编码让 LLM 跨领域联合优化架构、超参与数据
items.digest_zh:
① 研究的问题：训练一个好模型要同时调很多东西——网络结构、训练超参、数据配比。但现有 AutoML 工具大多只针对某一类任务，而且把这三类选择分开优化，彼此割裂，需要大量人工试错。
② 方法：作者提出一个基于大语言模型的“通用搜索器”。核心是名为 NCode 的统一数值编码：把各种形态的设计选择（层数、学习率、数据比例等）统统翻译成离散 token 序列，于是“调参”被改写成“给候选序列排序”这一统一任务——正好是 LLM 擅长的。搜索器不需要针对新任务微调，只用某个单一视觉任务的优化轨迹训练；再用强化学习教会它“思维链”式推理。
③ 结果：这个搜索器在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证、文生图等不同任务与模态上都刷新了 SOTA，说明它确实能跨领域迁移。更关键的是可扩展性：在十亿参数 Diffusion Transformer 的大规模训练与联合优化上，它花费 896 GPU 天，把 GenEval 分数做到 0.91 的 SOTA。由于具备思维链，作者还能“读出”搜索器的决策逻辑：早期偏向多样性探索，后期收敛到对好锚点的深度利用。
④ 重要性：它把“模型、超参、数据”的优化统一进一个可跨领域复用、可解释、可放大的框架，为开放世界的自动化机器学习提供新范式，也说明 LLM 不只是生成器，还可以充当通用“优化器”。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Embodied First Exam
items.title_zh: Embodied First Exam：面向编码智能体的具身评测基准
items.abstract_en: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.
items.abstract_zh: agentic 机器人领域的早期成功预示着一种可能的范式转变：用编码智能体控制机器人。现有机器人基准围绕视觉运动策略学习构建，因此编码智能体能否在物理世界约束下可靠控制多种机器人仍是未解问题。我们提出 Embodied First Exam——一个统一、全面且 agent-native 的评测框架，编码智能体可自行选择控制方式：直接控制、用代码控制，或训练策略来控制。我们希望它成为编码智能体进入物理世界前的“首考”，涵盖 47 种机器人、35 个套件中的 1156 项任务，其中 9 个新套件超越抓放任务，涉及空间谜题、灵巧操作、多机器人交互、动态全身控制与 sim-to-sim 工程。每个任务可在最多三种设置下运行：Standard 模拟真实世界，智能体仅获得传感器观测且默认不能重置环境；Realtime 变体在智能体推理时保持环境持续运行；Privileged 设置向智能体开放完整仿真器状态与无限重置，便于搜索训练用 oracle 解，其成功率可近似作为上界。在 456 项核心任务上，八个智能体中最强的 Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra 在 Standard 设置下成功率为 34%，仍有很大提升空间。为定位失败原因，我们标注失败尝试出错的阶段，并跨智能体、设置与阶段类别比较失败情况。
items.highlight_zh: 47 种机器人 1156 项任务，最强编码智能体成功率仅 34%
items.digest_zh:
① 研究的问题：越来越多人想用“会写代码的智能体”去操作机器人。但现有机器人基准基本是为“视觉-运动策略学习”设计的，衡量的是策略网络的表现，而不是编码智能体在真实物理约束下能否可靠指挥机器人。这个问题此前没有统一答案。
② 方法：作者搭建了 Embodied First Exam，一个“为智能体原生设计”的评测场。智能体可以自选控制路线：直接发控制指令、写代码去控制，或先训练一个策略再控制。题库规模可观：47 种机器人、35 个套件、1156 项任务，其中 9 个是新套件，跳出了传统“抓取-放置”，涵盖空间谜题、灵巧操作、多机器人协作、动态全身控制和 sim-to-sim 工程迁移。每个任务最多可在三种设置下运行：Standard（模拟真实世界，只能看传感器读数，默认不许重置）、Realtime（环境不停，智能体边想边动）、Privileged（开放完整仿真状态、可无限重置，用来找“标准答案”，其成功率近似上界）。
③ 结果：在最核心的 456 项任务上，八个智能体中表现最好的 GPT-6 Astra（在 Codex 中）于 Standard 设置下成功率仅 34%，离实用还很远。作者还标注了每次失败发生在哪个阶段，横向比较不同智能体、不同设置、不同阶段类别的失败模式，指出具体卡在哪里。
④ 重要性：它提供了一个统一标尺，回答“编码智能体现在够不够格进物理世界”，并把失败定位到可改进的环节，对具身智能与智能体研究都具有基准意义。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: EVAThink: Evidence Sufficiency-Guided Training for Adaptive Thinking in Video Understanding
items.title_zh: EVAThink：以证据充分性为引导的训练，实现视频理解中的自适应思考
items.abstract_en: Under a fixed frame budget, video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) depends on whether the sampled frames provide sufficient evidence for the question. Sufficient frame evidence supports direct answering, whereas less informative observations may benefit from reasoning that connects the available cues. We introduce EVAThink, which enhances video understanding through evidence sufficiency-guided training for adaptive thinking. First, Recoverable Evidence Gap Mining constructs evidence-dense and evidence-sparse video views that share the same question and answer under an identical frame budget. It retains pairs where sparse views yield lower direct-answer accuracy than dense views but benefit from explicit reasoning, providing supervision for response-mode selection. Second, Evidence-Guided Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning uses stage-specific rewards to guide training with evidence-based mode preferences and then refine response efficiency, while first-token advantage regularization mitigates mode collapse. Trained on only 6.7K curated samples, EVAThink consistently improves upon the base model across video understanding benchmarks under both 32- and 64-frame budgets, while outperforming strong baselines on average. The code, model, and datasets are available at \href{https://github.com/ChangtiWu/EVAThink}{EVAThink}.
items.abstract_zh: 在固定帧预算下，视觉语言模型（VLM）的视频理解效果取决于所采样帧能否为问题提供充分证据。证据充分的帧支持直接作答，而信息量较少的观察则可能需要通过推理把已有线索连接起来。为此我们提出 EVAThink，通过证据充分性引导的训练实现自适应思考，从而提升视频理解能力。首先，「可恢复证据缺口挖掘」在相同帧预算下针对同一问题与答案构造证据密集与证据稀疏的两种视频视图，保留那些稀疏视图直接作答准确率低于密集视图、但能通过显式推理获益的样本对，为作答模式选择提供监督信号。其次，「证据引导的两阶段强化学习」使用分阶段奖励，先依据基于证据的模式偏好引导训练，再优化回答效率，并用首 token 优势正则化缓解模式坍塌。仅用 6.7K 条精选样本训练，EVAThink 在 32 帧和 64 帧预算下的多个视频理解基准上稳定优于基座模型，平均表现超过强基线。代码、模型与数据集已开源于 EVAThink。
items.highlight_zh: 用6.7K样本训练模型自适应选择直接作答或显式推理
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：视频问答模型通常只能在有限帧数（如 32 帧或 64 帧）内看视频。问题是，是否所有问题都值得「多想一步」？论文的出发点是：如果抽到的帧已经足以回答问题，直接作答又快又准；如果帧信息不足，反而应该启动推理，把零散线索串联起来。但现有模型往往固定地「总是推理」或「总是不推理」，缺乏自适应能力。

方法：作者设计了两步训练流程。第一步是数据构造，在相同帧预算下对同一段视频采样出「证据密集」与「证据稀疏」两种视图，保留那些稀疏视图直接作答更差、但推理后能答对的样本对，从而得到「什么时候该推理」的监督信号。第二步是两阶段强化学习，第一阶段用证据引导的奖励让模型学会按证据充分性选择作答模式，第二阶段再压缩不必要的推理以提升效率；同时用首 token 优势正则化防止模型退化为只会一种模式。

结果：仅用 6.7K 条精选样本，模型在 32 帧与 64 帧两种预算下的多个视频理解基准上均稳定超过基座模型，平均成绩优于强基线。

为何重要：它把「要不要推理」变成一个由证据充分性驱动的可学习决策，而不是靠人工设定的固定策略；且训练数据量很小，说明精巧的数据构造与奖励设计可以在不大幅增加算力的情况下显著提升推理效率与准确率。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Optimization principles, revisited
items.title_zh: 重访优化原理
items.abstract_en: The brain solves a wide range of problems, and some of these solutions are very good indeed. It is an old idea that, in some cases, these solutions may be as good as possible given the relevant constraints. If this is true we can promote this notion of optimization to a principle from which aspects of function and mechanism can be derived, ideally with no free parameters. Optimization principles are powerful and have had many successes, but they remain controversial. We start with a reminder of a classic example---diffraction limited optics in insect eyes---and then a summary of why you should worry about optimization as a more general principle. Next we turn to recent progress on the theory of optimal motion estimation in fly vision, and finally summarize recent results on the landscape for optimization, arguing that (contrary to widely held intuitions) optimal performance need not require the underlying mechanisms to have finely tuned parameters. I hope to convince you that this is a moment to take optimization seriously as the basis for theories of neural coding and computation. This is based on a rather informal lecture at the summer school LASCON X in Sao Paulo, and I have tried to preserve that tone here; pointers are given to more detailed and technical discussions.
items.abstract_zh: 大脑能解决各种各样的问题，其中一些解决方案确实非常出色。一个由来已久的想法是：在某些情况下，这些解在给定相关约束后可能已达到最优。若果真如此，我们便可把「优化」提升为一条原理，并据此推导出功能与机制层面的特征，理想情况下还不含自由参数。优化原理威力强大且已有诸多成功，但仍具争议。本文先回顾一个经典例子——昆虫复眼中受衍射极限限制的光学系统，随后概述为何应对「优化作为更普遍原理」保持警惕；接着介绍果蝇视觉中最优运动估计理论的新进展，最后总结近期关于优化「地形」的结果，并指出（与普遍直觉相反）最优性能未必要求底层机制具有精调的参数。我希望说服读者：现在是认真把优化作为神经编码与计算理论基础的时机。本文基于在圣保罗 LASCON X 暑期学校的非正式讲座，并尽量保留了那种口吻；文中给出了更详细、更技术性的讨论指引。
items.highlight_zh: 最优性能未必需要机制具有精调参数
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：神经科学里有一个老观点——大脑某些解决方案可能是在约束条件下的「最优解」。如果成立，就可以把优化当作一条原理，直接推导出神经系统的功能乃至机制，甚至不需要任何可调参数。但这条思路一直有争议，本文要重新审视它。

方法：这是一篇观点性综述，基于作者在暑期学校的讲座。论证路径分三步：先回顾经典案例——昆虫复眼受衍射极限限制的光学结构，说明「最优」确实能解释真实结构；再列举为何把优化当成普遍原理需要谨慎（例如约束条件难以界定、多个解可能同样好）；随后介绍果蝇视觉系统中「最优运动估计」理论的新进展，以及近期关于优化问题「地形」（landscape）的结果。

结果与核心论点：作者指出一个反直觉的结论——系统取得最优性能，并不必然意味着其底层机制被精调过；也就是说，最优性可能对参数细节不敏感，这反而让「优化原理」更有解释力，因为不需要为每个参数寻找特定取值。

为何重要：如果优化原理成立，它就是一种几乎无自由参数的理论工具，能把「系统为什么长成这样」从描述性解释变成可推导的预测。作者因此呼吁把优化认真作为神经编码与计算理论的出发点，而不是仅仅当作事后附会的说法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: The energetic cost of loading classical data in quantum computers
items.title_zh: 量子计算机中加载经典数据的能量代价
items.abstract_en: Quantum algorithms for machine learning, chemistry, and cryptanalysis often assume coherent access to classical data at negligible physical cost. We instead treat data loading as a hardware process and quantify the dynamic energetic cost of a quantum random access memory (QRAM) query on a superconducting processor. Using the metric-noise-resource framework, we relate query fidelity and power to gate duration, relative two-qubit drive strength, and the distribution of attenuation across a multi-stage refrigerator, while accounting for thermal photons and gate errors. We analyze the linear-depth multiplexer and the noise-resilient bucket-brigade architectures, adapting the latter to a native superconducting gate set and refining its fidelity analysis using the fully decomposed gate schedule. For a representative bucket-brigade QRAM query with a $12$-qubit address register we obtain a query fidelity of $0.969$. The query consumes $3.51\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{J}$ of dynamic energy, corresponding to an average dynamic power of $4.38\,\mathrm{W}$ and a peak of $64.4\,\mathrm{W}$. Our optimization shows that, at fixed target fidelity, the operating point and attenuation profile can change the average power by a factor of two or more.
items.abstract_zh: 面向机器学习、化学与密码分析的量子算法，常常假定能以相干方式访问经典数据，且物理代价可以忽略。本文转而把数据加载视为一种硬件过程，量化超导处理器上量子随机存取存储器（QRAM）单次查询的动态能量代价。我们采用「度量—噪声—资源」框架，将查询保真度与功率同门持续时间、相对双比特驱动强度以及多级制冷机中的衰减分布联系起来，同时计入热光子与门错误。我们分析了线性深度多路复用器与抗噪声的 bucket-brigade 架构，并将后者适配到原生超导门集合，利用完全分解的门调度改进了其保真度分析。对于地址寄存器为 12 个量子比特的代表性 bucket-brigade QRAM 查询，我们得到 0.969 的查询保真度；该查询消耗 3.51×10⁻⁴ J 的动态能量，对应平均动态功率 4.38 W、峰值 64.4 W。优化表明，在固定目标保真度下，工作点与衰减配置可使平均功率变化两倍以上。
items.highlight_zh: QRAM单次查询耗能3.51×10⁻⁴焦耳，峰值功率64.4瓦
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：许多量子算法（机器学习、量子化学、密码分析）在理论分析时都假设「读取经典数据」是免费且相干可行的。但在真实硬件上，把经典数据加载进量子内存本身要消耗能量，而且会引入噪声。本文要回答：这一步到底有多贵？

方法：作者把数据加载当作一个硬件过程来分析，针对超导处理器上的量子随机存取存储器（QRAM）查询，使用「度量—噪声—资源」框架，把查询保真度和功率与门持续时间、双比特驱动强度、以及多级稀释制冷机中各温区的信号衰减分布联系起来，同时考虑热光子和门错误。他们比较了两种架构：线性深度的多路复用器，以及抗噪声的 bucket-brigade 架构；后者被适配到原生超导门集合，并用完全分解的门调度改进保真度估计。

结果：以一个地址寄存器为 12 量子比特的 bucket-brigade 查询为例，保真度可达 0.969，单次查询动态耗能 3.51×10⁻⁴ J，平均功率 4.38 W，峰值 64.4 W。进一步优化显示，在保真度固定的前提下，工作点和衰减配置的选取能让平均功率相差两倍以上。

为何重要：它把量子算法中「数据加载免费」的隐含假设替换成可计算的硬件代价，提示未来的量子算法评估需要把能耗与噪声纳入复杂度分析，也为硬件设计给出了可优化的参数空间。

items.title_en: WaveGen: Truly End-to-End Waveform Generation via Internal Spectral Trajectory Learning
items.title_zh: WaveGen：通过内部频谱轨迹学习实现真正的端到端波形生成
items.abstract_en: This work proposes WaveGen, a fully end-to-end diffusion-based text-to-waveform framework based on Spectral Forcing, which jointly learns an internal spectral trajectory and the target waveform trajectory within a single model, enabling direct end-to-end text-to-waveform generation. Unlike recent TTS pipelines, WaveGen does not rely on separately trained or externally decoded intermediate representations, such as neural audio codecs, Mel-spectrogram vocoders, or VAE-based latent models. In addition, WaveGen performs internal text-speech alignment within a single model, eliminating the need for external alignment modules such as duration predictors. To preserve a truly end-to-end formulation, our framework further avoids dependence on self-supervised representations, such as BERT-based text embeddings and Wav2Vec 2.0-based semantic representations, as well as semantic distillation methods for training optimization. To achieve this, we carefully design Spectral Forcing, a model architecture with disentangled diffusion heads, and a training objective based on a multi-scale spectral $v$-loss. We further validate the scalability of end-to-end TTS models by scaling the model size from 0.1B to 0.6B parameters. Using a single architecture, open-source data, and one-stage training, without external modules such as duration predictor or REPA, WaveGen demonstrates fully end-to-end waveform generation achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Emilia training dataset. In particular, WaveGen achieves a WER of 1.47 and a SIM of 0.75 on the Seed-en benchmark. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/sh-lee-prml/WaveGen
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 WaveGen，一个基于 Spectral Forcing 的全端到端扩散式文本到波形生成框架：它在单一模型内联合学习内部频谱轨迹与目标波形轨迹，从而直接实现端到端的文本到波形生成。与近期的 TTS 流程不同，WaveGen 不依赖单独训练或外部解码的中间表示，如神经音频编解码器、Mel 声谱声码器或基于 VAE 的隐变量模型。此外，WaveGen 在单一模型内部完成文本—语音对齐，无需时长预测器等外部对齐模块。为保持真正的端到端形式，该框架还避免依赖自监督表示（如基于 BERT 的文本嵌入、基于 Wav2Vec 2.0 的语义表示）以及用于训练优化的语义蒸馏方法。为此，我们精心设计了 Spectral Forcing、具有解耦扩散头的模型架构，以及基于多尺度频谱 v-loss 的训练目标。我们进一步通过把模型规模从 0.1B 扩展到 0.6B 参数，验证端到端 TTS 模型的可扩展性。仅使用单一架构、开源数据和单阶段训练，不依赖时长预测器或 REPA 等外部模块，WaveGen 在 Emilia 训练数据集上展现出全端到端波形生成并达到最先进性能。具体而言，WaveGen 在 Seed-en 基准上取得 1.47 的 WER 与 0.75 的 SIM。源代码与检查点已发布于项目主页。
items.highlight_zh: 单模型单阶段训练，无需声码器或外部对齐即可生成波形
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：当前文本转语音（TTS）系统大多不是真正的「端到端」：文本先经过 BERT 之类的自监督表示，再预测时长、生成 Mel 声谱，最后由神经声码器或音频编解码器还原成波形。这些环节各自单独训练，误差逐级累积，流程也复杂。能否让一个模型直接从文本生成原始波形？

方法：作者提出 WaveGen，核心是「Spectral Forcing」：在同一个扩散模型内，同时学习一条内部的频谱轨迹和目标波形轨迹，让频谱作为模型内部的中间状态，而不是外部模块的输出。架构上采用解耦的扩散头，训练目标使用多尺度频谱 v-loss。为保持纯粹端到端，模型不依赖预训练的文本嵌入或语音语义表示，也不用语义蒸馏来辅助优化；文本与语音的对齐也在模型内部完成，从而省掉时长预测器。作者还把模型从 0.1B 扩展到 0.6B 参数以检验可扩展性。

结果：仅用单一架构、开源数据和单阶段训练，在 Emilia 数据集上训练后，WaveGen 在 Seed-en 基准上取得 WER 1.47、说话人相似度 SIM 0.75，达到该数据集上的最先进水平。

为何重要：它证明了「去中间表示」的端到端 TTS 不仅在概念上可行，在质量上也能与依赖大量外部组件的流程竞争，同时训练与部署链路更简单，并为后续规模化研究提供了路线。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
items.title_zh: EmoHarness：用元框架演化（Meta-Harness Evolving）提升多模态情感理解
items.abstract_en: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 小型多模态模型在文字、语音与视觉线索相互冲突时容易误判情绪。我们提出 EmoHarness，把这类模型（冻结的“学生模型”）放进一个 harness 中运行——即围绕其调用的提示、设置与验证代码。人工编写的初始 harness（scaffold）将学生模型的视觉观察、转录文本和韵律描述编号成可引用的证据，并让学生模型据此权衡候选情绪。在 Meta-Harness Evolving（MHE）中，更强的 LLM（Builder）离线读取学生模型的错误与执行轨迹并修改 harness，由静态检查与验证门决定哪些修改被保留，且 Builder 从不见评测样本。在 5,507 条 MME-Emotion 数据上，EmoHarness 相对仅视频单次调用，使四个学生模型、两个 Builder 的任务宏平均识别率提升 7.6–13.4 点。转录与韵律描述贡献了大部分增益（+5.38 至 +10.71）；scaffold 对音频增强调用的影响为 -0.79 至 +2.54，部分来自额外的多标签预测；演化修改最多再加 +0.95，但没有任何演化增量通过 Holm 校正。harness 的情绪上下文还可迁移到 IntentQA，四个学生模型中三个有小幅提升，但均未通过校正。因此，EmoHarness 主要是通过提供并组织音频派生证据来提升小型多模态学生模型。
items.highlight_zh: 组织音频证据的 harness 让小模型情感识别提升 7.6–13.4 点
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：小参数量的多模态模型在判断情绪时，一旦语气、措辞和表情互相矛盾就容易出错。作者不去重新训练模型，而是想改善“模型被怎样调用、怎样被喂证据”。
方法：把冻结的学生模型套进一个 harness——包括提示词、参数设置和结果校验代码。初始版本（scaffold）会把画面观察、语音转录、韵律（语调语速）描述都编号成可引用的证据，再让学生模型逐条对照、权衡候选情绪。随后用 Meta-Harness Evolving：让更强的 LLM 扮演 Builder，离线查看学生模型的错误案例和执行轨迹，据此改写 harness；改动须通过静态检查与验证门才能保留，且 Builder 看不到测试数据，避免作弊。
结果：在 5,507 条 MME-Emotion 样本上，该方法比“只看视频、只调一次”的基线高出 7.6–13.4 点，对四个学生模型和两个 Builder 都成立。消融显示增益主要来自转录和韵律描述（+5.38 至 +10.71）；scaffold 本身作用不稳定（-0.79 至 +2.54）；自动演化的编辑最多再加 0.95 点，且统计校正后不显著。迁移到 IntentQA 只有小幅、不显著的提升。
意义：结论很“反直觉”但很有价值——真正的收益来自把音频信息变成可引用的结构化证据，而不是花哨的自动提示演化；这为低成本提升小模型情绪理解指明了更可靠的方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它建立在高效紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，并有两项关键创新，使 LiDAR 导航与建图更快、更稳、更准。第一，直接将原始点云配准到地图（并随之更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征点，从而能利用环境中细微的特征、提升精度；去掉手工设计的特征提取模块后，也天然适配各种扫描模式的新兴 LiDAR。第二，用增量式 k-d 树（ikd-Tree）维护地图，支持点的插入、删除增量更新与动态重平衡。与八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d 树等现有动态结构相比，ikd-Tree 综合性能更优，并天然支持在树上降采样。我们在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做了详尽基准比较，FAST-LIO2 的计算量远低于其他先进 LiDAR-惯性导航系统，精度却持续更高。我们还针对小视场固态 LiDAR 开展了多项真实实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 里程计与建图）、鲁棒（在杂乱室内、旋转达 1000 deg/s 时仍能可靠定位）、通用（适用多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），且精度高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 无需特征提取、ikd-Tree 增量建图，实现 100 Hz 高精度 LiDAR 里程计
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人、无人机要定位和建图，常用 LiDAR 加惯性测量单元（IMU）。传统方法要先从点云里提取“特征点”（角点、面点），步骤多、耗时，而且特征提取规则往往针对某类雷达，换一种扫描方式就不好用。
方法：FAST-LIO2 做了两件事。其一，抛弃特征提取，把原始点云直接配准到地图上，并同步更新地图；这样既省掉手工模块，又能用上环境里细微的几何信息。其二，设计增量式 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 来管理地图，支持随时插入、删除点并动态重平衡，还天然支持树上降采样，使地图维护不再是瓶颈。整体算法基于紧耦合的迭代卡尔曼滤波，把 IMU 与 LiDAR 观测在一次滤波中融合。
结果：作者在多个公开数据集的 19 个序列上做了系统对比，FAST-LIO2 在计算量远低于同类先进系统的情况下精度持续更高。真实实验中，大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图；杂乱室内环境、角速度高达 1000 deg/s 时仍能稳定估计位姿；对多线旋转雷达和小视场固态雷达、无人机与手持设备、Intel 与 ARM 平台都能用。
意义：这是 LiDAR-惯性里程计领域的高影响力工作，它把“直接法”和高效地图结构结合起来，兼顾速度、精度与跨硬件通用性，此后成为许多机器人 SLAM 系统的实用基线。

items.title_en: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
items.title_zh: SWAM：通过跨模态对齐扩展世界动作模型
items.abstract_en: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.
items.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型以语言为条件联合预测视频和动作。现有研究主要关注架构和训练机制，通常将通过视频预训练获得的语言-视频对齐视为既定基础。然而，引入动作学习可能损害这种对齐。关于在动作学习期间维持语言-视频对齐的数据与监督设计，有原则性的指导仍然有限。为研究这一问题，我们整理了一个约47,000小时的池，包含通用视频、第一人称视频、UMI演示和机器人演示。在此基础上，我们系统研究语言-视频监督、语言-视频-动作监督以及这两种形式的联合使用如何影响WAM性能。特别地，我们考察语言标注质量如何影响预训练的语言-视频能力，以及来自UMI和机器人演示的动作监督如何将这些能力扩展到语言-视频-动作建模。为更好地扩展模型，我们进一步对联合训练配方和模型架构进行详细研究。在固定训练预算下，混合第一人称视频和UMI演示可改善控制泛化。模型架构影响这些经验被利用的有效程度，而在所选配置下扩展预训练带来进一步收益。最终配方仅在RoboTwin Clean演示上进行后训练，在Easy（Clean-to-Clean）和Hard（Clean-to-Random）条件下分别达到88.10%和61.56%的成功率。我们的模型在三个真实世界任务上达到40.00% SR，而最强基线为23.33%，表明在未见条件下具有更好的泛化能力。我们发布整理的数据、训练代码和模型权重。

items.title_en: Influence of the branching geometry on SPION propagation: coupling of experiment and simulation
items.title_zh: 分支几何结构对SPION传播的影响：实验与模拟的耦合
items.abstract_en: Magnetic Drug Targeting (MDT) is an emerging therapeutic concept in cancer medicine, where superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs) are used as carriers for medication. Their magnetic properties allow for the manipulation of particle transport within the vascular structure and thus targeted delivery to the tumor site. To develop effective concepts for particle steering and accumulation, a detailed understanding of the particle--flow interaction, especially at asymmetric vascular bifurcations, is needed. Based on hierarchical scaling laws, generalized bifurcation geometries with varying degrees of asymmetry were derived and additively manufactured. The particle distribution was investigated by in situ optical measurements under different flow conditions and magnetic field configurations and compared with Lagrangian particle and Volume of Fluid Simulations (VoFS). While the particle mass partition followed the hydraulic flow split in asymmetric bifurcations, density-driven stratification dominated in the symmetric bifurcation, where one daughter branch received only a minor fraction of the particle mass at low flow rates despite carrying half of the flow. The Lagrangian model reproduced the predominantly advective propagation, whereas only the VoFS approach captured the stratification-induced asymmetry. Magnetic actuation counteracted the stratification, reversed the passive branch preference and increased particle retention. From a molecular communication perspective, bifurcation geometry, collective volume effects and magnetic actuation thus jointly determine the received particle signal at vascular bifurcations.
items.abstract_zh: 磁药物靶向（MDT）是癌症医学中一种新兴的治疗概念，其中超顺磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒（SPION）被用作药物载体。其磁性允许在血管结构内操纵颗粒传输，从而靶向递送至肿瘤部位。为开发有效的颗粒操控与积聚方案，需要详细理解颗粒-流动相互作用，尤其是在不对称血管分叉处。基于分层缩放定律，推导并增材制造了具有不同不对称程度的广义分叉几何结构。通过原位光学测量在不同流动条件和磁场配置下研究颗粒分布，并与拉格朗日颗粒模拟和流体体积模拟（VoFS）进行比较。在不对称分叉中，颗粒质量分配遵循水力流动分流；而在对称分叉中，密度驱动的分层占主导，在低流速下，一个子分支尽管承载一半流量，却只接收很小一部分颗粒质量。拉格朗日模型再现了以平流为主的传播，而只有VoFS方法捕捉到分层引起的不对称。磁驱动抵消了分层，逆转了被动分支偏好并增加了颗粒滞留。从分子通信角度看，分叉几何、集体体积效应和磁驱动因此共同决定血管分叉处接收到的颗粒信号。

items.title_en: Physics-informed Bayesian optimization of high-order harmonic generation in gases
items.title_zh: 气体中高次谐波产生的物理信息贝叶斯优化
items.abstract_en: Optimization of high-order harmonic generation in gases is essential for attosecond science. Improving conversion efficiency from the infrared driving laser to the extreme-ultraviolet high-order harmonic radiation requires balancing microscopic single-atom dipole responses with macroscopic phase matching. The resulting conversion-efficiency landscape exhibits complex structures, such as the hyperbolic ridge in the pressure-length space, which can be difficult to accurately reconstruct using conventional Bayesian optimization. Here, we introduce a physics-informed Bayesian optimization framework that incorporates known physical scaling relations through nonlinear transformations of the search space. We first demonstrate the approach in the two-dimensional pressure-length space, where a direct grid scan enables detailed validation of the reconstructed landscape, before extending it to four dimensions, where exhaustive scanning becomes computationally impractical. In four dimensions, incorporating the pulse-duration scaling and a square-root transformation of conversion efficiency further improves the accuracy of the reconstructed landscape, as validated against an independent reference dataset. We also employ a threshold-based acquisition strategy to identify extended high-efficiency operating regions rather than isolated optimal points. Together, these results demonstrate that incorporating physical knowledge into Bayesian optimization improves the exploration and reconstruction of multidimensional high-order harmonic generation landscapes, extending its capabilities beyond locating individual optima.
items.abstract_zh: 气体中高次谐波产生的优化对阿秒科学至关重要。提高从红外驱动激光到极紫外高次谐波辐射的转换效率，需要平衡微观单原子偶极响应与宏观相位匹配。由此产生的转换效率景观呈现复杂结构，例如压力-长度空间中的双曲脊，使用传统贝叶斯优化难以准确重建。在此，我们引入一个物理信息贝叶斯优化框架，通过对搜索空间进行非线性变换来纳入已知的物理缩放关系。我们首先在二维压力-长度空间中演示该方法，其中直接网格扫描可对重建景观进行详细验证，然后扩展到四维，在四维中穷举扫描在计算上变得不可行。在四维中，纳入脉冲持续时间缩放和转换效率的平方根变换进一步提高了重建景观的准确性，并已通过独立参考数据集验证。我们还采用基于阈值的采集策略来识别扩展的高效运行区域，而不是孤立的最优点。总之，这些结果表明，将物理知识纳入贝叶斯优化可改善多维高次谐波产生景观的探索和重建，使其能力超越定位单个最优值。

items.title_en: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
items.title_zh: Pyrite：构建与评测蛋白质-配体构象排序智能体
items.abstract_en: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.
items.abstract_zh: 预测配体如何与靶点结合是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠（cofolding）模型能生成多种候选构象，但可靠地对这些候选排序仍很困难。我们提出 Pyrite，一个成对构象排序基准，包含跨多种蛋白质-配体复合物的 1,500 对构象。配备三维可视化工具与基于物理的分数的专家化学家表现接近随机，说明可用化学信号难以解读。为研究自动排序，我们提出 PyriteRep——对分子几何、蛋白-配体相互作用与物理化学分数的结构化表示，并开发了两个基于 LLM 的智能体：PyriteReasoner 通过文本推理直接比较构象；PyriteFeaturizer 生成可执行代码来构造特征供逻辑回归使用，并可选择性融入由 LLM 子调用导出的特征。两者准确率最高分别达 67% 和 74%，超过观察到的专家表现。LLM 引导的特征发现在总体上优于直接推理，而 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）能提升开放权重模型，使其在本文评测中追平甚至超越闭源前沿模型。这些结果确立了 Pyrite 作为构象排序能力的艰难测试，并凸显 LLM 引导的特征发现是解读与组合计算化学工具输出的有前景途径。
items.highlight_zh: LLM 智能体做配体构象排序准确率达 74%，超过人类化学家
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：在计算机辅助药物设计中，模型能生成很多“配体放在蛋白口袋里的可能姿态”，但要从这些候选中挑出最接近真实结合方式的那一个非常难。人类专家面对成对比较（A 与 B 哪个更合理）究竟能做到多好？机器能否做得更好？
方法：作者构建 Pyrite 基准，包含 1,500 对蛋白质-配体构象，覆盖多种复合物。先让配备三维可视化与基于物理打分的化学家做二选一，结果接近随机，说明现有化学信号并不好读。随后提出结构化表示 PyriteRep，把分子几何、相互作用和物理化学分数组织起来，并搭建两个基于 LLM 的智能体：PyriteReasoner 用文字推理直接比较两个构象；PyriteFeaturizer 则写代码把表示转成特征，交给逻辑回归分类，还可调用 LLM 生成额外特征。训练侧使用 GRPO 强化学习改进开放权重模型。
结果：两者的二选一准确率最高分别为 67% 与 74%，高于实验中人类专家的水平；总体看“让 LLM 指导特征发现”比“让 LLM 直接推理”更有效；经 GRPO 优化后，开源模型可追平甚至超过闭源前沿模型。
意义：这不仅给出了一个区分度高的新基准，也说明把 LLM 用作“特征工程师”而非“答题者”，更有助于解释和融合传统计算化学工具的分数，为构象筛选提供了新范式。

items.title_en: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
items.title_zh: Infrathon：面向真实世界长时程AI基础设施优化的语言智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.
items.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究前沿智能体是否能够在长时程内持续改进真实世界AI基础设施。我们引入Infrathon，一个包含不同层次多样化长时程AI基础设施优化任务的基准。我们在24小时预算下评估了六个模型共150次运行，总计超过10,000 GPU小时。我们的结果表明，模型排名随评估时程变化，而150次运行中有135次在其预算的后半段取得进一步改进。这些发现表明，较短的评估可能同时忽略优化收益和相对模型性能的变化。我们还发现智能体能够发现优于人工设计基线的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5将平均KV缓存压缩比从人工设计的Quant-VideoGen编解码器的6.82%提高到19.86%。对智能体轨迹的分析将任务违规、不可靠测试和过早完成识别为持续改进的障碍。总之，我们的Infrathon框架为构建长时程任务、评估前沿智能体和发现良好基础设施解决方案提供了资源。

items.title_en: DexSeed: Expanding Human Hand-Object Interactions into Robot Demonstrations for Dexterous Policy Learning
items.title_zh: DexSeed：将人手-物体交互扩展为机器人演示以进行灵巧策略学习
items.abstract_en: We study how to generate diverse, physically executable robot demonstrations for dexterous vision-language-action (VLA) learning. Existing demonstration-generation methods typically rely on costly teleoperated examples. Meanwhile, human hand--object datasets provide a reusable source, but existing transfer methods mainly reproduce given interactions. Turning these interactions into VLA training data further requires coverage of different objects and manipulation locations, together with executable arm and finger actions, and visual observations. To achieve this, we present DexSeed, a framework for low-cost generation of dexterous robot data from human hand--object interactions. Our key idea is to expand human sequences while preserving their grasps and realizing the resulting motions under arm-tracking dynamics in physics simulation. Specifically, we organize source sequences by grasp mode with shared language descriptions. InteractionMesh-based retargeting and arm trajectory augmentation adapt these sequences to the robot hand, different object geometries, and pick-and-place locations while preserving local hand--object relationships. An RL finger-control policy produces executable rollouts, while the arm tracks precomputed trajectories. Rendered observations and recorded actions from successful rollouts are paired with grasp descriptions to fine-tune a VLA. Experiments show improved contact fidelity in retargeting and more reliable whole-arm execution than the evaluated baselines. Simulation evaluation and real-world deployment further demonstrate that a VLA fine-tuned solely on the generated demonstrations can execute language-specified grasps. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/DexSeed/.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究如何为灵巧视觉-语言-动作（VLA）学习生成多样化、可物理执行的机器人演示。现有的演示生成方法通常依赖昂贵的遥操作示例。与此同时，人手-物体数据集提供了可复用来源，但现有迁移方法主要复现给定交互。将这些交互转化为VLA训练数据进一步需要覆盖不同物体和操作位置，以及可执行的手臂和手指动作与视觉观测。为实现这一点，我们提出DexSeed，一个从人手-物体交互低成本生成灵巧机器人数据的框架。我们的关键思想是扩展人类序列，同时保留其抓取，并在物理模拟中于手臂跟踪动力学下实现所得运动。具体地，我们按抓取模式组织源序列，并共享语言描述。基于InteractionMesh的重定向和手臂轨迹增强使这些序列适应机器人手、不同物体几何结构和拾放位置，同时保留局部手-物体关系。RL手指控制策略产生可执行展开，而手臂跟踪预计算轨迹。来自成功展开的渲染观测和记录动作与抓取描述配对，以微调VLA。实验表明，重定向中的接触保真度得到改善，且全臂执行比所评估的基线更可靠。模拟评估和真实世界部署进一步证明，仅使用生成演示微调的VLA能够执行语言指定的抓取。项目页面：https://robbyant-research.github.io/DexSeed/。

items.title_en: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
items.title_zh: dNaViT：离散码是通用视觉表示
items.abstract_en: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.
items.abstract_zh: 离散自回归建模，尤其是通过下一词元预测，已成为现代语言模型的基石。将该范式扩展到视觉，可使视觉模型与语言模型汇聚到统一框架，从而促进共享的方法与基础设施。本工作研究一个核心问题：有限离散词表在表示视觉世界丰富性方面能达到什么程度？我们提出 dNaViT，一种离散原生分辨率视觉 Transformer，可生成类似于语言词元的离散视觉基元。dNaViT 构建于冻结的预训练编码器之上，采用轻量残差调制与双分支目标，将重建感知线索注入语义特征。通过利用分组乘积量化，它可在不膨胀空间序列长度的情况下扩展离散容量，而平衡的训练配方同时保持语义与像素级信息。因此，dNaViT 可作为通用的离散视觉分词器，在下游任务中实现统一编码，并支持高保真图像解码。大量评估表明，dNaViT 在 12 个视觉理解基准、4 个生成基准和一个图像编辑基准上达到或超过任务特定基线。这些发现表明，紧凑的离散词表可作为通用视觉货币，并释放完全统一的原生多模态方法的全部潜力。

items.title_en: EvoSurv: Evolution-Aware Multimodal Survival Modeling Reveals Complementary Prognostic Signals
items.title_zh: EvoSurv：进化感知的多模态生存建模揭示互补预后信号
items.abstract_en: Accurate cancer survival prediction remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity. Although multimodal survival models integrate clinical and molecular data, they often overlook evolutionary information encoded in genomic alterations. To address this gap, we developed eTime, a 38-dimensional evolutionary representation comprising eight feature groups that characterize clonal and subclonal mutation burden, mutational spectra, functional consequences, copy-number alterations, and anoikis-related genomic changes. We further developed EvoSurv, a multimodal survival framework integrating eTime with clinical variables and RNA expression. Across six TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,782 patients, EvoSurv achieved the highest mean concordance index (C-index) in all six cancers, averaging 0.663 and outperforming three state-of-the-art survival prediction methods. More importantly, we assessed whether evolutionary features provide additional prognostic information beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors. eTime remained significantly associated with survival in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSC) and liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) after adjustment for clinical variables and RNA-derived risk scores. Feature-group analyses further revealed cancer-specific prognostic patterns. In HNSC, T>G substitutions were associated with increased mortality risk after clinical and molecular adjustment, including in HPV-negative patients, with supporting evidence from an independent CPTAC-HNSCC cohort. Overall, these findings demonstrate that eTime captures survival-associated evolutionary information and highlight its potential to provide prognostic value beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors.
items.abstract_zh: 由于肿瘤异质性，准确的癌症生存预测仍具挑战性。尽管多模态生存模型整合了临床与分子数据，但它们常忽略基因组改变所编码的进化信息。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了 eTime，一种 38 维进化表示，由八个特征组构成，刻画克隆与亚克隆突变负荷、突变谱、功能后果、拷贝数改变以及与失巢凋亡相关的基因组变化。我们进一步开发了 EvoSurv，一种将 eTime 与临床变量和 RNA 表达整合的多模态生存框架。在包含 2,782 名患者的六个 TCGA 癌症队列中，EvoSurv 在全部六种癌症中取得最高的平均一致性指数（C-index），平均为 0.663，并优于三种最先进的生存预测方法。更重要的是，我们评估了进化特征是否在临床和转录组预测因子之外提供额外预后信息。在对临床变量和 RNA 衍生风险评分进行调整后，eTime 在头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSC）和肝细胞癌（LIHC）中仍与生存显著相关。特征组分析进一步揭示了癌症特异性预后模式。在 HNSC 中，T>G 替换在临床和分子调整后与死亡风险增加相关，包括在 HPV 阴性患者中，并得到独立 CPTAC-HNSCC 队列的支持证据。总体而言，这些发现表明 eTime 捕获了与生存相关的进化信息，并强调其提供超越临床和转录组预测因子的预后价值的潜力。

items.title_en: SGAA: Independent active alignment of optical subgroups with uncompensated aberrations
items.title_zh: SGAA：具有未补偿像差的光学子组独立主动对准
items.abstract_en: Uncompensated subgroup aberrations complicate subgroup-level active alignment (AA), as local image-quality extrema do not directly indicate the target alignment state. We propose SGAA, an image-learning-based method for independent active alignment of optical subgroups. Multi-field point spread functions (PSFs) from a dedicated test configuration characterize misalignment, while golden-sample reference calibration and unified regression predict adjustments toward a common optical target across toleranced specimens. In simulations with tolerances, one step reduced the mean differential wavefront RMS from $0.0592λ$ to $0.0086λ$, an 85.4% reduction. In alignment experiments on 100 production subgroups, SGAA increased the mean full-lens weighted modulation transfer function (WMTF) at 30, 50, and 80 lp/mm by 0.073, 0.065, and 0.040, respectively, relative to industrial MTF-based scanning. The 8 MP acceptance yield increased by 29.2 percentage points, and mean alignment time decreased from 43 s to 3.1 s. SGAA thus translates independent subgroup reference-state restoration into gains in full-lens imaging, acceptance yield, and alignment speed.
items.abstract_zh: 未补偿的子组像差使子组级主动对准（AA）复杂化，因为局部图像质量极值并不直接指示目标对准状态。我们提出 SGAA，一种基于图像学习的光学子组独立主动对准方法。来自专用测试配置的多视场点扩散函数（PSF）表征失准，而金样参考标定与统一回归预测朝向共同光学目标的调整，适用于带公差的样本。在带公差的仿真中，一步将平均差分波前 RMS 从 0.0592λ 降至 0.0086λ，降低 85.4%。在对 100 个生产子组的对准实验中，相对于基于工业 MTF 的扫描，SGAA 将 30、50 和 80 lp/mm 处的平均全镜头加权调制传递函数（WMTF）分别提高 0.073、0.065 和 0.040。8 MP 验收良率提高 29.2 个百分点，平均对准时间从 43 s 降至 3.1 s。因此，SGAA 将独立子组参考状态恢复转化为全镜头成像、验收良率和对准速度方面的增益。

items.title_en: Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths
items.title_zh: 学习用于天蛾多模态主动感知的可操作信息景观
items.abstract_en: Animals integrate information across sensory modalities to guide exploration, suggesting that they maintain internal estimates of where actions are expected to reduce uncertainty. However, how such action-conditioned information maps are learned from multimodal sensory experience remains unclear, as previous studies have been largely confined to unimodal sensing frameworks. We introduce a multimodal predictive-coding framework for learning uncertainty-reduction maps from visual and mechanosensory observations in hawkmoth flower interaction tasks. A variational generative model trained on simulated environments recovers modality-specific information landscapes over the action space, capturing how visual patterns, surface geometry, and mechanosensory cues shape the value of exploratory actions. These learned maps are consistent with several features of hawkmoth behavior, including nonzero tracking offsets, probing along visual patterns, and geometry-dependent exploration. Applying the model to behavioral data from flower tracking and nectary search, we find that natural trajectories tend to occupy regions of high uncertainty reduction in these learned maps. Building on these observations, we develop an uncertainty-gated lexicographic algorithm that switches between information gathering and reward exploitation based on perceptual uncertainty. In nectary search, uncertainty gating improves learning relative to exploit-only, $ε$-greedy, fixed-time, and uncertainty-calibrated non-lexicographic controls, with better generalization and robustness to sensory and curvature shifts. These results link information landscapes learned through generative modeling to biological sensing and embodied exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 动物整合跨感官模态的信息来指导探索，这表明它们维持着关于哪些行动预期会降低不确定性的内部估计。然而，这种以行动为条件的信息图如何从多模态感官经验中学习仍不清楚，因为先前研究大多局限于单模态感知框架。我们引入一个多模态预测编码框架，用于从天蛾花朵交互任务中的视觉和机械感觉观测中学习不确定性降低图。一个在仿真环境中训练的变分生成模型在动作空间上恢复模态特定的信息景观，捕捉视觉模式、表面几何和机械感觉线索如何塑造探索性行动的价值。这些学习到的图与天蛾行为的若干特征一致，包括非零跟踪偏移、沿视觉模式探测以及依赖几何的探索。将该模型应用于花朵跟踪和蜜腺搜索的行为数据，我们发现自然轨迹倾向于占据这些学习图中不确定性降低高的区域。基于这些观察，我们开发了一种不确定性门控的词典序算法，根据感知不确定性在信息收集与奖励利用之间切换。在蜜腺搜索中，相对于仅利用、ε-贪心、固定时间和不确定性校准的非词典序对照，不确定性门控改善了学习，并具有更好的泛化性和对感官与曲率变化的鲁棒性。这些结果将通过生成建模学习到的信息景观与生物感知和具身探索联系起来。

items.title_en: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
items.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 的语言模型中 inside-outside 计算的分阶段且可解释的涌现
items.abstract_en: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.
items.abstract_zh: 句法结构中的变异性和解析歧义是自然语言的基本方面，现代 LLM 必须学会熟练处理。此前的“事后”研究表明，完全训练的 Transformer 确实近似于 inside-outside 等规范解析算法，但关于这实际上是如何被学习到的，理论上少有确立。在这里，我们通过研究具有可变解析树拓扑的合成上下文无关文法中的学习动态，迈出解决该问题的第一步。分阶段学习曲线是完全可解释的，因为所有损失阶段 a) 都可以解析计算，并且 b) 都能清楚地与隐藏潜在树变量的表示相关联，从而允许消除歧义并利用更广上下文的信息。通过探测表示，我们可视化了 inside-outside 计算在深度上和训练过程中的涌现：在早期阶段使用局部（二元/三元）信息且仅涉及少数初始层，逐渐地 Transformer 发展出编码器-解码器结构，其中最抽象的潜在信息在中间编码，而后半部分网络用于逐步精化最终词元预测。这种计算组织让人联想到真实世界 LLM 中的发现，并且重要的是，此处适用于一个合成模型，该模型允许对数据统计进行完全解析控制，从而为理论进展打开大门。

items.title_en: A computational framework for understanding embodied plans
items.title_zh: 理解具身计划的计算框架
items.abstract_en: Reasoning about people's plans and goals based on their actions is fundamental to human social interaction and essential for cooperative, embodied artificial intelligence. Formalizing this capacity in naturalistic, embodied settings has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we present GenEA, a novel agent representation capable of reasoning over multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans. At the heart of GenEA lies a multilevel state-space that couples the coarse biomechanics of an articulated body and its interactions with nearby objects by extending the task-and-motion planning framework from robotics with simulation-based intuitive physics. By embedding this state-space in a generative model, GenEA yields a joint probability distribution over goals and embodied plans. Across several experiments spanning the qualitatively distinct domains of object manipulation and navigation, featuring diverse tasks and multiple behavioral measures, we show that GenEA, through simple transformations of this joint distribution, recapitulates how humans reason about embodied plans. Crucially, GenEA consistently outperforms strong alternative models, including plausible heuristics, standard task-and-motion planning, and a state-of-the-art vision-language model. GenEA thereby offers a new perspective on the architecture of human reasoning and social cognition, suggesting that embodied artificial intelligence systems seeking to seamlessly interact with humans should adopt GenEA-like generative models of action planning.
items.abstract_zh: 基于人们的行动推理其计划和目标是人类社会互动的基础，并且对于协作式具身人工智能至关重要。在自然主义的具身环境中形式化这种能力一直是一个长期挑战。在这里，我们提出 GenEA，一种能够对多步骤、长时域具身计划进行推理的新型智能体表示。GenEA 的核心是一个多层级状态空间，它通过将机器人学中的任务与运动规划框架扩展为基于仿真的直觉物理学，将铰接身体的粗粒度生物力学及其与附近物体的交互耦合起来。通过将该状态空间嵌入生成模型，GenEA 产生目标和具身计划的联合概率分布。在跨越物体操作和导航这两个性质不同领域、包含多样任务和多种行为指标的若干实验中，我们表明 GenEA 通过该联合分布的简单变换，再现了人类如何推理具身计划。关键的是，GenEA 始终优于强替代模型，包括合理的启发式、标准任务与运动规划以及最先进的视觉语言模型。因此，GenEA 为人类推理和社会认知的架构提供了新视角，表明寻求与人类无缝交互的具身人工智能系统应采用类似 GenEA 的行动规划生成模型。

items.title_en: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
items.title_zh: PhysOPSD：以代码作为特权实现物理上合理的视频生成
items.abstract_en: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管现代视频生成模型实现了显著的视觉保真度，但在生成物理上合理的动力学和复杂交互时仍明显脆弱。有针对性的后训练至关重要，然而监督微调受困于离线状态失配，强化学习则受制于稀疏、定义不良的物理奖励函数。同策略（自）蒸馏（OPSD）将同策略 rollout 与稠密纠正反馈相协调，将核心挑战转移到设计有效的特权上下文。然而，传统模态存在不足：文本提示本质上是陈述性的，而真实参考视频将物理规律与视觉外观严重纠缠，且没有参数化控制。为此，我们提出 PhysOPSD，引入可执行代码作为视频生成的特权物理上下文。与静态视觉观测不同，可执行代码实例化了一个可编辑的物理世界，具有内在的抽象性和可控性。借助 PhysOPSD-Engine，我们将真实世界物理场景转化为可验证的仿真程序。PhysOPSD 随后结合：(i) 双层物理特权，通过中间瓶颈弥合信息差距；(ii) 在共享 rollout 噪声下的受控物理变化，以暴露因果动力学变化。大量实验表明，PhysOPSD 在多种骨干网络上大幅提升物理合理性，仅用 3K 样本就优于 SFT 和 RL 基线，同时保持通用视频生成质量。

items.title_en: Experimental Evidence of Cellular Sparing under Single-Pulse Picosecond Irradiation at Extreme Dose Rates
items.title_zh: 极端剂量率下单脉冲皮秒辐照细胞保护效应的实验证据
items.abstract_en: Understanding how biological cells respond to radiation delivered on extremely short timescales is central to resolving the fundamental mechanisms underlying radiotherapy and to defining new regimes of radiobiology. Experimentally accessing these earliest stages of physicochemical response is crucial to benchmark current numerical codes, whose predictions are known to vary substantially with under-constrained early-stage parameters. Using a laser-driven electron source, tunable doses up to 8Gy were delivered to normal and cancer human cell lines, in single pulses of picosecond-scale duration at mean dose rates above 10^10 Gy/s. Clonogenic survival assays and 53BP1 foci formation were compared with conventional X-ray irradiation at 2.4Gy/min. Surviving fractions are found to be comparable to conventional irradiation at doses up to 3Gy. At higher doses, however, all cell lines exhibited a consistent increase in surviving fraction, corresponding to an average RBE at 10% survival of 0.84+/-0.05. This sparing effect is associated with a statistically significant reduction in the beta parameter of the linear-quadratic model, indicating reduced cell killing from accumulated sub-lethal damage. Picosecond irradiation also produced a marked reduction in prompt 53BP1 foci, but no significant difference in residual foci at 24h and foci-size distributions. These results provide the first experimental evidence of cellular sparing following single-pulse picosecond-scale irradiation. Direct comparison with recent work at femtosecond timescales suggests the presence of a previously undetected sharp transition in biological response at the femtosecond/picosecond interface, giving critical insight on the possible mechanisms responsible for this differential response.
items.abstract_zh: 理解生物细胞如何响应极短时间尺度上递送的辐射，是解决放射治疗基本机制以及定义放射生物学新区域的核心。实验上获取这些最早的物理化学响应阶段对于基准测试当前数值代码至关重要，这些代码的预测已知会随约束不足的早期阶段参数而显著变化。使用激光驱动电子源，向正常和癌症人类细胞系递送可调剂量至 8 Gy，单脉冲持续时间为皮秒量级，平均剂量率超过 10^10 Gy/s。将克隆形成存活实验和 53BP1 焦点形成与 2.4 Gy/min 的传统 X 射线辐照进行比较。发现在剂量高达 3 Gy 时，存活分数与传统辐照相当。然而在更高剂量下，所有细胞系均表现出一致的存活分数增加，对应于 10% 存活时的平均 RBE 为 0.84±0.05。这种保护效应与线性二次模型中 beta 参数的统计显著降低相关，表明累积亚致死损伤导致的细胞杀伤减少。皮秒辐照还显著减少了即时 53BP1 焦点，但在 24 小时残余焦点和焦点大小分布上无显著差异。这些结果提供了单脉冲皮秒尺度辐照后细胞保护效应的首个实验证据。与近期飞秒时间尺度工作的直接比较表明，在飞秒/皮秒界面存在一个此前未被检测到的生物响应急剧转变，为导致这种差异响应的可能机制提供了关键见解。

items.title_en: Additively manufactured ceramic platforms for miniaturized optical frequency references and robust atomic sensor systems
items.title_zh: 用于小型化光学频率参考和稳健原子传感器系统的增材制造陶瓷平台
items.abstract_en: Transferring atomic quantum sensors from laboratory-scale physics packages to compact, alignment-free sensor heads suitable for field and space deployment requires a structural platform that combines mechanical, thermal, and optical functionality within a single, manufacturable component. We present such a platform based on additively manufactured technical ceramics: lithography-based ceramic manufacturing is used to fabricate monolithic micro-optical benches with application-specific mounting geometries, while high-precision active alignment and adhesive bonding realize long-term stable optical assemblies through micro-integration. As a first system-level demonstrator, we present a micro-integrated optical frequency reference based on Doppler-free spectroscopy of the rubidium D2 line, integrated within a 6 mL Al2O3 module. A laser stabilized to the reference reaches a fractional frequency instability of $3\times10^{-12}$ at 1 s. We extend the platform to a compact optically pumped magnetometer, exploiting the magnetic cleanliness and tailored thermal properties of high-purity ceramics for a 7 mL sensor head with picotesla sensitivity aimed at space-borne biomagnetometry, and to a micro-integrated optical dipole trap with active MEMS-mirror beam steering for cold-atom manipulation. Together, these demonstrators show that ceramic additive manufacturing and optical micro-integration form a versatile, robust platform for compact atomic sensor systems in field and space applications.
items.abstract_zh: 将原子量子传感器从实验室规模的物理封装转移到适合现场和太空部署的紧凑、免对准传感器头，需要一个在单一可制造组件中结合机械、热和光学功能的结构平台。我们提出了这样一个基于增材制造技术陶瓷的平台：采用基于光刻的陶瓷制造来制造具有应用特定安装几何形状的整体式微光学平台，同时通过微集成实现高精度主动对准和粘合键合，实现长期稳定的光学组件。作为首个系统级演示器，我们展示了一个基于铷 D2 线无多普勒光谱的微集成光学频率参考，集成在 6 mL 的 Al2O3 模块内。稳定到该参考的激光在 1 s 时达到 3×10^-12 的分数频率不稳定度。我们将该平台扩展到紧凑型光泵磁力计，利用高纯陶瓷的磁洁净性和定制热特性，实现 7 mL 传感器头，具有皮特斯拉灵敏度，面向星载生物磁测量；并扩展到具有主动 MEMS 反射镜光束转向的微集成光学偶极阱，用于冷原子操控。这些演示器共同表明，陶瓷增材制造和光学微集成构成了一个通用、稳健的平台，适用于现场和太空应用中的紧凑原子传感器系统。
