items.title_en: When Does the Real Wiring Win? Testing connectome structure-function claims against unmeasured physiology
items.title_zh: 真实连接组何时胜出？用未测量的生理学检验连接组结构-功能主张
items.abstract_en: Connectome-constrained models are often used to argue that a measured wiring diagram outperforms shuffled or rewired wiring, and hence that structure shapes function. Such comparisons can confound wiring with how the models are tuned: a connectome fixes who connects to whom, not the excitability, gains or plasticity rates the model also needs, and modellers often tune these until the real-wiring model works. We separate three estimands: physiology tuned on the real wiring and transferred to nulls (P1), each wiring tuned on its own (P2), and P2 restricted to physiology consistent with independent data (P3). The biases involved are known in machine learning (under-tuned baselines, inherited weights, winner's curse); we measure what they do to biological conclusions, using synthetic ground truth, placebo nulls and three Drosophila circuit models. Some claims survive every protocol we test: segregated reward and punishment dopamine improves learning, and head-direction topography is required for a persistent bump. Others do not. In the mushroom body, the real Kenyon-cell output wiring beats a cross-subtype identity shuffle by 0.09 under P1 and P2 but loses to it by 0.09 under P3 (95% CIs exclude zero; held-out runs confirm). The verdict is set by the share of alpha'beta' cells among active Kenyon cells, which P1 selects low; at the share implied by imaging (about 44%) the real-wiring model fails to learn, exposing a model inadequacy rather than a deficit of the fly's wiring. In flyvis, P1 penalises a mirrored connectome, which has a constructed solution within 0.07 (median) of the real error, more than a spatially shuffled one in 50 of 50 members; the ranking survives ten-fold longer retraining but depends on the checkpoint at fifty-fold. A credible structural claim needs matched optimisation, data-constrained physiology and a model that still works there.
items.abstract_zh: 连接组约束模型常被用来论证测量的连接图优于打乱或重连的连接图，从而结构塑造功能。此类比较可能将连接与模型的调参方式混淆：连接组固定了谁与谁连接，但不固定模型同样需要的兴奋性、增益或可塑性速率，建模者常调整这些直到真实连接模型有效。我们区分三种估计量：在真实连接上调整并迁移到空模型的生理学（P1）、每种连接各自调参（P2），以及限制为与独立数据一致的生理学的 P2（P3）。所涉及的偏差在机器学习中已知（调参不足的基线、继承权重、获胜者诅咒）；我们使用合成真值、安慰剂空模型和三个果蝇回路模型测量它们对生物学结论的影响。一些主张在我们测试的每种协议下都成立：分离的奖赏和惩罚多巴胺改善学习，头方向地形图是持续凸起所必需的。其他则不成立。在蘑菇体中，真实 Kenyon 细胞输出连接在 P1 和 P2 下比跨亚型身份打乱高 0.09，但在 P3 下比其低 0.09（95% CI 排除零；留出运行确认）。裁决由活跃 Kenyon 细胞中 alpha'beta' 细胞的比例决定，P1 将其选得低；在成像暗示的比例（约 44%）下，真实连接模型无法学习，暴露出模型不足而非果蝇连接缺陷。在 flyvis 中，P1 惩罚镜像连接组，其构造解与真实误差相差在 0.07（中位数）以内，在 50 个成员中的 50 个里超过空间打乱的连接组；该排名在十倍更长的再训练后仍成立，但取决于五十倍时的检查点。可信的结构主张需要匹配的优化、数据约束的生理学，以及在那里仍然有效的模型。

items.title_en: MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
items.title_zh: MISO-BR：巴西葡萄牙语厌女检测开放语料库
items.abstract_en: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 厌女是针对性巴西用户的最普遍在线仇恨言论形式之一，但专门针对巴西葡萄牙语的开放且可审计的资源仍然稀缺。我们推出 MISO-BR，一个开放、有文档且版本化的语料库，包含 896 条平衡的社交媒体文本，标注二元厌女标签，并发布其构建协议和可复现基线。该语料库结合了来自 X 的词典和目标引导抓取、从 OLID-BR 导入的条目、一个大型语言模型分诊阶段（其提示和解码参数已发布），以及三名标注者按照书面指南进行的人工标注。标注者间信度在 816 个条目上达到 Fleiss' kappa 0.788。在单一固定协议下，我们将四种经典分类器（多项式和伯努利朴素贝叶斯、线性 SVM 和随机森林）与微调的 BERTimbau Base 和 Large 进行比较。经典模型的宏 F1 聚集在 0.651 到 0.676 之间，偏向精确率但召回率低。Transformer 达到 0.833 宏 F1 和准确率（准确率的 Wilson 95% CI [0.77, 0.88]），差距约 16 个百分点，而 Base 和 Large 在测试集上不可区分，尽管训练成本相差 2.6 倍。我们认为该资源的价值不在于其头条分数，而在于其流程的可审计性，并说明用户必须考虑的三种局限：人工类别平衡（我们量化其对现实流行率下精确率的影响）；来源与标签之间的关联（发布的源字段使其可测量）；以及词典引导采样和自动分诊引入的选择偏差。语料库、标注指南、模型和实验脚本公开可用。

items.title_en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: 学习异构触觉表征以实现通用灵巧操作
items.abstract_en: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
items.abstract_zh: 触觉感知是接触丰富灵巧操作不可或缺的模态，这一能力指向具身智能的终极前沿。然而，商用触觉传感器仍处于相对早期的发展阶段，每种传感器都提供不可替代的优势以及自身缺点。因此，一个关键挑战是将触觉理解从传感器特定物理中解放出来，使具身模型能够有效利用异构触觉数据。为此，我们开发了 LingBot-Touch，一个具有以下特性的触觉基础模型。(i) 我们的模型在不同触觉传感器（即压阻式、磁性和视觉触觉传感器）之间产生统一表征，并易于扩展到新传感器类型。(ii) 所得的触觉 token 即插即用：它们可以无缝集成到跨范式的策略模型中，从扩散策略到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型如 π_{0.5} 和 LingBot-VLA，持续增强操作灵巧性。(iii) 跨多个硬件平台的仿真和真实机器人部署的大量实验表明，我们的触觉表征在保持强大计算效率的同时，大幅有益于复杂操作任务。我们相信本工作的发现展示了利用跨传感器数据扩展触觉学习的潜力，并为未来硬件和具身模型的设计提供了令人鼓舞的见解。

items.title_en: OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
items.title_zh: OnlyAct：从基础模型中提取用于世界模型的动作表示
items.abstract_en: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.
items.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型有望成为通用交互式模拟器，但其训练受限于动作监督：动作标签稀缺、分散于互不兼容的规范中，且无法随未标注视频预训练语料扩展。一种常见变通方法是联合训练动作编码器，将连续帧压缩为潜在动作，并训练解码器从上一帧和该潜在动作重建下一帧，迫使潜在动作仅捕获新信息。这有两个局限：从头学习动作空间可能限制对未见域的泛化；瓶颈以表达性换取分离性，更紧的设置会丢失细微信息，更松的设置则可能在域偏移下带来场景泄漏风险。我们主张不同的起点：不从零学习动作，而是从预训练基础模型（V-JEPA 2）出发，其帧对嵌入在大规模、多样化视频预训练后已携带大量动作信息。剩余挑战是在丢弃场景的同时提取动作。我们提出一种无标签对比自适应框架，将不同场景下具有相同运动的帧对拉近，并将同一场景下具有不同运动的帧对推开，在不施加重建瓶颈的情况下重塑预训练空间的几何结构。我们引入统一的评估协议，沿三个轴（动作表达性、场景不变性和动作条件视频生成质量）在机器人操作、相机导航、游戏和驾驶基准上评估，其中大多数在自适应期间未见。与无标注潜在动作方法相比，我们的表示表达性显著更强，同时达到与其相当的场景不变性，并且它们产生的世界模型能更忠实地将演示动作迁移到新场景。

items.title_en: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.abstract_en: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.
items.abstract_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及跨更广泛组织尺度的相互作用共同调控发育和再生过程中的分子状态转变与形态发生。时间分辨空间转录组学可同时分析基因表达和空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样不同细胞，导致中间轨迹和多尺度细胞间相互作用未被观测。在我们相互作用的平均场神经随机微分方程框架基础上，我们提出 stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），一种连续时间生成框架，可从非匹配时空快照推断耦合的分子、空间和增殖动力学。stMIND 将细胞表达速度向量/漂移分解为三个可解释算子：细胞内在程序；局部图差分注意力算子，其在协同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异和空间几何；以及非局部平均场注意力算子，其捕获超出紧邻邻域的长程群体上下文。通过随细胞迁移共同演化动态空间邻域，并强制内在漂移与相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND 在联合表达-位置空间中通过最优传输解析尺度特异的细胞间影响。在蝾螈和斑马鱼基准中，stMIND 在表达预测、解剖一致性和空间连贯性方面领先。消融实验证实了结合不相交的局部和非局部算子的必要性。它揭示了损伤后 10 至 15 天蝾螈端脑中的再生转变，伴随漂移能量激增，随后非局部主导和局部平衡，且在反应性室管膜胶质微环境中随细胞类型变化。它追踪了斑马鱼各阶段的发育向量场。

items.title_en: Analog quantum approximate optimization algorithm for solving the weighted MaxCut problem on three-dimensional single-atom Rydberg array
items.title_zh: 在三维单原子里德堡阵列上求解加权 MaxCut 问题的模拟量子近似优化算法
items.abstract_en: We theoretically investigate an analog implementation of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for the weighted maximum cut problem (MaxCut) problem. The protocol uses a three-dimensional array of individually trapped Rydberg atoms driven by globally addressed laser pulses, with site-dependent detunings applied near the Rydberg resonance. As benchmarks, we consider twenty randomly weighted 3-regular graphs with 12 vertices each. Problem weights are encoded directly in the interatomic interaction energies by choosing appropriate three-dimensional atom positions. We compare two parameter-optimization strategies: discretized quantum annealing and warm-start initialization using a graph neural network (GNN). The combined optimization strategy creates a portfolio that outperforms the Goemans-Williamson (GW) rounding almost in all instances in the noiseless case. We analyze the sampling statistics and the total pulse-time cost of both approaches. Finally, we emulate the performance of the optimized schedules on quantum trajectories using a realistic error model of the Aquila neutral-atom quantum processor.
items.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了用于加权最大割问题（MaxCut）的量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的模拟实现。该协议使用由全局寻址激光脉冲驱动的独立捕获里德堡原子的三维阵列，并在里德堡共振附近施加依赖于格点的失谐。作为基准，我们考虑二十个随机加权的 3-正则图，每个图有 12 个顶点。通过选择合适的原子三维位置，问题权重直接编码在原子间相互作用能中。我们比较两种参数优化策略：离散化量子退火和使用图神经网络（GNN）的热启动初始化。组合优化策略形成一种组合方案，在无噪声情况下几乎在所有实例上优于 Goemans-Williamson（GW）舍入。我们分析两种方法的采样统计和总脉冲时间成本。最后，我们使用 Aquila 中性原子量子处理器的真实误差模型，在量子轨迹上模拟优化调度的性能。

items.title_en: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
items.title_zh: 分子相互作用基础模型中涌现的生物学能力
items.abstract_en: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
items.abstract_zh: 在大型未标注语料上训练的基础模型会发展出涌现能力，即超出训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出 Bonbon，一个在约 3.2 万亿 token 的配对蛋白质-配体序列上训练的分子相互作用基础模型。Bonbon 从单一表示空间展现出三个层级分辨率上的零样本涌现能力：功能（作用机制）、残基（结合位点定位，包括正构/别构区分）和键（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力均泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon 仅使用蛋白质-配体序列训练，没有任何任务特定监督，也没有结构坐标。我们进行了受控缩放实验，涵盖从 4200 万到 16 亿参数的六个模型规模；在连续指标上，所评估的每种能力均在最大规模处出现急剧跃升，即使预训练损失平滑下降。这表明仅基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时出现。这里报告的能力在参数与 token 比为 1:2,000 的训练后涌现，以适配配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。相同的冻结表示在比共折叠方法快五个数量级的速度下实现最先进的结合和亲和力预测。在涵盖七个蛋白质家族的九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon 对从头化合物实现 61.5% 的剂量反应命中率，产生结构新颖的分子，这些分子此前未被报道可抑制这些蛋白质，包括分布外靶点。

items.title_en: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
items.title_zh: Sckwoky 在 SHROOM-Visions：通过双提示 LoRA 解码器在图像条件 VLM 中进行字符级幻觉片段检测
items.abstract_en: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了参加 SHROOM-visions 2026 共享任务的系统，该任务针对图像条件视觉语言模型（VLM）响应中的字符级幻觉片段检测，并在英语、法语、意大利语和中文上评估。检测器构建于冻结的 Gemma-4-12B-it 主干上，配有可训练 LoRA 适配器（约 1070 万参数）。由于主干是因果解码器，从答案的单一副本读取的隐藏状态无法关注后续 token；因此，我们在一个提示内重复候选答案，并从其第二次出现处提取特征，使每个位置在单次非自回归传递中获得近似双向上下文。字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率、BIO 边界和响应级弃权分数，而单独的语言特定分类器为每个预测片段分配五种幻觉类型之一。在封闭测试集上，我们的系统达到 0.4404 的宏平均字符 IoU，超过官方基线（0.1854）一倍以上，并在四种语言的 IoU 上排名第 5-6 位。在英语调优划分上，受控消融将增益归因于重复答案，其增益与 LoRA 自适应相当（其留出增益较小，且集中在幻觉答案上），并表明检测器依赖图像-答案配对：在示例间打乱图像会使每种语言的 IoU 降至预测为空的下限水平或以下。在由同一 Gemma-4-12B-it 模型也生成答案的部署中，其基础权重可复用，使该方法适用于无法运行单独验证器的本地问答系统。

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：用于动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM），用于包含动态对象的环境中的稠密建图。动态观测会污染视觉 SLAM（同时定位与建图）中的相机跟踪和场景重建。尽管 3DGS（三维高斯泼溅）能够实现高效稠密建图，但现有 3DGS-SLAM 系统在动态对象违反其底层静态场景假设时可能表现出不稳定性。排除动态观测可减少其对跟踪和建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束较弱。我们提出的 DPGS-SLAM 是一个单目 RGB SLAM 框架，通过异步基于扩散的背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表示。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和 SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，微调的扩散修复模型在被遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，而 Metric3D v2 从补全图像预测度量深度，以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元和观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变得可见时，移除符合条件的生成基元，并从真实 RGB 观测和预测深度独立初始化观测支持的基元。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在 TUM RGB-D 上平均 ATE RMSE 为 1.2 cm，在 BONN RGB-D 上为 2.7 cm。在 StaDy4D 上，DPGS-SLAM 仅使用单目 RGB 输入，就将平均 PSNR 比 WildGS-SLAM 提高了 4.60 dB。

items.title_en: Obscured Wildfire Flame Detection by Spatio-temporal Analysis of Smoke Patterns Using Frame-wise Transformers
items.title_zh: 利用逐帧Transformer对烟雾模式进行时空分析的被遮挡野火火焰检测
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm in wildfire management for detecting both visible and obscured fire using Deep Learning (DL). The essence of our method is the joint spatial and temporal analysis of RGB videos, embracing the fact that temporal patterns of smoke motions in consecutive video frames can indicate obscured fire flames. This perspective contrasts the traditional approach of independently analyzing images and individual video frames. To this end, we propose a frame-wise transformer architecture that applies an attention mechanism between the consecutive frames while preserving spatial information within frames as opposed to regular attention mechanisms like the non-local block, which combines spatial and temporal information into a single vector. We also optimize the temporal pattern lengths under different spatial resolutions to achieve the highest performance while reducing the computational cost. To investigate the applicability of our method in aerial image processing, we applied it to a curated version of the FLAME2 dataset that includes dual-mode RGB/IR videos. The IR video feed is used to extract ground truth, while the model is trained only on RGB videos to maintain applicability to lowcost commercial drones (which are equipped only with regular cameras) and facilitate processing existing RGB-only datasets. Our proposed method achieves a Segmentation Foreground Dice score of 92.61%, an Object Detection Precision and Recall rate of 93.21% and 91.73%, and clip-level classification accuracy of 98.02%, respectively. We also investigated the efficacy and generalizability of our method through ablation study
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种野火管理新范式，利用深度学习（DL）检测可见火和受遮挡火。我们方法的核心是对RGB视频进行联合空间与时间分析，接受连续视频帧中烟雾运动的时间模式可指示被遮挡火焰这一事实。这一视角与独立分析图像和单个视频帧的传统方法形成对比。为此，我们提出一种逐帧Transformer架构，在连续帧之间应用注意力机制，同时保留帧内空间信息，而不是像非局部块等常规注意力机制那样将空间和时间信息合并为单一向量。我们还优化不同空间分辨率下的时间模式长度，以在降低计算成本的同时实现最高性能。为探究本方法在航空图像处理中的适用性，我们将其应用于经整理的FLAME2数据集，该数据集包含双模态RGB/红外视频。红外视频流用于提取真值，而模型仅在RGB视频上训练，以保持对低成本商用无人机（仅配备普通相机）的适用性，并便于处理现有的仅RGB数据集。我们提出的方法分别达到92.61%的分割前景Dice分数、93.21%和91.73%的目标检测精确率与召回率，以及98.02%的片段级分类准确率。我们还通过消融研究考察了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

items.title_en: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞RNA测序数据细胞类型分类的突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）
items.abstract_en: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.
items.abstract_zh: 由于高维性、稀疏性以及转录上相似的细胞类型，单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性。我们开发了scDNM，它是对树突神经元模型的改进，融合了可学习突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。基于Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均采用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优均独立于外层测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其后是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被作为零覆盖的技术性结果处理。消融分析支持树突和突触阈值的贡献。然而，XGBoost取得了更高的平均二分类任务准确率（96.20%，scDNM为95.32%），且跨任务排名差异在统计上不显著。这些发现表明，scDNM在scRNA-seq细胞类型分类中具有竞争力，但仍需要更广泛的独立验证。

items.title_en: Quantum-Assisted Generative Anomaly Detection: A Dimension-Controlled Study of Latent Refinement
items.title_zh: 量子辅助生成式异常检测：潜在精炼的维度控制研究
items.abstract_en: Anomaly-based malware detectors learn what benign files look like and flag deviations. Generative approaches to this problem can make use of a "latent" or "prior" data representation, which is often chosen to be a Gaussian distribution. We ask whether the choice of prior distribution matters, and whether one produced by quantum hardware behaves differently from a classical one. Building on SAGEGAN, a style-based detector trained only on benign data, we compare three latent distributions: the original 512-dimensional Gaussian, a 48-dimensional Gaussian, and a 48-dimensional distribution sampled from an ORCA Computing PT-2 photonic quantum processor. We then refine each trained model's frozen representation using greedy and reinforcement-learning methods. Across ten random seeds, the quantum-derived model shows richer internal structure with better effective rank and latent similarity. It also benefits most from refinement. Though final detection accuracy is similar to that of the refined Gaussian latent, these findings show differences in latent geometry and refinement behavior between the trained configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 基于异常的恶意软件检测器学习良性文件的样子并标记偏差。该问题的生成式方法可以利用“潜在”或“先验”数据表示，这种表示通常选择为高斯分布。我们探究先验分布的选择是否重要，以及由量子硬件产生的先验是否与经典先验表现不同。在SAGEGAN（一种仅用良性数据训练的基于风格的检测器）基础上，我们比较三种潜在分布：原始512维高斯分布、48维高斯分布，以及从ORCA Computing PT-2光子量子处理器采样的48维分布。然后，我们使用贪心方法和强化学习方法对每个已训练模型的冻结表示进行精炼。在十个随机种子下，量子导出的模型表现出更丰富的内部结构，具有更好的有效秩和潜在相似性。它也从精炼中获益最多。尽管最终检测准确率与精炼后的高斯潜在模型相似，这些发现表明训练配置之间在潜在几何和精炼行为上存在差异。

items.title_en: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
items.title_zh: 人-智能体谈判中通过持续学习实现个性化情感感知
items.abstract_en: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.
items.abstract_zh: 与人类谈判的自利型智能体应解释非言语表达并据此调整行为。然而，通用面部情感模型在不同个体和情境下会退化，形成泛化差距。我们提出一种情感自适应谈判策略，将用于面部表情识别的持续学习与想象（CLIFER）相结合，以实时个性化效价-唤醒感知。差分反馈将效价-唤醒方向和强度的变化转化为智能体目标效用的调整。一种异步架构在实时交互期间于后台更新CLIFER。在一项66名参与者与人形机器人谈判的平衡被试内研究中，启用持续学习的智能体相比FaceChannel基线实现了显著更高的个体效用，并引发了更高的参与者让步率。持续学习条件产生了显著更高的平均唤醒估计，并具有更宽的输出范围。参与者效用和纳什距离在不同条件间未显著变化。这些结果支持将持续情感个性化与差分反馈相结合用于实时谈判的实际价值。

items.title_en: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
items.title_zh: AVCC：用于轮次转换预测并带有人类基准的音视频对话语料库
items.abstract_en: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned transcripts for the whole corpus, and a human reference benchmark collected at the same events. We score an audio-only Role-Relative VAP model (RoleVAP) and the multimodal MuVAP model. Labels, transcripts, per-response human data, and the scripts that reproduce every number are released.
items.abstract_zh: 预测谁将接下来发言以及何时发言，是对话智能体和社交机器人无需等待静默即可轮次转换的前提。多人下一次发言者预测（NSP）已在带有每位说话者传感器的语料库上研究，每个语料库都有其自身的事件定义。尚无公开基准覆盖机器人所拥有的单摄像头和麦克风，也没有任何模型与人类执行同一预测的表现进行比较。我们将AVCC——一个使用单个静态摄像头和麦克风录制的、时长31小时的两人和三人在线对话音视频语料库——转化为公开的NSP基准。我们添加了一个说话者不重叠的七视频测试分区，在相互静默间隙处包含865个保持事件和865个转换事件；为整个语料库添加词级强制对齐转录文本；并在相同事件上收集了人类参考基准。我们评估了仅音频的角色相对VAP模型（RoleVAP）和多模态MuVAP模型。标签、转录文本、逐响应人类数据以及可复现每个数字的脚本均已发布。

items.title_en: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
items.title_zh: 超越内存限制：面向大规模三维自主探索的层次化时空地图表示
items.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）探索越来越多地用于难以进入或受灾环境中的大规模测绘与巡检，而这些环境中的机载内存和计算资源通常受到严重限制。大多数现有无人机探索系统维护可全局查询的几何地图表示，用于运动规划和探索决策，导致内存消耗和空间查询成本随已探索区域增加而上升。以机器人为中心的局部建图限制了稠密地图的内存和计算，但丢弃了长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出FLAVOR，一种层次化时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图中，同时保留紧凑的全局观测和任务上下文。在观测层，轻量级LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留逐射线证据，用于前沿推理。在任务层，超出局部地图范围的未解决前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待处理任务。稀疏拓扑图通过保留的路线连接这些锚点，以便未来重访。当返回任务区域时，FLAVOR从观测中重建前沿和探索视点，同时拓扑路线在执行前被实例化并针对当前局部地图进行验证。随着探索扩展，稠密地图容量保持固定，依赖探索的内存增长被限制在紧凑的观测和任务上下文中。FLAVOR相比完成全部三个仿真场景的最佳基线，探索时间缩短31.98--41.88%，地图内存占用减少94--99%。在真实部署中，相对于显式点云ikd-tree，它在森林中将该占用减少92.67%，在建筑工地减少62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。

items.title_en: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
items.title_zh: 面向正常与应激相关超微结构状态的以星形胶质细胞为中心三维重建的轻量级深度学习框架
items.abstract_en: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.
items.abstract_zh: 星形胶质细胞的形态与其支持和调节神经回路功能的能力密切相关；然而，从体电子显微镜（vEM）数据中重建其形态仍然劳动密集且计算资源消耗大，尽管vEM具有高空间分辨率，这对其更广泛采用和可扩展性构成了重大障碍。我们提出AstroSeg-vEM，一个轻量级、以星形胶质细胞为中心的框架，用于vEM图像中保持形态的星形胶质细胞分割、三维重建和定量形态分析。AstroSeg-vEM将基于Transformer的二维分割与专门的后处理方法相结合，并直接在高分辨率EM切片上运行，使其非常适合各向异性vEM数据和下游校对工作流，同时保留原始EM数据的完整平面内分辨率。在代表正常及形态学定义的应激相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态的四个小鼠海马数据集中，AstroSeg-vEM表现出稳健的性能和泛化能力，在留出测试数据集上分别达到0.92和0.95的平均Dice和加权Dice值。其轻量级架构能够在消费级硬件上实现高效、高保真重建，为大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析和未来的星形胶质细胞-神经元相互作用研究提供了可扩展且易获取的平台。

items.title_en: Signals beneath the ectoderm: Mesodermal FGF signaling keeps the dorsally closing epithelium in shape
items.title_zh: 外胚层之下的信号：中胚层FGF信号维持背侧闭合上皮的形态
items.abstract_en: Morphogenesis requires coordinated biochemical signaling, actomyosin contractility and dynamic adhesion within and between tissues. During Drosophila development, ectodermal fibroblast growth factor (FGF) ligands regulate mesoderm morphogenesis through the FGF receptor (FGFR) Heartless. We find that the mesoderm reciprocally influences ectodermal morphogenesis. We show that loss of the FGF ligands Pyramus or Thisbe, Heartless, or its adaptor Stumps transforms normally straight dorsal seams and the formed dorsal epidermis into highly distorted, dynamically changing zigzags during dorsal closure. In these mutants, mesoderm is specified but defective. Mesodermal expression of Heartless restores epithelial stability in heartless mutants, whereas ectodermal expression does not. Genetic ablation of mesoderm produces more extensive seam distortions that persist beyond the end of closure, thereby displacing the dorsal midline. Despite these striking deformations, closure continues to completion. Together, our findings reveal a non-cell-autonomous requirement for mesodermal FGFR signaling in stabilizing the closing ectoderm and its newly formed seams. They identify a reciprocal influence of mesoderm on the ectoderm that patterns it and show that stable tissue geometry can be uncoupled from successful completion of a morphogenetic movement.
items.abstract_zh: 形态发生需要组织内和组织间协调的生化信号、肌动球蛋白收缩性和动态黏附。在果蝇发育过程中，外胚层成纤维细胞生长因子（FGF）配体通过FGF受体（FGFR）Heartless调节中胚层形态发生。我们发现中胚层反过来影响外胚层形态发生。我们表明，FGF配体Pyramus或Thisbe、Heartless或其衔接蛋白Stumps的缺失，会在背侧闭合过程中将通常笔直的背侧缝和已形成的背侧表皮转变为高度扭曲、动态变化的锯齿状。在这些突变体中，中胚层已特化但有缺陷。在中胚层表达Heartless可在heartless突变体中恢复上皮稳定性，而在外胚层表达则不能。中胚层的遗传消融会产生更广泛的缝扭曲，这些扭曲在闭合结束后仍然存在，从而使背侧中线移位。尽管有这些显著的变形，闭合仍继续完成。总之，我们的发现揭示了中胚层FGFR信号在稳定闭合中的外胚层及其新形成的缝方面具有非细胞自主性需求。它们识别出中胚层对外胚层的一种相互影响，这种影响塑造了外胚层的模式，并表明稳定的组织几何形态可与形态发生运动的成功完成解耦。

items.title_en: Boosting bottom-up milling of glass with GHz laser bursts
items.title_zh: 利用GHz激光脉冲串提升玻璃的自下而上铣削
items.abstract_en: Burst-mode laser processing has gained increasing attention in material machining due to its potential to enhance processing efficiency and quality. However, most studies have focused on conventional top-down machining strategies, while investigations of bottom-up milling (BUM) remain limited. In this work, we optimize processing parameters for high-efficiency glass milling using a bottom-up approach with GHz bursts. The results show that the highest BUM efficiencies are achieved when employing high pulse counts ($\geq$ 20). To the best of our knowledge, we report the highest glass milling efficiency, reaching more than 250 $μ$m$^3$/$μ$J for both soda-lime glass and fused silica. Furthermore, increasing the burst repetition rate while maintaining a parameter set associated with high milling efficiency enables a material removal rate larger than 8 mm$^3$/s.
items.abstract_zh: 脉冲串模式激光加工因其提高加工效率和质量的潜力而在材料加工中受到越来越多关注。然而，大多数研究集中于传统的自上而下加工策略，而对自下而上铣削（BUM）的研究仍然有限。在本工作中，我们优化了使用GHz脉冲串以自下而上方式高效铣削玻璃的加工参数。结果表明，采用高脉冲数（≥20）时可实现最高的BUM效率。据我们所知，我们报道了最高的玻璃铣削效率，钠钙玻璃和熔融石英均超过250 μm³/μJ。此外，在保持与高铣削效率相关的参数集的同时提高脉冲串重复频率，可实现大于8 mm³/s的材料去除率。

items.title_en: Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络强化学习中的循环模块化结构
items.abstract_en: Biological neural circuits are both modular and recurrent, with dense communities sparsely linked to one another. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) for reinforcement learning are usually feed-forward, and it is unclear how to obtain functional modules in a recurrent SNN or what they buy. In this work, we introduce a class of spiking networks, called Community Recurrent SNNs (CoRe SNNs): recurrent networks partitioned into communities with fixed roles. A controller community receives the stimulus, each action has its own community, and latent communities carry internal state. Spiking activity is then a walk between communities, and the action is the community the walk reaches. All learning is local and three-factor, and the recurrent communities are closer to cortical microcircuits than a feed-forward actor. We compare three regimes for obtaining the communities: dynamic modularity, in which a new learning rule we introduce, Map-STDP, encourages modular structure during learning; partial modularity, in which a stochastic block model (SBM) initialization enforces it partly; and full modularity, in which sealing enforces it fully. On CartPole, across three spiking neuron models, Map-STDP improves learning over the same network without it matches full modularity (sealed communities) on two of the three models, and makes the observed spike walk more compressible. Replacing the feed-forward actor of a TD-STDP actor-critic with recurrent action communities improves on the feed-forward network on CartPole and LunarLander, and matches it on Acrobot. How strongly to enforce modularity depends on the task: full modularity helps most on Acrobot, while on LunarLander the dynamic, partial and full regimes perform alike. Overall, these recurrent modular networks can match or even improve upon feed-forward approaches, with improvements in bio-plausibility and energy efficiency.
items.abstract_zh: 生物神经回路既模块化又具有循环性，密集的社区之间稀疏连接。用于强化学习的脉冲神经网络（SNN）通常是前馈的，尚不清楚如何在循环SNN中获得功能模块，也不清楚它们能带来什么好处。在本工作中，我们引入一类脉冲网络，称为社区循环SNN（CoRe SNN）：被划分为具有固定角色的社区的循环网络。一个控制器社区接收刺激，每个动作有自己的社区，潜在社区承载内部状态。脉冲活动于是成为社区之间的游走，动作就是游走所到达的社区。所有学习都是局部的和三因子的，循环社区比前馈actor更接近皮层微电路。我们比较了获得社区的三种机制：动态模块化，其中我们引入的新学习规则Map-STDP在学习过程中鼓励模块化结构；部分模块化，其中随机块模型（SBM）初始化部分强制实现模块化；以及完全模块化，其中通过封闭（sealing）完全强制实现模块化。在CartPole上，跨三种脉冲神经元模型，Map-STDP相较于不含该规则的同一网络改善了学习，在三种模型中的两种上达到与完全模块化（封闭社区）相当的水平，并使观察到的脉冲游走更具可压缩性。将TD-STDP actor-critic的前馈actor替换为循环动作社区，在CartPole和LunarLander上优于前馈网络，在Acrobot上与之相当。强制模块化的强度取决于任务：完全模块化在Acrobot上帮助最大，而在LunarLander上，动态、部分和完全三种机制表现相似。总体而言，这些循环模块化网络可以匹配甚至优于前馈方法，并在生物合理性和能效方面有所提升。

items.title_en: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement across Seven Open Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 删除敏感性是模型的属性：跨七个开放推理模型的三条件测量
items.abstract_en: Reasoning models write a reasoning trace at every turn of a multi-turn tool session, and later turns read this history. Across 94k ShareGPT conversations, 73 percent of user interactions span multiple turns. Upstream providers bind each trace to its issuer, so a request forwarded across issuers arrives with its history deleted, and the task cost of this stripping remains unmeasured. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling, through three rendering conditions, seven open-weight reasoning models, three seeds, 794 tasks, and the official checker. The same deletion spans -4.4 to +51.3 points with both ends excluding zero, and for the one model re-dosed from 0 to 100 percent deletion, the reading varies by at most 1.5 points. Deletion sensitivity is a model-level property. The reading follows the model itself and stays constant across deployments, and a retrained or re-released model is a new model that a two-cell screen, one retention run and one deletion run, re-reads for the cost of two runs. Deletion sensitivity is thus a measurable property of the model, and the reading must enter routing and aggregation as prior information rather than persist as an invisible default cost.
items.abstract_zh: 推理模型在多轮工具会话的每一轮都会写出一条推理轨迹，后续轮次会读取该历史。在94k个ShareGPT对话中，73%的用户交互跨越多个轮次。上游提供商将每条轨迹绑定到其签发者，因此跨签发者转发的请求到达时其历史已被删除，而这种剥离所带来的任务成本仍未得到测量。据我们所知，本文首次对多轮工具调用中的完整推理历史删除进行直接、盲测、多种子测量，涵盖三种渲染条件、七个开放权重推理模型、三个种子、794个任务以及官方检查器。同一删除在-4.4到+51.3分之间变化，且两端均不包含零；对于唯一一个将删除比例从0重新设定到100%的模型，其读数变化最多为1.5分。删除敏感性是模型层面的属性。该读数跟随模型本身，并在不同部署中保持恒定；重新训练或重新发布的模型是一个新模型，可用双单元筛选——一次保留运行和一次删除运行——以两次运行的成本重新读取。因此，删除敏感性是模型的一种可测量属性，该读数必须作为先验信息进入路由和聚合，而不是作为不可见的默认成本持续存在。

items.title_en: Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agentic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 通过盲区推理与视觉语言模型智能体对话的选择性协同感知
items.abstract_en: Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. Efficiency can be significantly improved by selectively performing CP only in safety-critical scenarios and for key occluding objects. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are well-suited for complex reasoning in dynamic and uncertain environments, making them a promising tool for this selective CP task. This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based CP. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. The framework also incorporates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting mechanism to enhance interpretability and intent-aware decision-making. We collect real-world data from connected vehicles operating in urban traffic and compare the driving-critical blind spot identification and dialogue performance of four state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves over 80% accuracy in driving-critical blind spot detection and over 90% success in dialogue-driven perception sharing. This work provides a scalable, interpretable, and bandwidth-efficient alternative to conventional CP pipelines, and offers new insights into agentic communication design for future connected traffic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体交通环境中的实时协同感知（CP）资源消耗极高，给大规模部署带来了可扩展性挑战。仅在安全关键场景和关键遮挡物体上选择性执行CP，可显著提高效率。视觉语言模型（VLM）非常适合在动态和不确定环境中进行复杂推理，使其成为这种选择性CP任务的有前景工具。本研究提出一个由VLM驱动的智能体框架，用于盲区推理和基于对话的CP。设计了一种混合模型架构，集成用于稳定感知的传统目标检测、用于识别有影响遮挡的视觉语言推理，以及一个基于物理的几何模块，使推理与真实世界可见性约束对齐。该框架还纳入思维链（CoT）提示机制，以增强可解释性和意图感知决策。我们收集了在城市交通中运行的网联汽车的真实世界数据，并比较了四种最先进VLM在驾驶关键盲区识别和对话性能方面的表现。实验结果表明，我们的方法在驾驶关键盲区检测中达到超过80%的准确率，在对话驱动的感知共享中达到超过90%的成功率。这项工作为传统CP流水线提供了一种可扩展、可解释且带宽高效的替代方案，并为未来网联交通系统的智能体通信设计提供了新见解。

items.title_en: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
items.title_zh: 基于球面光束法平差引导的无监督深度学习的尺度一致单目鱼眼视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼眼相机的宽视场和单目设置的简洁性，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）对机器人定位与建图具有吸引力。然而，长轨迹上的尺度漂移仍是一个主要挑战。无监督深度学习有助于缓解该问题，但鱼眼图像的显著畸变给准确深度估计带来挑战。本文提出S$^2$D-FVO，一种集成球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度学习的单目鱼眼VO框架，以提高尺度一致性和深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差不能一致地反映视线之间的角度偏差，并且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿一个切方向的扰动不敏感，SBA采用由球面对数映射得到的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切方向上均保持敏感性，且其范数等于相应的标量角度残差。进一步将基于中值深度的尺度正则项集成到SBA中，以约束重建尺度。基于这些公式，SBA在无监督深度学习中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络提供的深度估计为SBA提供尺度参考，在提高尺度一致性的同时允许对各个三维路标位置进行细化。在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提出的框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上均优于具有代表性的现有方法，并且适用于不同的相机模型。

items.title_en: Pooled Multiplex Amplicon Massive Parallel Sequencing for High-Throughput Confirmation of Whole-Genome Sequencing Potentially Pathogenic Variants in Patients with Parkinsonism
items.title_zh: 混合多重扩增子大规模平行测序用于高通量确认帕金森综合征患者全基因组测序潜在致病变异
items.abstract_en: Whole-genome sequencing identifies large numbers of genetic variants, although only a subset requires independent confirmation for clinical interpretation. Sanger sequencing remains the standard confirmation method but is impractical for large-scale variant verification. We developed and evaluated a strategy for variant confirmation based on multi-amplicon massively parallel sequencing of pooled DNA samples. Whole-genome sequencing data were obtained from 86 individuals, including patients with parkinsonism and controls. Variants were selected using phenotype-driven filtering, ClinVar classification, and pathogenicity assessment criteria. A total of 307 variants were targeted using a custom amplicon panel comprising 290 amplicons. DNA samples were normalized, pooled into 16 mixtures, and sequenced following automated library preparation. Variant presence and sequencing quality were assessed using standard bioinformatic tools. Of the 307 selected variants, 243 were successfully confirmed. Unconfirmed variants included sequencing artifacts (18), insufficiently covered targets (5), large insertions or deletions exceeding 12 base pairs (36), and variants located within homopolymeric regions (5). Results for selected variants were concordant with Sanger sequencing, and observed variant frequencies corresponded to expected frequencies in pooled samples. This approach provides a robust, rapid, and cost-effective method for high-throughput genetic variants confirming identified by whole-genome sequencing while requiring only limited DNA input. Despite complete concordance with Sanger sequencing, larger validation studies are needed before multi-amplicon massively parallel sequencing can replace routine confirmatory testing.
items.abstract_zh: 全基因组测序可识别大量遗传变异，尽管只有一部分需要独立确认以用于临床解释。Sanger测序仍是标准确认方法，但不适用于大规模变异验证。我们开发并评估了一种基于混合DNA样本多扩增子大规模平行测序的变异确认策略。全基因组测序数据来自86个个体，包括帕金森综合征患者和对照。使用表型驱动过滤、ClinVar分类和致病性评估标准选择变异。使用包含290个扩增子的定制扩增子检测板靶向共307个变异。DNA样本经归一化后混合成16个混合物，并在自动化文库制备后测序。使用标准生物信息学工具评估变异存在情况和测序质量。在307个选定变异中，243个被成功确认。未确认的变异包括测序伪影（18）、覆盖不足的靶标（5）、超过12个碱基对的大插入或缺失（36）以及位于同聚物区域的变异（5）。选定变异的结果与Sanger测序一致，观察到的变异频率与混合样本中的预期频率相符。该方法为高通量确认全基因组测序所识别的遗传变异提供了一种稳健、快速且经济有效的方法，同时仅需有限的DNA输入。尽管与Sanger测序完全一致，但在多扩增子大规模平行测序能够替代常规确认检测之前，仍需更大规模的验证研究。

items.title_en: Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
items.title_zh: CrSBr中的缺陷与结构演化：用于原子尺度模拟的机器学习势函数
items.abstract_en: The layered van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr combines intrinsic magnetic order with semiconducting and optical properties, making it a promising material for multifunctional electronic and photonic applications. Understanding how defects and structural transformations affect its properties under experimentally relevant conditions, however, remains challenging for first-principles simulations due to the relevant length and time scales. Here, we develop and benchmark machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for the Cr-S-Br system, enabling large-scale atomistic simulations of CrSBr with accuracy approaching that of density functional theory (DFT). The charge-aware variant qNEP achieves near-DFT accuracy in predicting lattice constants, formation enthalpies, vacancy energetics, and the anisotropic pressure response of o-CrSBr. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal that pre-existing S vacancies lower the Cr Frenkel-pair migration barrier by up to 1.1 eV, providing an atomistic mechanism for beam-induced Cr redistribution and structural transformations. Displacement threshold calculations further show that Br is the most susceptible species to electron-beam-induced displacement, identifying the relative ease of removing different atomic species. Together, these results establish a validated computational framework for investigating atomic-scale disorder and structural transformations in CrSBr, providing a basis for defect engineering in materials for future magneto-optoelectronic applications.
items.abstract_zh: 层状范德华半导体CrSBr结合了本征磁序与半导体和光学性质，使其成为多功能电子和光子应用的有前景材料。然而，理解缺陷和结构转变在实验相关条件下如何影响其性质，对于第一性原理模拟而言仍因相关长度和时间尺度而具有挑战性。在此，我们开发并基准测试了针对Cr-S-Br体系的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），从而能够以接近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度对CrSBr进行大规模原子尺度模拟。电荷感知变体qNEP在预测o-CrSBr的晶格常数、形成焓、空位能量学以及各向异性压力响应方面达到接近DFT的精度。微动弹性带计算揭示，预先存在的S空位将Cr弗伦克尔对迁移势垒降低最多1.1 eV，为束诱导的Cr重新分布和结构转变提供了原子尺度机制。位移阈值计算进一步表明，Br是电子束诱导位移最敏感的物种，识别了移除不同原子种类的相对难易程度。总之，这些结果建立了一个经过验证的计算框架，用于研究CrSBr中的原子尺度无序和结构转变，为未来磁光电子应用材料的缺陷工程提供了基础。

items.title_en: Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 用于基于奖励的持续学习的再循环训练单极神经元网络
items.abstract_en: Unipolar neurons are the predominant type of nerve cell in the octopus and in most other invertebrates. A single neurite (a fiber extending from the cell body) branches into a tree that carries both input and output synapses. The branches send graded local outputs to nearby cells, and one site on the main neurite sends a global output to distant targets. This paper proposes a network of such neurons and a learning rule for it. Each neuron is modeled as a tree of passive segments, whose activations are computed exactly as the steady state of a linear system. The network learns from reward alone, with a rule called recirculation. After each forward pass, a second pass sends requested changes of the outputs back through the same connections. Each synapse then adjusts its weight using only quantities available at its own location. Because the system of each neuron is symmetric, this update closely follows the gradient of the error in the predicted reward. Two mechanisms limit forgetting when tasks are learned in sequence: a task code inhibits a different subset of branches in each task, while consolidation lowers the learning rate of synapses that changed strongly in the recent past. The model is evaluated on a sequence of MNIST and Iris tasks. The network maintains high accuracy with low forgetting, whereas gradient-based training of the same network forgets earlier tasks almost completely.
items.abstract_zh: 单极神经元是章鱼和大多数其他无脊椎动物中占主导地位的神经细胞类型。单个神经突（从细胞体延伸出的纤维）分支成一棵树，该树同时承载输入和输出突触。分支向附近细胞发送分级局部输出，而主神经突上的一个位点向远处目标发送全局输出。本文提出了由这类神经元组成的网络及其学习规则。每个神经元被建模为由无源片段组成的树，其激活值被精确计算为线性系统的稳态。该网络仅从奖励中学习，所用规则称为再循环（recirculation）。每次前向传递之后，第二次传递将请求的输出变化通过相同连接回传。随后，每个突触仅使用其自身位置可获得的量来调整权重。由于每个神经元的系统是对称的，该更新紧密跟随预测奖励误差的梯度。当按顺序学习任务时，有两种机制限制遗忘：任务代码在每个任务中抑制不同的分支子集，而巩固机制降低近期强烈变化的突触的学习率。该模型在一系列MNIST和Iris任务上进行评估。该网络保持高准确率且遗忘较低，而对同一网络进行基于梯度的训练几乎完全遗忘较早的任务。

items.title_en: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
items.title_zh: 人格泛化可预测吗？
items.abstract_en: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 当在一个领域微调语言模型会在其他领域诱发行为变化时，就发生了人格泛化——例如，在涌现性错位中观察到的广泛不安全行为。我们发现人格泛化中存在一个令人惊讶的“on-the-line”（在线上）现象：在各种微调超参数下，域内和域外人格率遵循近似概率单位线性关系，并且这种特定的概率单位线性关系甚至跨模型家族和模型规模（包括Qwen和Llama）也令人惊讶地共享。不改变可训练参数集合的训练选择，如学习率、权重衰减和训练时长，主要使模型沿同一条线移动，主要通过削弱域内学习来降低迁移。然而，改变微调哪些层可以改变斜率。对于不安全行为，仅微调较后层会产生更浅的斜率，在保留强域内学习的同时减少域外错位。这种“on-the-line”现象将关于人格泛化的意外、孤立观察统一到一个用于预测和控制行为迁移的定量框架中。

items.title_en: GEMOR-GS: Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM
items.title_zh: GEMOR-GS：用于3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定精细化建图与在线重定位
items.abstract_en: Photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations are a primary requirement for LiDAR--inertial--visual SLAM systems that serve robots over continuous operation. 3D Gaussian splatting makes such representations attainable by supplying an explicit, renderable, and queryable scene model. We present GEMOR-GS (Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM) to make the Gaussian map geometrically accurate, globally refined, and re-enterable, providing a better appearance for robot perception and decision-making. To improve the 3DGS map, the LiDAR--camera extrinsic is first estimated offline by direct-method alignment over dedicated calibration segments and reused by all following online and offline processes. Under the calibrated geometry, keyframe poses and Gaussian parameters are refined alternately under a gated differentiable-rendering and LiDAR--projection objective. The final global reconstruction is then rebuilt from the refined keyframe schema with all online constraints lifted. For the robot SLAM lifecycle, the method recovers the pose from the 3DGS map after tracking loss through an XFeat bypass map, RANSAC-PnP coarse localization, and Gaussian RGB-D warp refinement. Experiments on one self-collected and five public sequences quantify each element: the offline reconstruction wins all paired keyframes against the online map by 14.3--19.9 dB, improves PSNR by approximately 9 dB over Gaussian-LIC2, and achieves 86--100% held-out relocalization success tied to extrinsic quality. The results show that GEMOR-GS improves the geometric accuracy, appearance fidelity, and re-enterability of the 3DGS map, serving as a dependable robot world model for SLAM and downstream tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 照片级真实且度量一致的世界表示，是服务机器人持续运行的激光雷达-惯性-视觉SLAM系统的主要需求。3D高斯泼溅通过提供显式、可渲染且可查询的场景模型，使此类表示成为可能。我们提出GEMOR-GS（用于3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定精细化建图与在线重定位），以使高斯地图在几何上准确、全局精细化且可重入，为机器人感知和决策提供更好的外观。为改进3DGS地图，首先在专用标定段上通过直接法对齐离线估计激光雷达-相机外参，并由所有后续在线和离线过程重用。在校准几何下，在门控可微渲染与激光雷达投影目标函数下交替细化关键帧位姿和高斯参数。然后，在解除所有在线约束的情况下，从精细化关键帧模式重建最终全局重建。对于机器人SLAM生命周期，该方法在跟踪丢失后通过XFeat旁路地图、RANSAC-PnP粗定位和高斯RGB-D warp精细化从3DGS地图恢复位姿。在一个自采集和五个公开序列上的实验量化了每个元素：离线重建在所有配对关键帧上以14.3–19.9 dB优于在线地图，相比Gaussian-LIC2将PSNR提高约9 dB，并实现86–100%的留出重定位成功率，且与外参质量相关。结果表明，GEMOR-GS提高了3DGS地图的几何精度、外观保真度和可重入性，可作为SLAM及下游任务的可靠机器人世界模型。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得当前最佳结果。我们的算法使用一个全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，该网络的输入是单个连续 5D 坐标（空间位置 (x,y,z) 和观察方向 (θ, φ)），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与观察方向相关的发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机光线查询 5D 坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影为图像。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们建议读者观看补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Gamma delta T cells are expanded in the blood of chronic low back pain patients with lumbar Modic changes
items.title_zh: γδ T 细胞在伴有腰椎 Modic 改变的慢性下背痛患者血液中扩增
items.abstract_en: Objectives Modic changes (MC) are vertebral endplate and bone marrow lesions strongly associated with chronic low back pain. Type 1 MC (MC1, oedema-like) and type 2 or 3 MC (MC2or3, fat- and sclerosis-like) are commonly regarded as different stages of the same pathological process, yet their underlying biology remains poorly defined. In particular, it remains unclear whether MC are confined to the spine or accompanied by distinct systemic immune alterations. Here, we provide the first comprehensive characterisation of the circulating immune landscape in patients with lumbar MC. Methods Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were analysed from 37 patients undergoing lumbar spinal surgery: 11 with no MC, 15 with MC1 and 11 with MC2or3. Samples were fluorescently barcoded, pooled, and stained with a 28-antibody phenotyping panel. Each pool was then split into 30 aliquots, and each of these was co-stained with a different PE-conjugated anti-integrin, -selectin, or -chemokine receptor antibody or isotype controls. Differences in abundance were tested with binomial mixed models adjusted for acquisition batch, age, and sex. Differentially abundant compartments were clustered by FlowSOM and the same binomial model was used to test differences in cluster abundance. Adhesion receptors were analysed as single chains. Results The {gamma}{delta} T cell compartment was the only population significantly expanded in MC patients (median 0.58% of all recorded cells in nonMC donors versus 1.61% in pooled MC (OR = 2.38, q = 0.035)). Clustering {gamma}{delta} T cells into subsets showed compartment-wide expansion, primarily driven by V{delta}2+ T cells. The adhesion receptor screen revealed 6 and 2 integrin on basophils, endoglin on plasmacytoid dendritic cells, and {beta}7 integrin on IgA B cells as differentially expressed in MC, but none survived multiple-testing correction across the whole screen. Conclusions Lumbar MC are accompanied by expansion of circulating {gamma}{delta} T cells. This aligns with previously reported {gamma}{delta} T cell accumulation in MC1 lesions, underscoring the role of {gamma}{delta} T cells in MC pathophysiology.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：Modic 改变（MC）是与慢性下背痛强烈相关的椎体终板及骨髓病变。1 型 MC（MC1，水肿样）和 2 或 3 型 MC（MC2or3，脂肪样和硬化样）通常被视为同一病理过程的不同阶段，但其潜在生物学仍定义不清。特别是，MC 是局限于脊柱还是伴随不同的全身免疫改变仍不清楚。在此，我们首次对腰椎 MC 患者的循环免疫景观进行全面表征。方法：分析 37 名接受腰椎手术患者的外周血单个核细胞：11 名无 MC、15 名 MC1、11 名 MC2or3。样本经荧光条形码标记、合并，并用 28 抗体表型 panel 染色。随后每个 pool 分成 30 等份，每份与不同的 PE 偶联抗整合素、抗选择素或抗趋化因子受体抗体或同型对照共染色。丰度差异使用二项混合模型检验，并校正采集批次、年龄和性别。差异丰度区室通过 FlowSOM 聚类，并使用相同二项模型检验 cluster 丰度差异。黏附受体按单链分析。结果：γδ T 细胞区室是 MC 患者中唯一显著扩增的群体（非 MC 供者中位数占所有记录细胞的 0.58%，合并 MC 中为 1.61%（OR = 2.38，q = 0.035））。将 γδ T 细胞聚类为亚群显示区室整体扩增，主要由 Vδ2+ T 细胞驱动。黏附受体筛查显示嗜碱性粒细胞上的整合素 6 和 2、浆细胞样树突状细胞上的内皮糖蛋白（endoglin）以及 IgA B 细胞上的 β7 整合素在 MC 中差异表达，但在整个筛查中无一通过多重检验校正。结论：腰椎 MC 伴随循环 γδ T 细胞扩增。这与先前报道的 MC1 病变中 γδ T 细胞积累一致，强调了 γδ T 细胞在 MC 病理生理学中的作用。

items.title_en: Modular and Looping Quantum Photonic Processing Unit for Quantum Computing
items.title_zh: 用于量子计算的模块化循环量子光子处理单元
items.abstract_en: Photonic processors are emerging as promising platforms in the race towards the realization of practical universal quantum computers. Several architectures with universal capabilities have been proposed for their implementation via a photonic platform, each with their own set of benefits and drawbacks. In this work we propose an architecture for a universal photonic quantum computer. The proposed architecture is modular, allowing for a high degree of flexibility and scalability, and relies on a loop-based structure, significantly reducing the number of physical components required to implement it experimentally. We prove that our architecture is universal, deterministic, and compatible with the quantum circuital model, as well as reprogrammable and capable of adaptive measurements. Furthermore, we showcase its functioning via numerical simulation on specific examples, by using machine learning techniques on a set of fundamental linear and nonlinear optical components to obtain some of the building blocks used in the architecture. The obtained results can be used to highlight the benefits and the drawbacks of the proposed architecture, as well as the route for future developments towards its physical implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 光子处理器正作为实现实用通用量子计算机竞赛中有前景的平台而兴起。已提出若干具有通用能力的架构以通过光子平台实现，每种架构各有其优缺点。在本工作中，我们提出一种通用光子量子计算机的架构。所提架构是模块化的，允许高度灵活性和可扩展性，并依赖基于环路的结构，显著减少实验实现所需的物理组件数量。我们证明我们的架构是通用的、确定性的，并与量子电路模型兼容，同时可重编程且能够进行自适应测量。此外，我们通过特定实例上的数值模拟展示其运行，在一组基本线性与非线性光学组件上使用机器学习技术，以获得架构中使用的一些构建模块。所得结果可用于突出所提架构的优点和缺点，以及其物理实现未来发展的路径。

items.title_en: BODYinTRANSIT-Lab: A Multimodal Dataset for Investigating Sensory-Driven Transformations in Body Perception and Affective Experiences
items.title_zh: BODYinTRANSIT-Lab：用于研究身体感知与情感体验中感官驱动转变的多模态数据集
items.abstract_en: Multimodal datasets that combine synchronised behavioural and physiological signals with subjective affective and body perception measures are still rare. This limits both the understanding of embodied experience and the development of computational models that infer subjective states from sensor data. We introduce BODYinTRANSIT-Lab, a multimodal dataset that addresses this gap by capturing affective, perceptual, and behavioural responses to the Footsteps Illusion. In this closed-loop paradigm, participants perform walking tasks while receiving real-time manipulated auditory feedback of their own footsteps intended to alter perceived body weight. The dataset comprises synchronised recordings from 101 participants recruited through systematic stratification by eating-disorder symptomatology and physical activity level. BODYinTRANSIT-Lab combines full-body kinematics with electromyography, electrocardiography, respiration, and electrodermal activity. Its annotations capture both immediate and post-trial experience, including within-trial perceived-weight ratings, post-trial assessments of body feelings and affective experience, 3D avatar body visualisations, and quantitative body maps. Psychological, behavioural, demographic, and social measures provide further information about factors that may influence individual responses. We provide a deep learning benchmark that uses walking kinematics to classify relative affective valence and perceived weight within subjects. On within-session, segment-level splits, the baseline model achieved mean balanced accuracies of 45.9% for affective valence and 44.5% for perceived weight. The BODYinTRANSIT-Lab dataset provides an experimentally controlled resource for cognitive neuroscience and affective computing research, with potential applications in affect-aware interactive systems, health and well-being technologies, and creative embodied experiences.
items.abstract_zh: 将同步的行为和生理信号与主观情感和身体感知测量相结合的多模态数据集仍然很少。这限制了对具身体验的理解，以及从传感器数据推断主观状态的计算模型的发展。我们介绍 BODYinTRANSIT-Lab，一个通过捕捉对 Footsteps Illusion 的情感、知觉和行为反应来弥补这一空白的多模态数据集。在这一闭环范式中，参与者在执行行走任务时接受对其自身脚步声的实时操纵听觉反馈，旨在改变其感知体重。该数据集包含通过按进食障碍症状学和体力活动水平进行系统分层招募的 101 名参与者的同步记录。BODYinTRANSIT-Lab 将全身运动学与肌电图、心电图、呼吸和皮肤电活动相结合。其标注捕捉即时和试验后体验，包括试验内感知体重评分、试验后身体感受和情感体验评估、3D 虚拟化身身体可视化以及定量身体地图。心理、行为、人口学和社会测量提供了关于可能影响个体反应的因素的进一步信息。我们提供一个深度学习基准，使用行走运动学在受试者内对相对情感效价和感知体重进行分类。在会话内、片段级划分上，基线模型在情感效价和感知体重上的平均平衡准确率分别达到 45.9% 和 44.5%。BODYinTRANSIT-Lab 数据集为认知神经科学和情感计算研究提供了实验控制的资源，在情感感知交互系统、健康与福祉技术以及创造性具身体验方面具有潜在应用。

items.title_en: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
items.title_zh: PORT：通过稳健的 token 级重加权进行偏好优化
items.abstract_en: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
items.abstract_zh: 偏好优化已成为使大语言模型与人类价值对齐的核心方法，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于偏好标注的质量。在实践中，由于标注错误和歧义，偏好数据往往带有噪声。现有的稳健偏好优化方法主要在序列级运行，隐含地将整个响应视为一致正确或错误。然而，被拒绝的响应仍可能包含有信息量的推理步骤，而被偏好的响应也可能包含细微错误。在本工作中，我们提出 PORT（Preference Optimization via Robust Token-level Reweighting），一个在噪声偏好下进行稳健对齐的细粒度框架。PORT 使用 token 对数概率的经验累积分布函数（CDF）进行 token 级重加权，产生一种仅需前向传播的高效代理，用以替代梯度范数惩罚，从而在不进行额外反向传播计算的情况下选择性抑制损坏的 token。我们提供理论分析，表明 PORT 通过最小化偏差项的上界来减少噪声偏好标签带来的梯度偏差。跨多种噪声设置的广泛实验表明，PORT 持续提高稳健性并优于现有序列级基线。代码见 https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT

items.title_en: Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: 用于惯性里程计的可微滤波
items.abstract_en: Accurate inertial odometry is critical for autonomous systems but suffers from unbounded drift caused by the integration of sensor noise and biases. In approaches such as TLIO, neural pseudo-measurements are trained independently of their downstream filter. This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry (DFIO), a learning framework that embeds the update stages of an error-state Kalman filter directly into a computational graph. Following standalone pre-training, DFIO jointly optimizes the displacement and covariance output heads using posterior-position supervision through differentiable measurement updates. The proposed system is validated on public pedestrian motion datasets featuring both calibrated and uncalibrated inertial measurements. Experimental results on a pedestrian dataset demonstrate that DFIO reduces mean absolute and one-second relative translation errors by 13.2% and 39.6% relative to the TLIO baseline, and by 7.7% and 17.4% relative to its pre-trained counterpart. Furthermore, evaluations on uncalibrated smartphone inertial data indicate that the proposed method effectively mitigates translational drift and maintains trajectory alignment under highly noisy sensor conditions. Source code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的惯性里程计对自主系统至关重要，但会因传感器噪声和偏置的积分而产生无界漂移。在 TLIO 等方法中，神经伪测量与下游滤波器独立训练。本文介绍用于惯性里程计的可微滤波（DFIO），一个将误差状态卡尔曼滤波器的更新阶段直接嵌入计算图的学习框架。在独立预训练之后，DFIO 通过可微测量更新利用后验位置监督，联合优化位移和协方差输出头。所提系统在具有校准和未校准惯性测量的公共行人运动数据集上得到验证。在行人数据集上的实验结果表明，相对于 TLIO 基线，DFIO 将平均绝对平移误差和 1 秒相对平移误差分别降低 13.2% 和 39.6%，相对于其预训练对应版本分别降低 7.7% 和 17.4%。此外，在未校准智能手机惯性数据上的评估表明，所提方法有效缓解平移漂移，并在高噪声传感器条件下保持轨迹对齐。源代码将公开。

items.title_en: UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
items.title_zh: UGG：统一生成式几何模型
items.abstract_en: Understanding 4D scenes is a core challenge in visual intelligence, requiring models to jointly capture scene geometry, appearance, and dynamics from partial observations. However, existing approaches are subdivided into feedforward models for direct geometric prediction, and generative models for visual synthesis. We introduce UGG, a unified framework for 4D scene understanding that jointly models RGB video and geometric representations such as depth and camera pose. By assigning different noise levels across modalities and time, UGG formulates visual generation and geometric prediction as conditional completion within a single generative model. This flexible formulation enables the model to learn from diverse, heterogeneous datasets with different subsets of geometric and visual annotations. Furthermore, our generative formulation enables inference-time search over multiple plausible scene hypotheses, using geometric evidence extracted from observed RGB frames to improve geometric prediction without ground truth geometry. We demonstrate UGG's effectiveness over non-unified baselines across camera-controlled video generation, depth estimation, and camera pose prediction, including in challenging sparse observation settings. Code and visualizations are available at https://ugg-model.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 理解 4D 场景是视觉智能的核心挑战，要求模型从部分观测中联合捕捉场景几何、外观和动态。然而，现有方法被细分为用于直接几何预测的前馈模型和用于视觉合成的生成模型。我们提出 UGG，一个用于 4D 场景理解的统一框架，联合建模 RGB 视频与深度、相机位姿等几何表示。通过在不同模态和时间上分配不同噪声水平，UGG 将视觉生成和几何预测统一表述为单一生成模型中的条件补全。这种灵活的形式使模型能够从具有不同几何与视觉标注子集的多样异构数据集中学习。此外，我们的生成式表述支持在推理时对多个合理场景假设进行搜索，利用从观测 RGB 帧中提取的几何证据，在无真实几何的情况下改进几何预测。我们在相机控制视频生成、深度估计和相机位姿预测中展示了 UGG 相较于非统一基线的有效性，包括在具有挑战性的稀疏观测设置下。代码与可视化见 https://ugg-model.github.io/

items.title_en: Spatiotemporal mapping of ex vivo myometrial contractions in adenomyosis
items.title_zh: 子宫腺肌症中离体子宫肌层收缩的时空映射
items.abstract_en: Objective: Uterine dyscontractility plays a major role in pain sensation, infertility, and adenomyosis pathogenesis. In vivo, contractility occurs in the inner myometrium and junctional zone, which is thickened in adenomyosis. We examined whether the junctional zone presents particular contractile features ex vivo by measuring contractility and oxytocin response in full-thickness serosa-to-endometrium myometrial slices retrieved from control and adenomyosis patients. Design: Prospective ex vivo case-control study. Subjects: Premenopausal women following hysterectomy: adenomyosis (n = 16) and controls (n = 12). Contractility: 57 strips (11 vs 8 patients), immunofluorescence: 10 vs 9 patients. Main Outcome Measures: We resorted to spatiotemporal mapping, time-lapse video-based techniques used in the field of gastroenterology. We measured contraction frequency, amplitude, duration, velocity, site of origin, and propagation direction along the serosa-to-endometrium axis, before and after oxytocin. We measured oxytocin receptor density along the serosa-to-endometrium axis by immunofluorescence and machine learning-assisted segmentation. Results: Ex vivo contractile waves propagated throughout the outer and inner myometrium, with similar amplitude and frequency. Contraction frequency, amplitude, duration, and velocity did not differ between control and adenomyosis uteri. Oxytocin increased contraction frequency and velocity and systematically caused contractile waves to originate at the inner myometrium in both groups. In both groups, oxytocin receptor density was highest in the inner myometrium. Adenomyosis patients had a 1.8-fold higher oxytocin receptor density, but a smaller oxytocin-induced increase in contraction frequency. Conclusion: We provide the first ex vivo spatiotemporal time-lapse analysis of myometrial contractions. The whole myometrium contracts ex vivo, not just the inner part (junctional zone). This uniform myogenic motility is presumably inhibited neurally in vivo in the outer myometrium. Ex vivo adenomyosis basal contractility was similar to that of controls. Adenomyotic myometrium overexpressed oxytocin receptors compared to controls, but this did not translate into a stronger contractile response to oxytocin. In both groups, oxytocin caused contractile waves to originate at and propagate from the sub-endometrial myometrium, where receptor density is higher. This demonstrates that contractile wave direction can be controlled hormonally.
items.abstract_zh: 目的：子宫收缩功能障碍在疼痛感受、不孕和子宫腺肌症发病机制中起主要作用。在体内，收缩性发生于内层子宫肌层和连接带，而连接带在子宫腺肌症中增厚。我们通过测量从对照组和子宫腺肌症患者获取的全层浆膜至子宫内膜子宫肌层切片中的收缩性和催产素反应，检验连接带在离体条件下是否呈现特定收缩特征。设计：前瞻性离体病例对照研究。研究对象：子宫切除术后绝经前女性：子宫腺肌症组（n = 16）和对照组（n = 12）。收缩性：57 条肌条（11 对 8 名患者），免疫荧光：10 对 9 名患者。主要结局指标：我们采用时空映射，即胃肠病学领域使用的基于延时视频的技术。我们测量了催产素前后沿浆膜至子宫内膜轴的收缩频率、幅度、持续时间、速度、起源部位和传播方向。我们通过免疫荧光和机器学习辅助分割测量沿浆膜至子宫内膜轴的催产素受体密度。结果：离体收缩波在整个外层和内层子宫肌层中传播，幅度和频率相似。对照组与子宫腺肌症子宫之间的收缩频率、幅度、持续时间和速度无差异。催产素增加收缩频率和速度，并在两组中系统性地使收缩波起源于内层子宫肌层。在两组中，催产素受体密度均在内层子宫肌层最高。子宫腺肌症患者的催产素受体密度高 1.8 倍，但催产素诱导的收缩频率增加较小。结论：我们提供了首个子宫肌层收缩的离体时空延时分析。整个子宫肌层在离体条件下均收缩，而不仅是内层部分（连接带）。这种均匀的肌源性运动在体内外层子宫肌层中推测受神经抑制。离体子宫腺肌症的基础收缩性与对照组相似。与对照组相比，子宫腺肌症子宫肌层过表达催产素受体，但并未转化为对催产素更强的收缩反应。在两组中，催产素使收缩波起源于子宫内膜下子宫肌层并从该处传播，该处受体密度更高。这表明收缩波方向可受激素控制。
