items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer
items.title_zh: 变分量子电路的权重空间编程：大语言模型无需优化器即可写出量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) optimize circuit angles through repeated quantum-device evaluations, often facing vanishing gradients and high optimization costs. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can write these angles directly. Extending *weight-space programming* from classical networks to quantum circuits, we provide a frontier LLM (\gpt) with the problem, circuit, and gate conventions. Its angles are executed exactly as written, without returning losses, gradients, or accuracy feedback. Across 139 requests, we test handwritten-digit classification, VQE ground-state estimation for spin chains and H$_2$, and MaxCut QAOA, comparing against random weights, classical optimization, and optimization initialized with LLM weights on the same circuit. When parameters have interpretable structure, the LLM matches or approaches the optimizer: it achieves 95--100\% of the energy spectrum on every VQE problem, derives the exact H$_2$ ground state in closed form, finds optimal depth-one QAOA angles for every graph, and reaches 93--96\% accuracy on digits 3 versus 8 with 12--18 hand-written weights, outperforming an optimizer trained on the same ten examples. Its weights are also strong warm starts: optimization reaches its best value after a median of one evaluation rather than hundreds. Allowed to design circuits, the LLM chooses data-dependent rotation chains encoding pixel importance in all 30 cases (one qubit for binary tasks, one chain per qubit for ten classes), reaching 65\% accuracy across ten digits. Yet the approach fails in opaque weight spaces: accuracy drops to chance when fixed circuits exceed 30 weights, while optimization improves. It is also sensitive to gate conventions: 6 of 42 QAOA replies reverse mixing-angle signs and fail. We release all prompts, replies, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）通过重复的量子设备评估来优化电路角度，常面临梯度消失和高优化成本。我们询问大语言模型（LLM）能否直接写出这些角度。我们将权重空间编程从经典网络扩展到量子电路，向一个前沿 LLM（GPT）提供问题、电路和门约定。其角度按原样精确执行，不返回损失、梯度或准确率反馈。在 139 个请求中，我们测试手写数字分类、自旋链和 H$_2$ 的 VQE 基态估计以及 MaxCut QAOA，并与随机权重、经典优化以及在同一电路上用 LLM 权重初始化的优化进行比较。当参数具有可解释结构时，LLM 匹配或接近优化器：它在每个 VQE 问题上达到能谱的 95--100\%，以闭式推导出精确的 H$_2$ 基态，为每个图找到最优深度一 QAOA 角度，并在 3 与 8 的数字分类上用 12--18 个手写权重达到 93--96\% 的准确率，优于在同样十个示例上训练的优化器。其权重也是强热启动：优化在评估次数中位数为一次后达到最佳值，而非数百次。在允许设计电路时，LLM 在全部 30 个案例中选择编码像素重要性的数据依赖旋转链（二分类任务一个量子比特，十类任务每个量子比特一条链），在十个数字上达到 65\% 的准确率。然而，该方法在不透明权重空间中失败：当固定电路超过 30 个权重时，准确率降至随机水平，而优化则有所提升。它还对门约定敏感：42 个 QAOA 回复中有 6 个反转混合角符号并失败。我们发布所有提示、回复和评分。

items.title_en: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
items.title_zh: BioXArena-Pro：面向自主生物医学机器学习智能体的研究级基准
items.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.
items.abstract_zh: 编程智能体越来越多地被提出作为生物医学模型的自主构建者，但现有基准规模小、接近饱和或存在信息泄漏风险。我们提出 BioXArena-Pro，包含来自八个生物医学领域的 64 个研究级建模任务，每个任务都根据一项已发表研究重建；大多数任务留出整个生物单元（如物种或队列）。在 22 种智能体配置中，最佳得分为 100 分制下的 55.1 分，且脚手架的重要性几乎与模型相当。我们为每个任务重新运行了一种已发表方法：在已发表配方原样适用的情况下，最佳智能体与方法打平；在重建任务上，方法落后 8.2 分，表明智能体通过适应新数据而获益。预训练模型（包括生物基础模型）在最强智能体使用它们的地方很重要：禁止使用会使该智能体在这些任务上的得分下降 9 分。每个任务都经过多轮 AI 辅助审计和最终人工审查。

items.title_en: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
items.title_zh: 面向智能体软件开发的仓库上下文引导图像理解
items.abstract_en: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.
items.abstract_zh: 编程智能体越来越多地在错误报告中接收 UI 截图，但图像质量下降——由低分辨率、压缩伪影或渲染文本过小导致——会阻碍它们识别相关 UI 元素和源文件。视觉语言模型随着图像质量恶化而变得不那么可靠，而 OCR 辅助方法可能传播来自退化输入的识别错误。当定位所需的视觉证据在查询截图中不再清晰可观察时，两种方法都受限。我们提出为编程智能体增强仓库渲染的参考图像：从智能体被要求修改的同一代码库生成清晰截图。这些参考提供应用 UI 的可读视觉证据，同时保留当前可能包含缺陷的实现状态。由于它们从可用仓库生成，而不需要已知无缺陷版本，因此可以针对可复现的应用状态自动生成，无需手动图像标注。我们在一个由 SWE-bench Multimodal 衍生的受控基准上评估该方法，该基准通过向真实 Web 应用注入视觉 UI 缺陷构建。我们改变截图退化和参考图像提供情况，并测量编程智能体是否识别出正确的源文件。结果表明，参考图像改善了文件定位，尤其是在图像质量退化时，在四倍下采样并 JPEG 压缩下提高了金标准文件匹配率。我们通过进一步分析确认，在相同退化下，所提方法识别文本的能力比语言偏置的 OCR 约高 12 个百分点。

items.title_en: Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty
items.title_zh: 不确定性下月球车轨迹规划的大语言模型可解释性
items.abstract_en: Planning planetary rover trajectories under probabilistic uncertainty is a multi-objective optimization problem that science teams currently iteratively solve and verify by hand. This process becomes impractical when timelines and constraints frequently shift throughout the mission planning phase. Sampling-based planners such as Monte Carlo tree search can speed up this process, but their outputs do not preserve traceability to the science objectives that justify each plan, which the science team needs to verify. We propose an interactive assistant based on a large language model (LLM) that can explain planner trajectories using domain vocabulary and re-run the planner under user-specified conditions to compare alternatives. Previous work has used LLMs inside planner decision-making loops, but we explore using them for post-planning explanation, where they are more likely to be trusted since they do not directly influence planner decisions. Our framework pairs a simulator inspired by the NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) mission with a ReAct queryable interface that calls curated action tools and retrieval functions. We evaluate the assistant on a query bank consisting of plan comparisons, feasibility, and lookup queries. Experiments show that 90.9% of the assistant's responses are faithful to the planner's outputs, a nearly 65% improvement over zero-shot prompting of the same LLM without tool access, demonstrating the potential for trustworthy explainability of uncertainty-aware traverses with an LLM-based system.
items.abstract_zh: 在概率不确定性下规划行星车轨迹是一个多目标优化问题，科学团队目前通过人工迭代求解和验证。当任务规划阶段时间线和约束频繁变化时，该过程变得不切实际。诸如蒙特卡洛树搜索的采样规划器可以加速这一过程，但其输出不保留对证明每个计划合理性的科学目标的可追溯性，而科学团队需要验证这种可追溯性。我们提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的交互式助手，能够使用领域词汇解释规划器轨迹，并在用户指定条件下重新运行规划器以比较备选方案。先前工作已在规划器决策循环内使用 LLM，但我们探索将其用于规划后解释；由于不直接影响规划器决策，它们更可能被信任。我们的框架将受 NASA 挥发物调查极地探测车（VIPER）任务启发的模拟器与 ReAct 可查询接口配对，该接口调用精选动作工具和检索函数。我们在由计划比较、可行性和查找查询组成的查询库上评估该助手。实验表明，助手 90.9% 的回复忠实于规划器输出，相较同一 LLM 在无工具访问下的零样本提示提升近 65%，展示了基于 LLM 的系统为不确定性感知穿越提供可信可解释性的潜力。

items.title_en: CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
items.title_zh: CroCoMAE：面向SAR-光学遥感数据的跨模态自监督协同表示学习
items.abstract_en: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. At the image level, an intra-modality contrastive loss on the class token yields globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives fine-grained per-modality representations, while a cross-modal contrastive objective aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the complementary subspace unconstrained to retain modality-specific information. On two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation, CroCoMAE improves over uni-modal SSL baselines and outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal frameworks in most configurations, with gains in both single-modality and multi-modal evaluation across varying label regimes and the largest improvements on semantic segmentation.
items.abstract_zh: 遥感正日益通过SAR和光学等互补传感器捕捉地球表面，但真实标注仍然稀缺，限制了监督式方法。自监督学习（SSL）缓解了标签稀缺问题，跨模态SSL进一步利用同址传感器之间的互补性，但现有跨模态框架大多通过全局图像级表示对齐模态，或将其视为基本冗余，导致其细粒度互补结构未被充分利用。我们提出CroCoMAE，一种面向SAR-光学遥感的跨模态SSL框架，在基于ViT的架构内统一对比学习与掩码图像建模，并在两个互补层面运行。在图像层面，对类别token施加模态内对比损失，产生全局判别性强、增强不变的表示。在图像块层面，掩码图像建模驱动每种模态的细粒度表示，而跨模态对比目标对齐SAR与光学图像块token之间的共享子空间，互补子空间不受约束以保留模态特定信息。在涵盖场景分类和语义分割的两个SAR-光学基准上，CroCoMAE优于单模态SSL基线，并在大多数配置下优于最先进的跨模态框架；在不同标签条件下，单模态和多模态评估均有提升，语义分割上的提升最大。

items.title_en: Dysregulated B Cell Education Drives Autoimmunity and Immunodeficiency in Down Syndrome
items.title_zh: B细胞教育失调驱动唐氏综合征中的自身免疫与免疫缺陷
items.abstract_en: Individuals with Down syndrome (DS) present with both increased rates of autoimmunity and immunodeficiency. To understand this paradox, we first examined lymph node (LN) architecture and immune cell composition in infants with and without DS, as well as peripheral blood B cells from unrelated adults with and without DS. Most strikingly, LNs from individuals with DS exhibited a marked paucity of germinal centers compared with typical lymph nodes. Stromal cells within DS LNs expressed significantly lower levels of the adhesion molecules ICAM1 and VCAM1, accompanied by significantly reduced CXCR5 expression within B cell follicles, suggesting impaired B cell migration and follicular organization. Although fibroblastic reticular cells (FRCs) were present at comparable frequencies in DS and control LNs, MARCO lymphatic endothelial cells (MARCO-LECs), another critical stromal cell population supporting LN architecture, were significantly reduced. In addition, follicular dendritic cells (FDCs), which are essential for antigen retention and B cell selection within germinal centers, were also substantially reduced. To determine the consequences of these abnormalities on humoral immunity, we performed paired single-cell RNA sequencing and V(D)J sequencing of peripheral blood B cells from adults with and without DS. DS memory and CD86 switched memory B cell populations exhibited significantly elevated reactive oxygen species and PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling gene signatures, coupled with reduced levels of somatic hypermutation in the memory population and increase usage of the autoreactivity-associated IGHV4-34 heavy-chain gene. Collectively, these findings suggest that early-life disruption of LN architecture, characterized by reduced expression of adhesion molecules, selective loss of MARCO-LECs, and depletion of FDCs, impairs germinal center function and B cell education. This defective microenvironment likely contributes to inadequate affinity maturation, as reflected by diminished somatic hypermutation and a more autoreactive B cell repertoire in adults with Down syndrome.
items.abstract_zh: 唐氏综合征（DS）个体表现出自身免疫和免疫缺陷发生率均升高。为理解这一悖论，我们首先检查了伴或不伴DS婴儿的淋巴结（LN）结构和免疫细胞组成，以及来自无亲缘关系的伴或不伴DS成人的外周血B细胞。最显著的是，与典型淋巴结相比，DS个体的LN显示出生发中心明显稀少。DS LN内的基质细胞表达显著更低水平的黏附分子ICAM1和VCAM1，同时B细胞滤泡内CXCR5表达显著降低，提示B细胞迁移和滤泡组织受损。尽管成纤维网状细胞（FRCs）在DS和对照LN中以相当频率存在，但另一种支持LN结构的关键基质细胞群体——MARCO淋巴管内皮细胞（MARCO-LECs）显著减少。此外，对生发中心内抗原保留和B细胞选择至关重要的滤泡树突状细胞（FDCs）也大幅减少。为确定这些异常对体液免疫的影响，我们对伴或不伴DS成人的外周血B细胞进行了配对单细胞RNA测序和V(D)J测序。DS记忆B细胞和CD86转换记忆B细胞群表现出显著升高的活性氧和PI3K-AKT-mTOR信号基因特征，同时记忆B细胞群体中体细胞超突变水平降低，并增加使用与自身反应性相关的IGHV4-34重链基因。总之，这些发现表明，生命早期LN结构破坏——以黏附分子表达降低、MARCO-LECs选择性丢失和FDCs耗竭为特征——损害生发中心功能和B细胞教育。这种缺陷的微环境可能促成亲和成熟不足，表现为DS成人中体细胞超突变减少和更具自身反应性的B细胞库。

items.title_en: High-sensitivity sensing technology of 10 MHz radio frequency electric field based on Rydberg atoms
items.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子的10 MHz射频电场高灵敏度传感技术
items.abstract_en: To address the pressing need for high-sensitivity, miniaturized electric field sensors in the short-wave communication band (3-30 MHz), this study proposes and demonstrates a radio frequency electric field quantum sensing scheme based on cesium atomic Rydberg states and the electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) effect. The scheme employs an all-infrared optical design, utilizing 852 nm probe light, 1470 nm dressing light, and 780 nm coupling light to efficiently prepare the 49P3/2 Rydberg state in a room-temperature cesium vapor cell, which is then probed non-destructively via ladder-type four-level EIT spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 为解决短波通信频段（3–30 MHz）对高灵敏度、小型化电场传感器的迫切需求，本研究提出并演示了一种基于铯原子里德堡态和电磁诱导透明（EIT）效应的射频电场量子传感方案。该方案采用全红外光学设计，利用852 nm探测光、1470 nm缀饰光和780 nm耦合光，在室温铯蒸气池中高效制备49P3/2里德堡态，随后通过梯形四能级EIT光谱对其进行非破坏性探测。

items.title_en: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
items.title_zh: 面向张量恢复的结构缓存加速双核张量轮分解
items.abstract_en: Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. This reuse reduces redundant computation and avoids the explicit construction of large matrices. Complexity analysis and experiments show that the strategy based on structural caching accelerates optimization compared with explicit and implicit up- date schemes while limiting the increase in peak memory as the ranks grow. Experiments on color video completion and robust denoising show that DCTW matches or outperforms representative tensor network methods in reconstruction quality, computational efficiency, and scalability.
items.abstract_zh: 张量轮分解通过外环因子与高阶中心核之间的交互捕捉高维数据中的复杂相关性。然而，更新这些组件需要显式构造和操作大规模矩阵，这限制了计算效率，并在中心核更新时带来尤其高的计算和内存开销。为解决这些局限，我们提出双核张量轮分解（DCTW），将中心核分解为两个较低阶核，并由共享的潜在键连接。每个核与不同组的外环因子耦合。我们进一步提出一种结构缓存加速策略，避免显式大规模矩阵乘法，并缓存张量网络收缩过程中生成的中间张量，以便在块更新间复用。这种复用减少了冗余计算，并避免显式构造大矩阵。复杂度分析和实验表明，随着秩增大，基于结构缓存的策略相比显式和隐式更新方案加速了优化，同时限制了峰值内存的增长。在彩色视频补全和鲁棒去噪上的实验表明，DCTW在重建质量、计算效率和可扩展性方面达到或优于代表性张量网络方法。

items.title_en: CaseLaw: A Policy-Decoupled Framework for Training-Free Content Moderation
items.title_zh: CaseLaw：一种策略解耦的无训练内容审核框架
items.abstract_en: Content moderation is inherently policy-dependent: moderation boundaries are often subtle, subjective, and frequently updated, while conventional rule based or fine-tuning based systems require costly rule rewriting, model retraining, or system redeployment. We propose CaseLaw, a policy-decoupled and training-free framework for adaptive content moderation. CaseLaw reformulates moderation as precedent-based retrieval and voting, where multimodal content is transformed into evidence-preserved structured semantics, embedded into a stable semantic space, and classified by thresholded voting over retrieved precedent labels. We train NoteCap on a large-scale corpus of structurally annotated notes to ensure consistent semantic extraction and freeze it during subsequent policy adaptation, which requires no additional training. Policy adaptation is achieved by updating the semantic case library, including case labels and mappings, without retraining models or modifying prompts. To evaluate CaseLaw, we construct MFO-RedNotes, a benchmark for the male-female opposition risk domain. We additionally provide a five category CoPro comparison. Experiments show that CaseLaw consistently outperforms competing baselines in both precision and recall across policy-dependent risk levels and broader safety categories, with category-wise precision/recall reaching up to 86.8%/90.1% on MFO-RedNotes across both policy settings and 94.5%/92.3% on CoPro. Our work highlights the potential of precedent-based reasoning for policy adaptive content moderation and offers a practical direction toward more stable, transparent, and training-free moderation systems.
items.abstract_zh: 内容审核本质上依赖策略：审核边界往往细微、主观且频繁更新，而传统基于规则或基于微调的系统需要昂贵的规则重写、模型再训练或系统重新部署。我们提出CaseLaw，一种用于自适应内容审核的策略解耦且免训练的框架。CaseLaw将审核重构为基于先例的检索与投票，其中多模态内容被转换为保留证据的结构化语义，嵌入稳定语义空间，并通过对检索到的先例标签进行阈值化投票进行分类。我们在大规模结构化标注笔记语料上训练NoteCap，以确保一致的语义提取，并在后续策略适应期间冻结它，无需额外训练。策略适应通过更新语义案例库（包括案例标签和映射）实现，而无需重新训练模型或修改提示。为评估CaseLaw，我们构建了MFO-RedNotes，一个面向男女对立风险领域的基准。我们还提供了五类别CoPro比较。实验表明，在依赖策略的风险水平和更广泛的安全类别上，CaseLaw在精确率和召回率上均持续优于竞争基线；在两种策略设置下，MFO-RedNotes上的类别精确率/召回率最高达86.8%/90.1%，CoPro上达94.5%/92.3%。我们的工作凸显了基于先例的推理用于策略自适应内容审核的潜力，并为更稳定、透明且免训练的审核系统提供了实用方向。

items.title_en: CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
items.title_zh: CSG-Nav：面向鲁棒探索与准确零样本物体目标导航的置信度感知语义-几何融合
items.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 零样本物体目标导航要求自主智能体在无任务特定训练的情况下探索未见环境并定位目标物体，这在观察不确定性下的感知可靠性和物理可依据的目标终止方面提出挑战。尽管基于基础模型的方法提高了泛化能力，但它们仍易受不可靠远距离感知、幻觉引发的方向偏差以及语义上合理但几何上不正确的停止决策影响。为解决这些局限，我们提出CSG-Nav，一种以置信度感知多模态信息融合为核心的零样本导航框架。CSG-Nav集成三种互补融合机制。首先，语义源融合整合开放词汇检测结果、检测置信度、场景观察和关系推理，以产生更可靠的方向级语义分数并抑制幻觉引发的方向偏差。其次，空间置信度融合使用高斯衰减函数对多视角语义证据加权，抑制不可靠的远距离观察，同时累积空间一致的探索偏好。第三，语义-几何决策融合将语义目标检测与基于深度的3D定位相结合，以支持物理可依据的停止决策。在HM3Dv1、HM3Dv2和MP3D上的实验展示了有竞争力的零样本性能，成功率分别为58.9%、71.6%和44.3%。融合级消融及室内外环境中的真实部署进一步验证了CSG-Nav在不确定感知下进行鲁棒导航的有效性和实用性。代码见 https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

items.title_en: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
items.title_zh: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割
items.abstract_en: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.
items.abstract_zh: 在开放世界识别中，机器学习模型不仅对未知结构进行预测（“广义开放集”），还会随时间从这些预测中持续学习并改进。交互式分割尽管能够获取用户反馈，但迄今仍局限于开放集设定。在本工作中，我们提出 MEOW，这是首个将非交互式分割骨干网络转变为交互式开放世界学习器的框架，且无需更新可学习模型参数。MEOW 将无参数直推式推理与记忆巩固相结合，以积累知识，从而提升未来性能。聚焦医学数据，我们表明 MEOW 在训练中从未见过的类别上持续改进自身预测，并能零样本迁移到不熟悉领域，包括 micro-CT 数据和其他成像模态。

items.title_en: Serum Raman spectroscopy as a blood-based triage test for bladder cancer: a retrospective proof-of-concept study
items.title_zh: 血清拉曼光谱作为膀胱癌的血液基分诊测试：一项回顾性概念验证研究
items.abstract_en: BackgroundBladder cancer remains one of the most common urological malignancies. Current diagnostic pathways rely heavily on cystoscopy, an invasive investigation with significant cost and resource implications. A rapid blood-based assay capable of improving patient stratification before cystoscopy could reduce unnecessary invasive investigations while maintaining diagnostic sensitivity. MethodsArchived serum samples from patients with histologically confirmed bladder cancer and symptomatic control subjects were analysed using dried-serum Raman spectroscopy. Raman spectra were incorporated into supervised machine-learning classification models to generate predicted probabilities of bladder cancer. Diagnostic performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis. ResultsThe study included 49 patients with bladder cancer and 97 symptomatic controls. Predicted probabilities of bladder cancer were substantially higher in cancer patients than in controls. The Raman classifier demonstrated excellent diagnostic discrimination (AUC approximately 0.90). Incorporation of age into the classification model produced little additional improvement (AUC approximately 0.91). ConclusionsMachine learning-assisted analysis of dried-serum Raman spectra demonstrates promising diagnostic performance for bladder cancer. Prospective evaluation is warranted to determine its role as a minimally invasive triage test within contemporary bladder cancer diagnostic pathways.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：膀胱癌仍是最常见的泌尿系统恶性肿瘤之一。当前诊断路径严重依赖膀胱镜检查，这是一种具有显著成本和资源影响的侵入性检查。一种能够在膀胱镜检查前改善患者分层的快速血液检测，可在保持诊断敏感性的同时减少不必要的侵入性检查。方法：使用干血清拉曼光谱分析组织学确诊的膀胱癌患者和有症状对照受试者的存档血清样本。将拉曼光谱纳入监督机器学习分类模型，以生成膀胱癌的预测概率。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估诊断性能。结果：研究纳入 49 例膀胱癌患者和 97 例有症状对照。膀胱癌预测概率在癌症患者中显著高于对照。拉曼分类器表现出极好的诊断判别能力（AUC 约 0.90）。将年龄纳入分类模型仅带来很小额外改善（AUC 约 0.91）。结论：机器学习辅助的干血清拉曼光谱分析显示出有前景的膀胱癌诊断性能。有必要进行前瞻性评估，以确定其在当代膀胱癌诊断路径中作为微创分诊检测的作用。

items.title_en: Thin-film lithium niobate integrated photonics at 493 nm
items.title_zh: 493 nm 薄膜铌酸锂集成光子学
items.abstract_en: Visible and near-ultraviolet light underpins applications from biophotonics to quantum computing, which demand fast control of optical amplitude and phase. Integrated photonics offers scalable control, yet most visible-wavelength platforms lack gigahertz-scale modulation. We demonstrate a thin-film lithium niobate platform at 493 nm integrating grating couplers, beamsplitters, ring resonators, and modulators. Segmented traveling-wave modulators achieve a half-wave voltage--length product of 450 mV$\cdot$cm, $>$20 dB extinction, and bandwidth beyond 50 GHz. Ring resonators show $2.9 \pm 0.2$ dB/cm propagation loss and quantify the platform's photorefractive response. This enables agile visible beam delivery for trapped-ion systems, although photorefraction and substrate uniformity remain key challenges to scaling.
items.abstract_zh: 可见光和近紫外光支撑从生物光子学到量子计算的应用，这些应用需要对光振幅和相位进行快速控制。集成光子学提供可扩展控制，但大多数可见波长平台缺乏吉赫兹级调制。我们展示了一个 493 nm 的薄膜铌酸锂平台，集成了光栅耦合器、分束器、环形谐振器和调制器。分段行波调制器实现 450 mV·cm 的半波电压-长度积、>20 dB 消光比和超过 50 GHz 的带宽。环形谐振器显示 2.9 ± 0.2 dB/cm 的传播损耗，并量化了平台的光折变响应。这为囚禁离子系统实现了灵活的可见光束传输，尽管光折变和衬底均匀性仍是扩展的关键挑战。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Building World Models from Intrinsic Motivation
items.title_zh: 从内在动机构建世界模型
items.abstract_en: In the absence of extrinsic rewards or task supervision, human behavior is guided by intrinsic motivation---neural signals that drive curiosity, creativity, play, and other essential facets of intelligence. Intrinsic motivation plays an important developmental role in building robust world models that enable generalization and adaptation. Yet existing studies leave open how a broad range of intrinsic motivations interacts with world-model representation learning to support downstream control. This limits our understanding of which intrinsically collected experiences build reusable models. To address these gaps, we integrate 24 intrinsic objectives, including established methods and explicit variants spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency, into a common model-based reinforcement learning framework. We evaluate the world models they build through zero-shot, few-shot, and multi-task control in locomotion, manipulation, and open-ended gaming environments, using three representation-learning strategies: observation reconstruction, latent prediction, and redundancy reduction. Curiosity-driven exploration with observation reconstruction yields the strongest aggregate family profile, although the best individual pairing depends on the experiment. In compositional vision-based tasks, intrinsic motivation derived from both episodic and lifelong novelty---providing a complementary memory to the world model's generic recurrent state---achieves the best zero-shot transfer and few-shot adaptation. These findings motivate designing intrinsic motivation and representation learning jointly. Our results demonstrate world models as a powerful tool for measuring the quality of intrinsically motivated experience, and positions intrinsic motivation as a key ingredient for building world models autonomously.
items.abstract_zh: 在缺乏外在奖励或任务监督时，人类行为由内在动机引导——这种神经信号驱动好奇心、创造力、玩耍以及智能的其他关键方面。内在动机在构建稳健世界模型方面发挥重要的发展作用，这些模型能够实现泛化和适应。然而，现有研究尚未阐明广泛的内在动机如何与世界模型表示学习相互作用以支持下游控制。这限制了我们对哪些内在动机收集的经验能够构建可复用模型的理解。为解决这些空白，我们将 24 个内在目标集成到一个共同的基于模型的强化学习框架中，包括已有方法和涵盖好奇心、熵与能力的显式变体。我们通过零样本、少样本和多任务控制，在运动、操作和开放式游戏环境中评估它们构建的世界模型，并使用三种表示学习策略：观测重建、潜在预测和冗余减少。采用观测重建的好奇心驱动探索产生最强的总体家族表现，尽管最佳个体配对取决于实验。在组合式基于视觉的任务中，源自情景新颖性和终身新颖性的内在动机——为世界模型的通用循环状态提供补充记忆——实现最佳的零样本迁移和少样本适应。这些发现促使联合设计内在动机和表示学习。我们的结果表明，世界模型是衡量内在动机经验质量的有力工具，并将内在动机定位为自主构建世界模型的关键要素。

items.title_en: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
items.title_zh: ScrapeBench：评估 AI 智能体在网站抓取中的法律合规性
items.abstract_en: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and $\texttt{robots.txt}$ directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and $\texttt{robots.txt}$, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.
items.abstract_zh: 部署在开放网络上的 AI 智能体越来越有能力执行可能违反合同条款和违反计算机安全法的行为。在本文中，我们介绍 ScrapeBench，这是首个用于实证评估 AI 智能体对网站抓取政策（即服务条款（ToS）和 robots.txt 指令）法律合规性的智能体基准。在广泛使用的闭权重和开权重 AI 智能体中，我们发现，在我们样本中 1,626 个明确禁止抓取的流行网站上，当被指示抓取网站时，大多数智能体表现出低合规率（< 5%）。此外，我们观察到，即使 AI 智能体主动检查适用的 ToS 和 robots.txt，它们仍继续表现出低合规率。相反，在我们样本中 269 个不禁止抓取的网站上，我们观察到智能体有时尽管抓取合法却拒绝抓取，例如 Claude Opus 4.6 表现出 98.5% 的过度拒绝率。我们的人类基线实验（n = 180 名参与者）表明，人类表现出与 AI 智能体相当的合规率，但过度拒绝率要高得多。

items.title_en: Gaussian Process-Augmented Model Predictive Contouring Control for 6-DoF Trajectory Tracking with a Holonomic AUV
items.title_zh: 高斯过程增强的模型预测轮廓控制用于全向 AUV 的 6 自由度轨迹跟踪
items.abstract_en: Small, holonomic Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) enable close-range inspection of underwater structures from arbitrary viewpoints, requiring accurate position and attitude tracking under state and input constraints. Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) naturally handles these requirements, but relies on an accurate dynamics model, which is difficult to obtain underwater. In this paper, we present a nonlinear MPCC in all six Degrees of Freedom (DoF) for a holonomic AUV and alleviate the inaccuracies in the dynamics by augmenting the nominal model employed with residual dynamics learned via Gaussian Process (GP) regression. The learned residual is embedded in the optimal control problem through a zero-order robust optimization scheme, which keeps the controller real-time capable at 25 Hz. A simulation ablation shows that residual selection is essential when designing the controller, and simulation and in-water experiments with the Multimodality, Observing, Low-cost, Agile (MOLA) AUV validate the resulting controllers against a nominal MPCC and a field proven Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller.
items.abstract_zh: 小型全向自主水下航行器（AUV）能够从任意视角对水下结构进行近距离检查，需要在状态和输入约束下进行精确的位置和姿态跟踪。模型预测轮廓控制（MPCC）自然能够处理这些需求，但依赖准确的动力学模型，而该模型在水下难以获得。在本文中，我们提出一种用于全向 AUV 的全六自由度非线性 MPCC，并通过将所采用的标称模型与通过高斯过程（GP）回归学习到的残差动力学相结合，来缓解动力学中的不准确性。学习到的残差通过零阶鲁棒优化方案嵌入最优控制问题，使控制器能够以 25 Hz 保持实时能力。仿真消融表明，残差选择在设计控制器时至关重要；并且使用多模态、观测、低成本、敏捷（MOLA）AUV 进行的仿真和水下实验，将所得控制器与标称 MPCC 和经过现场验证的比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器进行了验证。

items.title_en: Adapting a Vision Foundation Model for Fracture Characterization in Acoustic Image Logs
items.title_zh: 将视觉基础模型适配用于声波成像测井中的裂缝表征
items.abstract_en: Natural fractures (NFs) and drilling-induced tensile fractures (DITFs) in acoustic image logs provide insights into rock mass structure and in situ stress, but manual characterization is time-consuming. Deep learning can automate this task, although expert-labeled data are scarce. We investigate whether adapting a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM) outperforms task-specific models trained from scratch with limited annotations. Using 80 annotated acoustic image samples, we fine-tuned DINOv3, pretrained on satellite imagery, and evaluated it on four boreholes excluded from fine-tuning. The adapted model estimated NF and DITF parameters comparably to human interpretation. Relative to U-Net, YOLOv8, and Swin Transformer models trained from scratch, it yielded fewer false positives and negatives and more accurate fracture counts and orientations. However, its performance advantage generally narrowed as training sample size decreased. We also assessed decoder architecture, fine-tuning strategy, and image enhancement. A progressive upsampling decoder with full fine-tuning performed best among the DINOv3 configurations tested, while fracture-focused image enhancement did not consistently improve accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of VFM adaptation for fracture characterization in acoustic image logs with limited labeled data and suggest a transferable workflow for other annotation-scarce geoscientific imaging tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 声波成像测井中的天然裂缝（NFs）和钻井诱导张性裂缝（DITFs）可为岩体结构和原位应力提供信息，但人工表征耗时。深度学习可自动完成此任务，尽管专家标注数据稀缺。我们研究在标注有限时，适配预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）是否优于从头训练的任务专用模型。使用80个标注声波图像样本，我们微调了在卫星影像上预训练的DINOv3，并在未参与微调的四个钻孔上评估。适配模型估计NF和DITF参数与人工解释相当。相对于从头训练的U-Net、YOLOv8和Swin Transformer模型，它产生更少的假阳性和假阴性，裂缝计数和方位更准确。然而，其性能优势通常随训练样本量减少而缩小。我们还评估了解码器架构、微调策略和图像增强。在测试的DINOv3配置中，带完全微调的渐进上采样解码器表现最佳，而以裂缝为中心的图像增强并未持续提高准确率。这些结果表明VFM适配在标注数据有限的声波成像测井裂缝表征中的潜力，并提出了可迁移的工作流程用于其他标注稀缺的地球科学成像任务。

items.title_en: Persistent or recurrent depression in young adults: associations with systemic inflammation and early life adversity.
items.title_zh: 青年期持续性或复发性抑郁：与全身性炎症和早期生活逆境的关联
items.abstract_en: Background There is limited research on persistent or recurrent depression into young adulthood. We examined the prevalence of recurrent/persistent depression in young adults, and associations with childhood trauma/adversity and systemic inflammation, and if inflammatory markers mediated associations between childhood trauma and subsequent depression. Methods ALSPAC participants with ICD-10 depression assessments at ages 18, 24 and 30 were classified as never depressed, transiently depressed (one episode), or persistently/recurrently depressed ([≥] 2). Trauma/adversity from birth to age 16/17 was characterised by type, timing and burden. Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and C-reactive protein (CRP) were measured at ages 9, 16, 18 and 24. Analyses used multinomial logistic regression, linear regression and causal mediation models. Results Among 2,014 participants, 78.9% were never depressed, 15.0% had transient depression and 6.1% had persistent/recurrent depression. Trauma/adversity was more strongly associated with persistent/recurrent depression (RRR 3.17, 95% CI 1.98-5.06; FDR-P=6.2x10^-6) than transient depression, with a dose-response pattern and stronger associations for threat adversities. Middle-to-late childhood (11-17 yrs) emerged as a sensitive period for persistent/recurrent (RRR 2.85, 95% CI 1.47-5.52) and transient depression (RRR 1.85, 95% CI 1.25-2.73). Trauma/adversity was associated with modestly higher IL-6 at age 24 (all FDR-adjusted P < 0.05); CRP associations did not survive multiple-testing correction. Neither marker mediated trauma/adversity associations with persistent/recurrent depression. Conclusion Persistent/recurrent depression affects approximately 1 in 20 young adults. Childhood trauma/adversity, particularly during middle-to-late childhood, was associated with persistent/recurrent depression, but measured inflammatory proteins did not mediate this association. Further work is needed to understand biological mechanisms underlying the embedding early life psychosocial stress.
items.abstract_zh: 背景 关于持续至青年期的持续性或复发性抑郁研究有限。我们考察了青年人中复发性/持续性抑郁的患病率，及其与童年创伤/逆境和全身性炎症的关联，并检验炎症标志物是否介导童年创伤与后续抑郁之间的关联。方法 在18、24和30岁时具有ICD-10抑郁评估的ALSPAC参与者被分类为从未抑郁、短暂性抑郁（一次发作）或持续性/复发性抑郁（≥2次）。从出生到16/17岁的创伤/逆境按类型、发生时间和负担进行表征。在9、16、18和24岁时测量白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和C反应蛋白（CRP）。分析使用多项逻辑回归、线性回归和因果中介模型。结果 在2,014名参与者中，78.9%从未抑郁，15.0%有短暂性抑郁，6.1%有持续性/复发性抑郁。创伤/逆境与持续性/复发性抑郁的关联强于与短暂性抑郁的关联（RRR 3.17，95% CI 1.98–5.06；FDR-P=6.2×10^-6），呈剂量-反应模式，且对威胁性逆境的关联更强。童年中后期（11–17岁）成为持续性/复发性抑郁（RRR 2.85，95% CI 1.47–5.52）和短暂性抑郁（RRR 1.85，95% CI 1.25–2.73）的敏感期。创伤/逆境与24岁时IL-6轻度升高相关（所有FDR校正P < 0.05）；CRP关联未通过多重检验校正。两种标志物均未介导创伤/逆境与持续性/复发性抑郁的关联。结论 持续性/复发性抑郁影响约1/20的青年人。童年创伤/逆境，尤其是童年中后期，与持续性/复发性抑郁相关，但所测炎症蛋白未介导这一关联。需要进一步研究以理解早期生活心理社会应激嵌入的生物学机制。

items.title_en: Finite-Key Readiness and Authentication-Key Replenishment in QKD-Assisted UAV Edge Computing
items.title_zh: QKD辅助无人机边缘计算中的有限密钥就绪性与认证密钥补充
items.abstract_en: A service that needs fresh quantum keys must wait for key release, and may be denied it, before protected computation starts. We quantify this cost for a trusted stationary UAV serving two ground gateways, each obtaining its keys from one finite-key decoy-state BB84 attempt with parameters fixed in advance. A count-level Monte Carlo model, reproduced by a semi-analytic model, links key acceptance to protected upload, computation, and download, including failed attempts and hover energy. At 26~dB effective optical loss, with authentication hashing at its proxy-benchmarked, near-zero cost, fresh keys raise the 95th-percentile completion time of both tasks from 10.37 to 28.65~s; hover energy grows in proportion. The scalar rate models evaluated here miss the deadline limit on the block size. The pulse budget lies in a window bounded below by authentication-key replenishment and above by the deadline; for a fixed source, channel, and acceptance model, the authentication debit shifts the floor, whereas hashing cost does not. At a 35-s deadline the largest tested loss with a non-empty window is 27~dB at 1\% misalignment and 22~dB at 2\%; at 3\% no tested setting has one. Conditional on the assumed acquisition probability, the selected configurations meet this deadline with simultaneous lower confidence bounds of 96.9--97.3\% on held-out trials, at 26~dB and at 18--20~dB with 2\% misalignment. A high-cost stress reference that charges hashing in full narrows the window and lowers these loss limits to 26 and 20~dB at the reference processing capacity. A small rise in error rate or loss pushes the deadline probability well below its target and drains authentication keys, while the protocol's security parameter is unchanged.
items.abstract_zh: 需要新量子密钥的服务必须等待密钥释放，并且可能被拒绝，之后受保护计算才能开始。我们针对一个可信固定无人机为两个地面网关服务量化这一成本，每个网关通过一次参数预先固定的有限密钥诱骗态BB84尝试获取其密钥。一个计数级蒙特卡洛模型，由半解析模型复现，将密钥接受与受保护上传、计算和下载联系起来，包括失败尝试和悬停能量。在26 dB有效光学损耗下，认证哈希按其代理基准的近零成本计，新密钥将两个任务的95百分位完成时间从10.37秒提高到28.65秒；悬停能量成比例增长。此处评估的标量速率模型忽略了块大小上的截止时间限制。脉冲预算位于一个窗口内，其下界由认证密钥补充决定，上界由截止时间决定；对于固定源、信道和接受模型，认证扣减移动下界，而哈希成本则不会。在35秒截止时间下，具有非空窗口的最大测试损耗在1%失配时为27 dB，在2%时为22 dB；在3%时没有测试设置具有非空窗口。在假定获取概率的条件下，所选配置在留出试验中以96.9–97.3%的同时下置信界满足该截止时间，分别在26 dB以及2%失配下的18–20 dB。一个全额计入哈希成本的高成本压力参考收窄了窗口，并在参考处理能力下将这些损耗限值降低到26和20 dB。误差率或损耗的小幅上升会将截止时间概率推至远低于其目标，并耗尽认证密钥，而协议的安全参数保持不变。

items.title_en: Target Selection with a Disappearing-Stimulus Mixed-Reality P300 Interface: Feasibility and Object-Distinguishable Versus Uniform Cues
items.title_zh: 使用消失刺激混合现实P300接口的目标选择：可行性与物体可区分线索对比统一线索
items.abstract_en: Mixed-reality (MR) P300 interfaces can register selectable destinations, such as wheelchair goals, directly in the user's surroundings. When the cues disappear between flashes, however, the user must retain an intended target that is no longer visible. We tested whether such an interface supports target selection and whether giving each cue a stable colour-shape identity improves it compared with visually uniform spheres. Six healthy adults completed four trials in each cue condition of a 5x5 row/column task on a head-mounted MR display, with EEG from Fz, Cz, and Pz. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis was evaluated with nested validation in which complete trials were held out from class balancing, hyperparameter selection, and fitting. Both conditions evoked a parietal target-related positivity. The decoded cell was correct in 18 of 48 held-out trials, against 1.9 expected by chance (binomial p < 1e-12), and in three participants individually. Cue format made no detectable difference: complete-target accuracy was 9/24 in both conditions (paired difference 0.0 percentage points, 95% CI [-37, 37]), and held-out AUC was 0.609 for spheres and 0.585 for object cues. Disappearing-stimulus MR P300 selection is therefore feasible under strict trial-level evaluation, but the benefit of object identity, if any, is too small to resolve in a pilot of this size.
items.abstract_zh: 混合现实（MR）P300接口可直接在用户周围环境中登记可选目的地，例如轮椅目标。然而，当线索在闪烁之间消失时，用户必须保持一个已不可见的预期目标。我们测试了这种接口是否支持目标选择，以及为每个线索赋予稳定的颜色-形状身份相比视觉上统一的球体是否能改善目标选择。六名健康成人在头戴式MR显示器的5×5行列任务中，在每种线索条件下完成四次试验，并采集Fz、Cz和Pz的EEG。收缩线性判别分析采用嵌套验证评估，其中完整试验被留出，不参与类别平衡、超参数选择和拟合。两种条件均诱发顶叶目标相关正电位。解码单元格在48次留出试验中有18次正确，而随机期望为1.9次（二项检验p < 1e-12），并在三名参与者中分别成立。线索格式未产生可检测差异：完整目标准确率在两种条件下均为9/24（配对差异0.0个百分点，95% CI [-37, 37]），留出AUC对球体为0.609，对物体线索为0.585。因此，消失刺激MR P300选择在严格的试次级评估下是可行的，但物体身份的益处（如果有）太小，无法在此规模的试点研究中分辨。

items.title_en: Are Dense Rewards Worth Their Tokens in GRPO?
items.title_zh: 在GRPO中，稠密奖励值得其消耗的token吗？
items.abstract_en: RLVR trains language models to reason by rewarding correct final answers. A widely used algorithm, group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), gives every token of a solution the same credit, so dense process rewards have been proposed to credit intermediate steps, for example with a Monte-Carlo reward that scores each step by sampling continuations from it. Comparing such a reward with GRPO per training update, or vetting it with a gradient test on a single batch, leaves out what it costs: in our setting, the continuations alone take 91% of all generated tokens. We introduce a matched-compute protocol that gives every training intervention the same budget, measured in generated tokens and training GPU-hours, and tests it in preregistered studies with controls for side effects. Across 1,668 runs on six models, matching compute reverses the ranking. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, the Monte-Carlo reward leads standard GRPO per update, yet ends 14.3 percentage points lower at equal tokens and 7.8 points lower at equal training time, and none of four dense-reward variants outperforms GRPO even with as much training time. A per-token gradient test orders these rewards as training does but overestimates each by one to two points, as much as the gains it is meant to detect. In contrast, training on the prompts whose predicted success is nearest 1/2 improves accuracy at matched compute, by 1.7 points on Qwen3-0.6B and 0.8 on Qwen2.5-1.5B. These gains replicate on fresh seeds and unseen problems, and a simple rule, that the candidate prompts are predicted to fail more often than not, predicted where they appear in five of six preregistered tests. Both gains come early in training, and standard GRPO with twice the initial learning rate comes within half a point of them. We argue that training interventions should be validated at matched compute, which overturns some apparent gains and confirms others.
items.abstract_zh: RLVR通过奖励正确的最终答案来训练语言模型进行推理。一种广泛使用的算法——组相对策略优化（GRPO）——给解决方案的每个token相同信用，因此有人提出稠密过程奖励来为中间步骤记功，例如使用蒙特卡洛奖励，通过从某一步采样续写来为该步打分。将这种奖励与GRPO按每次训练更新进行比较，或在单个批次上用梯度检验审查它，都忽略了其成本：在我们的设置中，仅续写就占所有生成token的91%。我们引入一种匹配计算量协议，使每种训练干预获得相同预算，以生成token和训练GPU小时计量，并在预注册研究中测试，同时控制副作用。在六个模型上的1,668次运行中，匹配计算量逆转了排名。在Qwen2.5-1.5B上，蒙特卡洛奖励在每次更新上领先标准GRPO，但在等token下最终低14.3个百分点，在等训练时间下低7.8个百分点；即使训练时间相同，四种稠密奖励变体也均未优于GRPO。逐token梯度检验对这些奖励的排序与训练一致，但将每个高估一到两个百分点，与其旨在检测的增益相当。相比之下，在预测成功率最接近1/2的提示上训练，在匹配计算量下提高准确率：Qwen3-0.6B上提高1.7个百分点，Qwen2.5-1.5B上提高0.8个百分点。这些增益在新随机种子和未见问题上可复现，并且一个简单规则——候选提示被预测为更可能失败而非成功——在六项预注册测试中的五项预测了它们出现的位置。两种增益都出现在训练早期，而初始学习率加倍的标准GRPO与其差距在半分以内。我们认为训练干预应在匹配计算量下验证，这推翻了一些表面增益并确认了另一些。

items.title_en: RedirectMimic: Local Motion Content Redaction for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
items.title_zh: RedirectMimic：用于人形全身控制的局部运动内容遮蔽
items.abstract_en: Humanoid motion interfaces should accommodate application-specific movement constraints while retaining useful reference behavior. Local content redaction requires a controller to replace selected movements even when it continues to receive the original reference. Removing the tracking incentive for those movements leaves their replacement unspecified. We introduce RedirectMimic, which separates the reference observed by the actor from the target used to train its execution. A rule-generated edited reference guides tracking rewards during proximal policy optimization, while the deployed observation and action interfaces remain unchanged. We evaluate pose- and speed-defined arm editing in Unitree G1 simulation using a tracker pretrained on 7,509 motion clips. On the overhead-arm task, RedirectMimic reduces core-window content occurrence to 2.7%, compared with 58.9% for reward zeroing and 32.8% for anti-tracking. It achieves 94.2% core-window joint success, combining content suppression, fall-free execution, and local retention. On the speed-defined task, fast outward arm movements occurred at similarly low rates under all three local editing methods. Across both tasks, RedirectMimic achieved the lowest replacement error among these methods and tracked unedited motions with accuracy comparable to that of the pretrained controller. Project page: https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/.
items.abstract_zh: 人形运动接口应适应应用特定的运动约束，同时保留有用的参考行为。局部内容遮蔽要求控制器替换选定运动，即使它继续接收原始参考。移除对这些运动的跟踪激励会使其替换方式未被指定。我们提出RedirectMimic，它将执行器观察到的参考与用于训练其执行的目标分离。规则生成的编辑参考在近端策略优化过程中引导跟踪奖励，而部署时的观测和动作接口保持不变。我们在Unitree G1仿真中评估姿态定义和速度定义的手臂编辑，使用在7,509个运动片段上预训练的跟踪器。在举过头顶手臂任务中，RedirectMimic将核心窗口内容出现率降至2.7%，而奖励置零为58.9%，反跟踪为32.8%。它实现94.2%的核心窗口关节成功率，结合了内容抑制、无跌倒执行和局部保留。在速度定义任务中，三种局部编辑方法下快速向外手臂运动的发生率均相似地低。在两个任务中，RedirectMimic在这些方法中实现最低替换误差，并以与预训练控制器相当的准确率跟踪未编辑运动。项目页面：https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/。

items.title_en: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
items.title_zh: 用于青光眼检测的带条件熵的证据深度学习
items.abstract_en: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的条件熵函数，作为量化视网膜眼底图像青光眼检测中证据深度学习（EDL）预测不确定性的基础。使用 EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 和 RIM-ONE-DL 数据集进行验证，我们发现，由条件熵函数正则化的所提 EDL 模型产生的不确定性估计，其校准误差显著低于 Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准以及基于 Dempster 不确定性的传统 EDL 框架。为进一步探查模型的可解释性，我们使用表示空间集中度的聚焦指数分析 Grad-CAM 热图。与其他不确定性量化方法相比，EDL 模型在正确分类与错误分类眼底图像的指数分布之间表现出更大的分离。特别是，假阴性对应于从视盘移位的局部 Grad-CAM 激活，这与视盘在青光眼评估中已确立的临床重要性一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明，所提用于青光眼检测的 EDL 框架不仅提供增强的不确定性校准，而且具有更符合生理学的可解释性。

items.title_en: Near point of care C-Reactive Protein and Serum Amyloid-A Test met WHO target product profile for TB screening
items.title_zh: 近即时检验的C反应蛋白和血清淀粉样蛋白-A检测满足WHO结核病筛查目标产品概况
items.abstract_en: Background: TB eradication strategies in high burden countries need affordable, scalable, and accessible screening tools. This study investigated the diagnostic accuracy of C-reactive protein (CRP), serum amyloid A (SAA), and interferon gamma-induced protein 10 (IP-10) as potential screening tools. Methods. This cross-sectional diagnostic study investigated stored archived serum samples from three groups of subjects; bacteriology confirmed symptomatic TB group (n=57), probable TB (n=56) and healthy controls (n=60). CRP and SAA concentrations were measured using near point-of-care fluorescence immunoassay (NPOCT-FIA), while IP-10 was measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Diagnostic performance of individual and combined biomarkers was evaluated Results Receiver operating characteristic analysis demonstrated excellent diagnostic performance of serum amyloid A (SAA) and C-reactive protein (CRP) for identifying confirmed tuberculosis (TB). Compared with probable TB and healthy controls, SAA achieved an AUC of 0.961 (cut-off >31.0 mg/L), with 96.5% sensitivity and 88.6% specificity, while CRP achieved an AUC of 0.953 (cut-off 21.3 mg/L), with 96.5% sensitivity and 86.0% specificity. Interferon gamma-induced protein 10 (IP-10) showed poor discrimination (AUC 0.545). Combined CRP and SAA achieved 100.0% sensitivity and 83.3% specificity. Conclusion: SAA and CRP met WHO target product profile criteria for TB triage screening.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：高负担国家的结核病消除策略需要可负担、可扩展且可及的筛查工具。本研究调查了C反应蛋白（CRP）、血清淀粉样蛋白A（SAA）和干扰素γ诱导蛋白10（IP-10）作为潜在筛查工具的诊断准确性。方法：这项横断面诊断研究调查了三组受试者的储存归档血清样本：细菌学确诊的有症状结核病组（n=57）、疑似结核病组（n=56）和健康对照（n=60）。CRP和SAA浓度使用近即时检验荧光免疫分析（NPOCT-FIA）测量，而IP-10使用酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）测量。评估了单个和联合生物标志物的诊断性能。结果：受试者工作特征分析显示，SAA和CRP在识别确诊结核病方面具有优异的诊断性能。与疑似结核病组和健康对照相比，SAA达到AUC 0.961（截断值>31.0 mg/L），敏感性96.5%，特异性88.6%；CRP达到AUC 0.953（截断值21.3 mg/L），敏感性96.5%，特异性86.0%。IP-10区分能力差（AUC 0.545）。CRP和SAA联合达到100.0%敏感性和83.3%特异性。结论：SAA和CRP满足WHO结核病分诊筛查的目标产品概况标准。

items.title_en: Angle-Resolved Reflectance Measurements in the Vacuum Ultraviolet for Metallic Samples
items.title_zh: 金属样品在真空紫外波段的角度分辨反射率测量
items.abstract_en: The light yield of noble-element scintillation detectors depends strongly on the reflective properties of detector materials in the vacuum ultraviolet (VUV), where optical measurements are scarce. For this reason, we built a custom rotary setup at IFIC, equipped with a monochromator and operated in a gaseous argon atmosphere, to perform angle-resolved reflectance measurements in the specular reflection plane. We describe the setup and its extensive characterization, together with the procedure used to measure the bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) of materials at various angles of incidence, for wavelengths from 128 to 500 nm, covering both the argon (128 nm) and xenon (175 nm) scintillation wavelengths. To illustrate the capabilities of the setup, we present results for rough aluminum and stainless-steel surfaces as reference materials. Fitting the measured angular profiles with the analytical GGX microfacet model allows us to extract the real and imaginary parts of the refractive index and the surface roughness parameter of each sample. These parameters are then used to extrapolate the in-plane measurements to the full hemisphere and from gaseous argon to liquid media, enabling the inference of the hemispherical reflectance in gaseous argon, liquid argon and liquid xenon.
items.abstract_zh: 惰性元素闪烁探测器的光产额强烈依赖于探测器材料在真空紫外（VUV）中的反射特性，而该波段的光学测量很少。为此，我们在IFIC搭建了一套定制的旋转装置，配备单色仪并在气态氩气氛下运行，用于在镜面反射平面内进行角度分辨反射率测量。我们描述了该装置及其广泛表征，以及在128至500 nm波长范围内、以不同入射角测量材料双向反射分布函数（BRDF）所采用的流程，该波长范围覆盖氩（128 nm）和氙（175 nm）闪烁波长。为说明该装置的能力，我们给出了粗糙铝和不锈钢表面作为参考材料的结果。用解析GGX微表面模型拟合测量的角度分布，使我们能够提取每个样品的折射率实部和虚部以及表面粗糙度参数。随后，这些参数被用于将面内测量外推到整个半球，并从气态氩外推到液态介质，从而能够推断气态氩、液氩和液氙中的半球反射率。

items.title_en: When Covariance Is Not Enough: Kernel-Based Regularization for Single-Cell Counterfactuals
items.title_zh: 当协方差不够时：面向单细胞反事实的基于核的正则化
items.abstract_en: Counterfactual editing of single cells, predicting how an observed cell would look had one factor been different, enables in-silico screening where experiments are infeasible, but is useful only if the edit is faithful to the individual and not merely to the condition. Concept bottleneck generative models make the effects of interventions interpretable by decomposing a cell's representation into known and unknown factors. Previous work uses a linear cross-covariance penalty to disentangle known and unknown dimensions. We demonstrate that this first-order criterion does not fully separate information when non-linear interactions are present. We first demonstrate the inadequacy of linear cross-factor penalization with simulation experiments with controlled edits and known non-linear covariate effects. We then demonstrate that adding a nonlinear kernel criterion, the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, is able to recover the true intervention effects on simulation data. Finally, we apply the non-linear concept bottleneck model to a complex single-cell RNA-seq dataset and find that it improves the ability to generate counterfactual expression profiles of cells under different tissue environments.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞的反事实编辑——预测若某一因素不同，观察到的细胞会呈现何种状态——使得在实验不可行时能够进行计算机筛选，但只有当编辑忠实于个体而不仅仅忠实于条件时才有用。概念瓶颈生成模型通过将细胞表示分解为已知和未知因素，使干预效应具有可解释性。先前工作使用线性交叉协方差惩罚来解耦已知和未知维度。我们证明，当存在非线性交互时，这种一阶准则不能完全分离信息。我们首先通过具有受控编辑和已知非线性协变量效应的模拟实验，证明线性跨因素惩罚的不足。然后我们证明，加入非线性核准则——归一化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则——能够在模拟数据上恢复真实干预效应。最后，我们将非线性概念瓶颈模型应用于复杂的单细胞RNA-seq数据集，发现它提高了生成不同组织环境下细胞反事实表达谱的能力。

items.title_en: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
items.title_zh: 盲式变异、选择性保留：改进AI科学家的创造性想法生成
items.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.
items.abstract_zh: 科学发现需要具有原创性、有用且非显而易见的想法。然而，AI科学家在想法生成过程中通常被给予尽可能多的任务信息，这可能使生成锚定于熟悉的方法。受盲式变异与选择性保留（BVSR）认知框架启发，我们提出一种发现框架，将信息的这两种作用分开：在刻意限制的任务信息下生成提案以拓宽探索，然后从同一任务上先前验证过的提案及其结果中学习，以保留有前景的候选方案用于昂贵的实证评估。我们在五个提案模型和12项科学任务上评估BVSR。限制任务信息大幅提高了提案的原创性和非显而易见性，并比现有最先进的基于提示的基线产生更大比例的高创造性和高效用提案。从任务上先前提案结果中学习进一步改进候选选择，丢弃一半候选方案，同时保留大多数表现最佳的提案。当纳入现有AI科学家工作流程时，BVSR在基因表达分析、药物反应预测、异常检测、标度律发现和脑活动预测中取得更强的发现。这些结果表明，有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段以不同方式使用信息：在探索期间约束任务特定信息，同时利用任务上积累的实证经验。

items.title_en: Oscillatory Processing Units as a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence
items.title_zh: 振荡处理单元作为仿生智能的计算基底
items.abstract_en: Biological intelligence emerges from neural activity that connects sensation, memory and action. Synaptic plasticity, neuronal assemblies and oscillations provide principles for biomimetic computing, but translating them into reusable operations requires a defined computational unit. We introduce Oscillatory Processing Units (OPUs), groups of synthetic neurons sharing a rhythm. Their directed interactions transform incoming activity and prior receiving state into an Oscillatory Occupancy Space (OOS), which becomes available to subsequent computation. We show that source--receiver conditions and oscillatory organization shape these transformations, including their geometry, persistence and historical accessibility. An Atlas of measured relationships supports prospective composition with predicted response classes. Configured circuits perform logical and numerical operations, express associative recall and generate closed-loop decisions with fixed synaptic weights. OPUs and OOS establish a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence in which experience remains part of the state through which new input becomes action.
items.abstract_zh: 生物智能源于连接感觉、记忆和行动的神经活动。突触可塑性、神经元组装和振荡为仿生计算提供了原理，但将其转化为可复用操作需要一个定义明确的计算单元。我们引入振荡处理单元（OPUs），即共享节律的合成神经元组。它们的有向交互将传入活动和先前接收状态转换为振荡占用空间（OOS），该空间可供后续计算使用。我们表明，源-接收者条件和振荡组织塑造这些转换，包括其几何结构、持续性和历史可及性。一个测量关系图谱支持带有预测响应类别的预期组合。配置好的电路以固定突触权重执行逻辑和数值运算、表达联想回忆并生成闭环决策。OPUs和OOS建立了仿生智能的计算基底，其中经验仍然是状态的一部分，新输入通过该状态转化为行动。

items.title_en: Measuring Robustness and Efficiency in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual System Model: Linking an Adversarial and a Perceptual Illusion
items.title_zh: 连接组约束的果蝇视觉系统模型中的鲁棒性与效率测量：将对抗性与知觉错觉联系起来
items.abstract_en: Biological visual systems compute reliably under tight metabolic and wiring constraints, whereas artificial vision systems consume far more energy and can be sensitive to adversarial perturbations. Whether networks with brain-like wiring are more robust at lower computational cost is unclear. We address this by benchmarking a task-optimized, continuous-time recurrent neural network of the fly visual system constrained by its synaptic connectome (FlyNet) against artificial neural networks. We compare it against CNNs, RAFT, and continuous-time recurrent neural networks without detailed connectome constraints (sCTRNN, CTRNN) on a collision-detection task within a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline. FlyNet is adversarially vulnerable but, relative to its compute, more robust to common video corruptions than RAFT, while using up to five orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs. The CTRNNs remain more robust than FlyNet across almost all tested perturbations, suggesting that connectome constraints benefit efficiency, through their low edge count, over robustness. Recurrence improves robustness to white-box attacks in RAFT and temporal context improves robustness to common corruptions. FlyNet's position and velocity representations degrade under adversarial textures but recover under counterfactual textures that restore correct classification while staying equally far from training, ruling out unfamiliar textures as the cause of failure. The reverse-phi illusion similarly disrupts these representations and inverts the same low-level motion statistic as the adversarial textures. Optimizing this input statistic alone, without access to the network, suffices to induce classification failure, attributing both perturbations to the same circuit vulnerability. Connectome-constrained models can thus surface adversarial failure mechanisms as testable hypotheses about biological perceptual vulnerabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 生物视觉系统在严格的代谢和布线约束下可靠计算，而人工视觉系统消耗更多能量且可能对对抗扰动敏感。具有类脑布线的网络是否在更低计算成本下更鲁棒尚不清楚。我们通过将受突触连接组约束、任务优化的果蝇视觉系统连续时间递归神经网络（FlyNet）与人工神经网络进行基准测试来研究此问题。我们在可微3D渲染管线中的碰撞检测任务上，将其与CNN、RAFT以及无详细连接组约束的连续时间递归神经网络（sCTRNN、CTRNN）比较。FlyNet 对对抗攻击脆弱，但相对于其计算量，对常见视频损坏比 RAFT 更鲁棒，同时使用的 FLOPs 最多少五个数量级。CTRNN 在几乎所有测试扰动下仍比 FlyNet 更鲁棒，表明连接组约束通过其低边数有利于效率而非鲁棒性。递归提高了 RAFT 对白盒攻击的鲁棒性，时间上下文提高了对常见损坏的鲁棒性。FlyNet 的位置和速度表征在对抗纹理下退化，但在反事实纹理下恢复——这些纹理在保持与训练集同等距离的同时恢复正确分类，从而排除了不熟悉纹理作为失败原因。反向phi错觉同样破坏这些表征，并反转与对抗纹理相同的低层运动统计量。仅优化该输入统计量，无需访问网络，就足以诱导分类失败，将两种扰动归因于同一回路脆弱性。因此，连接组约束模型可将对抗失败机制揭示为关于生物知觉脆弱性的可检验假设。

items.title_en: Genome-Wide Study of Early Disability Severity in Multiple Sclerosis
items.title_zh: 多发性硬化早期残疾严重程度的全基因组研究
items.abstract_en: Background and Objectives: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic neurological disorder characterized by demyelination and neuroaxonal injury. MS genetic susceptibility and severity long after disease onset is well characterized, but the genetic architecture of disability severity near disease onset is unclear. We performed the first genome-wide association study of early MS severity to identify causal loci, prioritize effector genes and associated pathways, and understand the relationships of early MS severity and various traits. Methods: The primary outcome was the first age-related MS severity score (ARMSS), an age-adjusted severity measure, in 7,209 individuals of Swedish discovery cohorts and independent Italian and multi-national European replication cohorts. Replicated loci underwent conditional analysis, fine-mapping, time-to-event MS phenotype association analyses, and multi-omics-based gene prioritization. Using the genome-wide summary statistics, we also conducted heritability analyses, polygenic risk score association with other MS phenotypes, gene-level and pathway analyses, cross-trait analyses with disease-related traits, Mendelian randomization, and drug-repurposing screening. Results: Two suggestive loci were replicated: rs1234317 at chromosome 1 (effect allele T: beta = 0.100, SE = 0.0189, P = 1.08E-07) and rs929769 at chromosome 5 (effect allele T: beta = -0.0956, SE = 0.0184, P = 1.95E-07). Fine-mapping supported rs929769 as a single-variant 95% credible set, and rs1234317 and rs6657136 as a two-variant 95% credible set with two-causal-SNP model having the highest posterior probability. The SNPs did not show a significant change in effect sizes when adjusted for heritable traits and exhibited attenuated associations with long-term MS disability progression. TNFSF4 was the top prioritized effector for rs1234317, TNFSF18 for rs6657136, and ADAMTS2 for rs929769. Early MS severity showed partial genetic overlap with MS susceptibility or late MS severity, but no significant correlation with a range of neurological, psychiatric, autoimmune, cognitive, and aging traits. Pathway analyses identified ion-channel regulation and folic acid metabolism, and Mendelian randomization suggested nominal bidirectional associations with educational attainment. Drug screening nominated several drugs that can be repurposed. Discussion: This study identifies candidate causal variants of early MS severity and their effector genes: TNFSF4, TNFSF18, and ADAMTS2. It provides insights into the genetic architecture and therapeutic measures for the early phase of MS severity.
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目标：多发性硬化（MS）是一种以脱髓鞘和神经轴突损伤为特征的慢性神经系统疾病。MS遗传易感性及疾病发作后很久的严重程度已被充分表征，但疾病发作附近残疾严重程度的遗传结构尚不清楚。我们进行了首个早期MS严重程度的全基因组关联研究，以识别因果位点、优先确定效应基因及相关通路，并理解早期MS严重程度与各种性状的关系。方法：主要结局是瑞典发现队列及独立意大利和多国欧洲复制队列中7,209个个体的首个年龄相关MS严重程度评分（ARMSS），一种年龄校正的严重程度指标。复制位点接受条件分析、精细定位、事件时间MS表型关联分析以及基于多组学的基因优先级排序。利用全基因组汇总统计量，我们还进行了遗传力分析、多基因风险评分与其他MS表型的关联、基因水平和通路分析、与疾病相关性状的跨性状分析、孟德尔随机化以及药物再利用筛选。结果：两个提示性位点被复制：染色体1上的rs1234317（效应等位基因T：beta = 0.100，SE = 0.0189，P = 1.08E-07）和染色体5上的rs929769（效应等位基因T：beta = -0.0956，SE = 0.0184，P = 1.95E-07）。精细定位支持rs929769作为单变异95%可信集，rs1234317和rs6657136作为双变异95%可信集，其中两因果SNP模型具有最高后验概率。当校正可遗传性状时，这些SNP的效应量未显示显著变化，并且与长期MS残疾进展的关联减弱。rs1234317的首要优先效应基因为TNFSF4，rs6657136为TNFSF18，rs929769为ADAMTS2。早期MS严重程度与MS易感性或晚期MS严重程度显示部分遗传重叠，但与一系列神经、精神、自身免疫、认知和衰老性状无显著相关性。通路分析识别出离子通道调节和叶酸代谢，孟德尔随机化提示与教育程度存在名义双向关联。药物筛选提名了几种可被再利用的药物。讨论：本研究识别了早期MS严重程度的候选因果变异及其效应基因：TNFSF4、TNFSF18和ADAMTS2。它为MS严重程度早期阶段的遗传结构和治疗措施提供了见解。

items.title_en: Good Practices for Measuring the Interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction by Brillouin Light Scattering and Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect
items.title_zh: 使用布里渊光散射和磁光克尔效应测量界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的良好实践
items.abstract_en: The interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (iDMI) is a key ingredient for stabilizing chiral magnetic states, such as skyrmions and chiral domain walls, which are key building blocks for next-generation spintronic technologies. Despite its importance, the quantitative determination of the iDMI constant, $D$, is often plagued by significant discrepancies. This paper establishes a set of good practices for measuring iDMI using two primary techniques: Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) and the Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect (MOKE). Through the analysis of Co/Pt-based heterostructures, this work provides a comprehensive roadmap for measurement procedures, data evaluation, and uncertainty analysis. Our analysis highlights the crucial role of magnetic parameters used to extract the iDMI constant and propagation of their uncertainties, and the measurement model for enhancing measurement reliability. The proposed methodology provides a practical framework for improving the consistency and reproducibility of iDMI measurements across different laboratories and experimental techniques.
items.abstract_zh: 界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（iDMI）是稳定手性磁态（如skyrmion和手性畴壁）的关键要素，而这些是下一代自旋电子技术的关键构建块。尽管其重要性，iDMI常数D的定量测定常受到显著差异的困扰。本文建立了一套使用两种主要技术测量iDMI的良好实践：布里渊光散射（BLS）和磁光克尔效应（MOKE）。通过分析Co/Pt基异质结构，本工作为测量程序、数据评估和不确定性分析提供了全面路线图。我们的分析强调了用于提取iDMI常数的磁参数及其不确定性传播的关键作用，以及用于提高测量可靠性的测量模型。所提出的方法提供了一个实用框架，以提高不同实验室和实验技术之间iDMI测量的一致性和可重复性。

items.title_en: Thickness-Field-Excited Bimorph Piezoelectric Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducer in Submicrometer Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
items.title_zh: 亚微米厚薄膜铌酸锂中的厚度场激励双压电晶片压电微机械超声换能器
items.abstract_en: This work presents the first demonstration of a submicrometer-thick thickness-field-excited (TFE) lithium niobate (LN) flexural-mode piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducer (PMUT). A 670-nm-thick bilayer periodically poled piezoelectric film (P3F) 128Y LN is used to demonstrate a suspended membrane with an area of 0.25 mm$^{2}$, achieving a low resonance frequency of 33.4 kHz for airborne transduction. Its electrical measurements reveal an extracted effective electromechanical coupling efficiency ($k_{\mathrm{eff}}^{2}$) of 3% and a moderate static capacitance $C_0$ of 17 pF. Meanwhile, mechanical measurements using a laser Doppler vibrometer (LDV) yield a high quasi-static peak out-of-plane displacement ($ξ_{\mathrm{static}}$) of 145 nm/V and a high corresponding open-circuit sensitivity ($S_{\mathrm{OC}}$) of 1.4 mV/Pa in the audio band. The fabricated device is compared with state-of-the-art (SoA) airborne piezoelectric transducers with sub-100-kHz resonance frequencies, underscoring the potential of the TFE P3F LN transducer platform by simultaneously demonstrating strong actuation capability while featuring high sensitivity.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作首次演示了亚微米厚的厚度场激励（TFE）铌酸锂（LN）弯曲模式压电微机械超声换能器（PMUT）。使用670 nm厚的双层周期性极化压电薄膜（P3F）128Y LN，演示了面积为0.25 mm²的悬浮膜，实现了33.4 kHz的低谐振频率用于空气声换能。其电学测量揭示了提取的有效机电耦合效率（k_eff²）为3%，以及17 pF的中等静态电容C0。同时，使用激光多普勒振动计（LDV）的机械测量在音频频带产生了145 nm/V的高准静态峰值面外位移（ξ_static）和1.4 mV/Pa的高相应开路灵敏度（S_OC）。将所制造器件与具有低于100 kHz谐振频率的最先进（SoA）空气声压电换能器进行比较，强调了TFE P3F LN换能器平台的潜力，同时展示强驱动能力和高灵敏度。

items.title_en: Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
items.title_zh: 创造性启动：将过程与产物解耦以逃脱创造力悖论
items.abstract_en: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能所承诺的许多最重要进展，从治愈疾病、发明新技术到提出新的科学理论，本质上都是创造性行为。然而，创造力独特地难以学习，因为它面临一个创造力悖论：学习重复过去创造性成功的例子会使那些特定例子更可能重现，从而抑制所期望的创造力。本工作主张，将创造力建模为一个显式过程而非单个产物的属性更好，并提出学习创造性过程背后的潜在生成原则。特别地，为逃脱该悖论，我们引入创造性启动（CP），其中训练过的启动模型生成针对提示的引物，帮助响应模型具有创造性，显式地将创造性过程与响应生成解耦。启动模型通过GRPO学习，奖励那些导致新颖、高质量和多样响应的引物，从而强化产生创造性响应的过程，而不强化任何特定响应。

items.title_en: Joint-State Inference for Autonomous Excavators Using Cab-View Vision-Control Fusion
items.title_zh: 基于驾驶室视角视觉-控制融合的自主挖掘机关节状态推断
items.abstract_en: Reliable state feedback of excavator front-end mechanisms is essential for autonomous excavation, yet retrofitting existing machines with dedicated joint sensors, external cameras, or visual markers can increase deployment and maintenance burdens. This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous excavation framework for continuous inference of excavator joint states using onboard visual observations and control-related temporal information. The framework encodes structural cues from the current cab-view image, models short-term motion trends from historical joystick commands, and introduces a rolling state buffer for the bucket joint to preserve temporal continuity under severe occlusion. Mechanical joint-range constraints are incorporated into the learning objective to suppress infeasible estimates. The current cab-view image and inferred states are supplied to an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT)-based control policy for online action generation. Experiments in an AGX Dynamics for Unity simulation environment under diverse operating conditions evaluate joint-state inference and end-to-end task execution. Across 20 autonomous excavation trials, the framework achieved a 95% task-completion rate, with an average joint-state-inference-and-control latency of 10.11 ms per step. The bucket-joint inference achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.965 degrees. These results demonstrate a sensor-light and computationally efficient joint-state-inference approach that can support closed-loop autonomous excavation with reduced dependence on additional sensing infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh: 挖掘机前端机构的可靠状态反馈对于自主挖掘至关重要，然而用专用关节传感器、外部相机或视觉标记对现有机器进行改造会增加部署和维护负担。本文提出一个闭环自主挖掘框架，利用车载视觉观察和控制相关时间信息连续推断挖掘机关节状态。该框架编码当前驾驶室视角图像中的结构线索，从历史操纵杆命令建模短期运动趋势，并为铲斗关节引入滚动状态缓冲，以在严重遮挡下保持时间连续性。机械关节范围约束被纳入学习目标以抑制不可行估计。当前驾驶室视角图像和推断状态被提供给基于Transformer的动作分块（ACT）控制策略，用于在线动作生成。在Unity的AGX Dynamics仿真环境中，在不同操作条件下进行实验，评估关节状态推断和端到端任务执行。在20次自主挖掘试验中，该框架达到95%的任务完成率，平均每步关节状态推断与控制延迟为10.11 ms。铲斗关节推断的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.965度。这些结果表明一种传感器轻量且计算高效的关节状态推断方法，可支持闭环自主挖掘，并减少对额外传感基础设施的依赖。

items.title_en: RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: RS-JEPA：具有扫描路径视图的遥感联合嵌入预测架构，用于跨传感器图像检索
items.abstract_en: Cross-sensor remote sensing image retrieval aims to find scenes with the same content across heterogeneous sensors, such as SAR and optical or panchromatic (PAN) and multispectral (MS) imagery, without manual labels. Existing self-supervised methods either reconstruct sensor-specific pixel detail, align each image only with its co-registered twin, or rely on large transformers with 118-173M parameters (and up to 398M). We introduce RS-JEPA, a compact joint-embedding predictive framework built on a Vision Mamba encoder shared by both sensors. Since a state-space encoder reads an image as an ordered sequence of patches, we propose scan-path views, which treat two reading orders of the same image as two views with identical pixels and predict the hidden patches in one order from the visible patches in the other.To keep this prediction challenging, we propose Adversarial View Coupling (AVC), which learns the hardest split of the visible patches, and a neighbourhood consensus loss that aligns the scene similarities of both sensors. Extensive experiments on SAR-optical (BEN-14K, CBRSIR-VS) and PAN-MS (DSRSID) benchmarks demonstrate that RS-JEPA achieves the highest F1@5 among twelve re-implemented methods (72.92, 80.35 and 94.43) with a retrieval network of only 3.88M parameters (14.57M in training, 8-16times fewer than prior JEPA retrievers). Like prior methods, RS-JEPA trains on co-registered pairs. Our results highlight reading order as a source of self-supervised views. code: https://github.com/Tanishq251/RSJEPA.
items.abstract_zh: 跨传感器遥感图像检索旨在无需人工标签的情况下，在异构传感器（如 SAR 与光学，或全色（PAN）与多光谱（MS）影像）之间找到内容相同的场景。现有的自监督方法要么重建传感器特定的像素细节，要么仅将每幅图像与其共配准的孪生图像对齐，要么依赖参数规模为 118–173M（最高达 398M）的大型 Transformer。我们提出 RS-JEPA，一个紧凑的联合嵌入预测框架，构建于两个传感器共享的 Vision Mamba 编码器之上。由于状态空间编码器将图像读取为有序的图像块序列，我们提出扫描路径视图，将同一幅图像的两种读取顺序视为具有相同像素的两个视图，并由一种顺序中的可见图像块预测另一种顺序中的隐藏图像块。为使该预测保持挑战性，我们提出对抗视图耦合（AVC），学习可见图像块的最难划分，并提出邻域一致性损失以对齐两个传感器的场景相似性。在 SAR-光学（BEN-14K、CBRSIR-VS）和 PAN-MS（DSRSID）基准上的大量实验表明，RS-JEPA 在十二种重新实现的方法中取得最高 F1@5（72.92、80.35 和 94.43），其检索网络仅有 3.88M 参数（训练时为 14.57M，比此前的 JEPA 检索器少 8–16 倍）。与先前方法一样，RS-JEPA 在共配准图像对上训练。我们的结果突出了读取顺序作为自监督视图的一种来源。代码：https://github.com/Tanishq251/RSJEPA。

items.title_en: ANTIOCH-VS: From Sequence to Hits with Modular, Open-Source Ensemble Virtual Screening
items.title_zh: ANTIOCH-VS：通过模块化开源集成虚拟筛选从序列到命中
items.abstract_en: Structure-based virtual screening needs a receptor conformation that fits the ligand class, but for most targets no ligand-bound crystal is available -- and a single predicted model or an apo structure often misses the binding-competent state. We present ANTIOCH-VS, an open-source framework that runs an entire in silico screening campaign, from a protein sequence to a ranked shortlist of candidate binders, as one plug-and-play workflow. It first builds a conformational ensemble by reduced-MSA subsampling with ColabFold, then uses AlphaFold2-RAVE (AF2RAVE) -- short molecular-dynamics simulations with State Predictive Information Bottleneck analysis -- to pick out docking-ready, Boltzmann-weighted metastable states. It then detects the binding pocket, prepares receptors and ligands, docks the library across the ensemble with DOCK6 or AutoDock Vina, builds a consensus ranking, and triages the top hits by physics-based metadynamics (CTMD). We benchmark it on two very different targets, JAK2 kinase and ADRB2 GPCR, using their DUD-E benchmark sets of known binders and property-matched decoys. Starting from sequence alone -- no ligand-bound crystal, no manual intervention -- the AF2RAVE ensembles gave top-20 shortlists strongly enriched for true binders: a 20% hit rate for JAK2 and 60% for ADRB2 (random ~1-2%), on par with ligand-bound crystals and, for the kinase, above single AF2 models and an apo crystal. The full pipeline runs end to end on a workstation or HPC from a single command, or each module can be run on its own with user-supplied inputs. ANTIOCH-VS is freely available at https://github.com/tiwarylab/antioch-vs
items.abstract_zh: 基于结构的虚拟筛选需要一个与配体类别相匹配的受体构象，但对大多数靶标而言，没有配体结合晶体可用——而单一预测模型或 apo 结构常常错过具备结合能力的状态。我们提出 ANTIOCH-VS，一个开源框架，可将整个计算机筛选流程——从蛋白质序列到候选结合物的排序短名单——作为一个即插即用工作流运行。它首先通过使用 ColabFold 的缩减 MSA 子采样构建构象集成，然后使用 AlphaFold2-RAVE（AF2RAVE）——结合状态预测信息瓶颈分析的短分子动力学模拟——挑选出适合对接的、玻尔兹曼加权的亚稳态。随后检测结合口袋、准备受体和配体、使用 DOCK6 或 AutoDock Vina 将文库对接到整个集成、构建共识排序，并通过基于物理的元动力学（CTMD）对排名靠前的命中进行筛选。我们在两个非常不同的靶标——JAK2 激酶和 ADRB2 GPCR——上使用其 DUD-E 基准集（已知结合物和性质匹配的诱饵）进行基准测试。仅从序列出发——无配体结合晶体、无人工干预——AF2RAVE 集成给出的前 20 名短名单强烈富集真实结合物：JAK2 的命中率为 20%，ADRB2 为 60%（随机约 1–2%），与配体结合晶体相当；对于该激酶，还高于单个 AF2 模型和一个 apo 晶体。完整流程可在工作站或 HPC 上通过单条命令端到端运行，或者每个模块可在用户提供输入的情况下单独运行。ANTIOCH-VS 可在 https://github.com/tiwarylab/antioch-vs 免费获取。

items.title_en: High-Speed Control of a Fluxonium Qubit via Picosecond Pulses from Josephson Digital Circuits
items.title_zh: 利用约瑟夫森数字电路产生的皮秒脉冲实现 Fluxonium 量子比特的高速控制
items.abstract_en: We develop a control strategy for fluxonium qubits based on picosecond single-flux-quantum (SFQ) pulses generated by Josephson digital circuits. A major challenge is that SFQ protocols originally designed for transmon control become inefficient for low-frequency fluxonium. In this regime, the asymmetry of flux and charge couplings leads either to excessive leakage or excessively long gate times. We show that this limitation can be overcome by two complementary protocols. The first protocol employs high-frequency SFQ pulse packets applied through the flux channel, offering a simple, analytically transparent, and robust approach for high-fidelity single-qubit control. The second protocol combines phase-shifted flux and charge pulse sequences to enhance the resonant drive and reduce the gate duration. Multilevel simulations demonstrate single-qubit gate fidelities above $99.99\%$; the simpler protocol remains robust under moderate variations of qubit parameters and flux bias, while the combined protocol preserves high fidelity while substantially accelerating the gate. These results establish SFQ-based cryogenic control as a realistic route to fast, accurate, and scalable manipulation of fluxonium qubits.
items.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于约瑟夫森数字电路产生的皮秒单磁通量子（SFQ）脉冲的 Fluxonium 量子比特控制策略。一个主要挑战是，最初为 transmon 控制设计的 SFQ 协议对低频 Fluxonium 变得低效。在此区间内，磁通与电荷耦合的不对称性要么导致过量泄漏，要么导致过长的门时间。我们表明，这一限制可以通过两种互补协议克服。第一种协议采用通过磁通通道施加的高频 SFQ 脉冲包，为高保真单量子比特控制提供一种简单、解析透明且稳健的方法。第二种协议结合相移的磁通和电荷脉冲序列，以增强共振驱动并缩短门持续时间。多能级模拟表明单量子比特门保真度高于 99.99%；较简单的协议在量子比特参数和磁通偏置的适度变化下仍保持稳健，而组合协议在保持高保真度的同时显著加速门。这些结果确立了基于 SFQ 的低温控制作为实现 Fluxonium 量子比特快速、精确且可扩展操控的一条现实路径。
